records.title_en: Work from Home before and after the COVID-19 Outbreak
records.title_cn: COVID-19疫情前后的居家办公
records.abstract_en: Based on novel survey data, we document a persistent rise in work from home (WFH) over the course of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using theory and direct survey evidence, we argue that three-quarters of this increase reflects the adoption of new work arrangements that will likely be permanent for many workers. A quantitative model matched to survey data predicts that twice as many workers will WFH full-time postpandemic compared to prepandemic, and that one in every five instead of seven workdays will be WFH. These model predictions are consistent with survey evidence on workers’ own expectations about WFH in the future. (JEL I12, I18, J22, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 基于新颖的调查数据，我们记录了在COVID-19疫情期间居家办公（WFH）的持续上升。利用理论和直接调查证据，我们认为这一增长的四分之三反映了新工作安排的采用，这些安排对许多工人来说可能是永久性的。与调查数据匹配的定量模型预测，疫情后全职居家办公的工人数量将是疫情前的两倍，并且每五个工作日中有一个（而非每七个工作日中有一个）将在家办公。这些模型预测与工人对未来居家办公期望的调查证据一致。（JEL I12, I18, J22, M54）

records.title_en: Product Variety, the Cost of Living, and Welfare across Countries
records.title_cn: 产品多样性、生活成本与跨国福利
records.abstract_en: We use the structure of the Melitz (2003) model to compute the cost of living and welfare across 47 countries, and compare these to conventional measures of prices and real consumption from the International Comparisons Project (ICP). The cost of living is inferred without directly using ICP prices of traded goods and instead relying on output prices, openness, domestic trade costs, and product variety measured by the counts of barcodes or firms. We find that welfare relative to the United States is lower than indicated by real consumption for most countries, but similar in China and Japan and similar or higher in some European countries. (JEL E21, E23, E31, O11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用Melitz（2003）模型的结构来计算47个国家的生活成本和福利，并将其与国际比较项目（ICP）的传统价格和实际消费度量进行比较。生活成本的推断不直接使用ICP的贸易品价格，而是依赖于产出价格、开放度、国内贸易成本以及通过条形码或企业数量衡量的产品多样性。我们发现，相对于美国，大多数国家的福利低于实际消费所显示的水平，但在中国和日本相似，在一些欧洲国家则相似或更高。（JEL E21, E23, E31, O11）

records.title_en: Electricity and Firm Productivity: A General-Equilibrium Approach
records.title_cn: 电力与企业生产率：一种一般均衡方法
records.abstract_en: Many policymakers view power outages as a major constraint on firm productivity in developing countries. Yet empirical studies find modest short-run effects of outages on firm performance. This paper builds a dynamic macroeconomic model to study the long-run general-equilibrium effects of power outages on productivity. Outages lower productivity in the model by creating idle resources, depressing the scale of incumbent firms and reducing entry of new firms. Consistent with the empirical literature, the model predicts small short-run effects of eliminating outages. However, the long-run general-equilibrium effects are much larger, supporting the view that eliminating outages is an important development objective. (JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)
records.abstract_cn: 许多政策制定者认为停电是发展中国家企业生产率的主要制约因素。然而，实证研究发现停电对企业绩效的短期影响有限。本文构建了一个动态宏观经济模型，以研究停电对生产率的长期一般均衡效应。在该模型中，停电通过创造闲置资源、压低现有企业规模并减少新企业进入来降低生产率。与实证文献一致，该模型预测消除停电的短期效应较小。然而，长期一般均衡效应要大得多，这支持了消除停电是重要发展目标的观点。(JEL D22, D24, G32, L94, O13, O14)

records.title_en: Trade Policies and Fiscal Devaluations
records.title_cn: 贸易政策与财政贬值
records.abstract_en: Fiscal devaluations—an increase in import tariffs and export subsidies (IX) or an increase in value-added taxes and payroll subsidies (VP)—have been shown to provide as much stimulus under fixed exchange rates as a currency devaluation. We find that if agents expect policies to be reversed and the tax pass-through is large, VP is contractionary and IX provides a modest boost. In our medium-scale DSGE model, both features are crucial in accounting for Germany’s underperformance in response to VP in 2007. These findings cast doubt on fiscal devaluations as a cyclical stabilization tool when monetary policy is constrained. (JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20)
records.abstract_cn: 财政贬值——提高进口关税和出口补贴（IX）或提高增值税和工资补贴（VP）——已被证明在固定汇率下能提供与货币贬值相当的刺激。我们发现，如果代理人预期政策将被逆转且税收传导效应较大，则VP具有紧缩效应，而IX仅提供适度的提振。在我们的中等规模DSGE模型中，这两个特征对于解释德国在2007年对VP反应不佳至关重要。这些发现对财政贬值作为货币政策受限时的周期性稳定工具提出了质疑。（JEL E32, E52, E62, F13, F33, H20）

records.title_en: Monetary Policy in Sudden Stop-Prone Economies
records.title_cn: 突然停止倾向经济体中的货币政策
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a parsimonious theory explaining the cyclicality of monetary policy in emerging countries in a model where access to foreign financing depends on the real exchange rate and the government lacks commitment. The discretionary monetary policy is procyclical to mitigate balance sheet effects originating from exchange rate depreciations during sudden stops. Committing to an inflation targeting regime is found to increase social welfare and reduce the frequency of financial crises despite increasing their severity. Finally, the ability to use capital controls induces a less procyclical discretionary monetary policy and delivers higher welfare gains than an inflation targeting regime. (JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一个简约理论，解释了新兴国家货币政策的周期性，在一个外国融资获取取决于实际汇率且政府缺乏承诺的模型中。相机抉择的货币政策是顺周期的，以减轻在突然停止期间由汇率贬值引起的资产负债表效应。研究发现，承诺通胀目标制度能增加社会福利并减少金融危机的频率，尽管增加了其严重性。最后，使用资本管制的能力导致较不顺周期的相机抉择货币政策，并比通胀目标制度带来更高的福利收益。(JEL E31, E32, E44, E52, F31, F33, F38)

records.title_en: Taxation of Consumption and Labor Income: A Quantitative Approach
records.title_cn: 消费与劳动收入征税：一种定量方法
records.abstract_en: I quantitatively characterize optimal consumption and labor income taxes in a structural life-cycle model of household consumption, saving, and employment choices that allows for irreversibility of durable goods and preference heterogeneity. I find that durables should be subsidized and nondurables should be taxed at a uniform rate. The durable subsidy is driven by the life-cycle features of the model together with durables’ irreversibility and borrowing constraints. Uniform taxation on nondurables holds under exogenous and endogenous—fully or weakly separable—labor supply and it relies on homogeneity of intertemporal preferences. Allowing for government’s equity concerns, I show that the model rationalizes the tax practice. (JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我在一个包含家庭消费、储蓄和就业选择的结构性生命周期模型中，定量刻画了最优消费和劳动收入税，该模型允许耐用品不可逆性和偏好异质性。我发现耐用品应获得补贴，而非耐用品应按统一税率征税。耐用品补贴由模型的生命周期特征以及耐用品的不可逆性和借贷约束共同驱动。在劳动供给外生和内生（完全或弱可分）的情况下，非耐用品的统一征税均成立，并且依赖于跨期偏好的同质性。考虑到政府的公平关切，我表明该模型能够合理化税收实践。（JEL D15, G51, H21, H23, H24, H31, J22）

records.title_en: Disentangling COVID-19, Economic Mobility, and Containment Policy Shocks
records.title_cn: 解析COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策冲击
records.abstract_en: We study the dynamic interaction between COVID-19, economic mobility, and containment policy. We use Bayesian panel structural vector autoregressions with daily data for 44 countries, identified through traditional and narrative sign restrictions. We find that incidence shocks and containment shocks have large and persistent effects on mobility, morbidity, and mortality that last for one to two months. These shocks are the main drivers of the pandemic, explaining between 20 and 60 percent of the average and historical variability in mobility, cases, and deaths worldwide. The policy trade-off associated to nonpharmaceutical interventions is 1 pp less economic mobility per day for 8 percent fewer deaths after 3 months. (JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19、经济流动性与防控政策之间的动态相互作用。我们使用44个国家的日度数据，通过传统和叙事符号约束识别的贝叶斯面板结构向量自回归模型。我们发现，发病率冲击和防控冲击对流动性、发病率和死亡率具有持续一至两个月的大而持久的影响。这些冲击是大流行的主要驱动因素，解释了全球流动性、病例和死亡的平均及历史变异的20至60%。与非药物干预相关的政策权衡是，每天减少1个百分点的经济流动性，8%个月后死亡人数减少3。(JEL C43, H51, I12, I18, O15)

records.title_en: “Quick Response” Economic Stimulus: The Effect of Small-Value Digital Coupons on Spending
records.title_cn: “快速响应”经济刺激：小额数字优惠券对消费的影响
records.abstract_en: We study a new consumption stimulus program implemented by a large Chinese city that leverages mobile payment platforms to dispense massive amounts of small-value digital coupons. Exploiting a “rush” design of the dispensing process in which over 1 million program participants compete for coupons on a first-come, first-served basis through a digital portal, we estimate that winning coupons increases weekly out-of-pocket spending by US$3 for every US$1 in government subsidy. Coupon-winning consumers practice inter-temporal substitution by moving up purchases that would have been made four months in the future. Customer flow analysis suggests that coupons distort consumption toward pricier options. (JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个由中国大城市实施的新型消费刺激计划，该计划利用移动支付平台发放大量小额数字优惠券。利用发放过程中的“抢购”设计，超过1百万计划参与者在数字门户上以先到先得的方式竞争优惠券，我们估计赢得优惠券会使每周自付支出增加，每获得政府补贴US$1，支出增加US$3。赢得优惠券的消费者通过将未来四个月才会进行的购买提前来实现跨期替代。客流分析表明，优惠券将消费扭曲向更昂贵的选择。(JEL D15, E21, E42, H71, O18, P25, P36)

records.title_en: Schooling, Skill Demand, and Differential Fertility in the Process of Structural Transformation
records.title_cn: 结构转型过程中的教育、技能需求与差异化生育
records.abstract_en: Demography and structural transformation are interrelated, and depend critically on education. At the turn of the twentieth century, US parents began having fewer children while increasing educational investment per child. This quantity-quality tradeoff facilitated job reallocation from the low-skilled agricultural sector to the high-skilled nonagricultural sector. This transformation is examined in a heterogeneous agent model with a nondegenerate human capital distribution, focusing on how fertility and education decisions affect structural transformation. The result shows that the quantity-quality decisions account for up to approximately one-third of the decline in the agricultural employment share. (JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31)
records.abstract_cn: 人口统计与结构转型相互关联，且关键取决于教育。在二十世纪之交，美国父母开始减少生育数量，同时增加每个孩子的教育投资。这种数量-质量权衡促进了就业从低技能的农业部门向高技能的非农业部门重新配置。本文在一个具有非退化人力资本分布的异质性主体模型中考察了这一转型，重点关注生育和教育决策如何影响结构转型。结果表明，数量-质量决策解释了农业就业份额下降的约三分之一。（JEL E24, I21, I26, J11, J13, J24, N31）

records.title_en: Overpersistence Bias in Individual Income Expectations and Its Aggregate Implications
records.title_cn: 个人收入预期中的过度持续性偏差及其总体影响
records.abstract_en: Using microlevel data, we document systematic forecast errors in household income expectations that are related to the level of income. We show that these errors can be formalized by a modest deviation from rational expectations, where agents overestimate the persistence of their income process. We then investigate the implications of these distortions on consumption and savings behavior and find two effects. First, these distortions allow an otherwise fully optimization-based quantitative model to match the joint distribution of liquid assets and income. Second, the bias alters the distribution of marginal propensities to consume which makes government stimulus policies less effective. (JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 利用微观层面数据，我们记录了家庭收入预期中与收入水平相关的系统性预测误差。我们表明，这些误差可以通过对理性预期的适度偏离来形式化，其中个体高估其收入过程的持续性。然后，我们研究了这些扭曲对消费和储蓄行为的影响，并发现了两个效应。第一，这些扭曲使得一个完全基于优化的定量模型能够匹配流动资产和收入的联合分布。第二，这种偏差改变了边际消费倾向的分布，使得政府刺激政策效果减弱。(JEL D84, E21, D91, E62, G51)

records.title_en: Information Dynamics and Macro Fluctuations
records.title_cn: 信息动态与宏观波动
records.abstract_en: The amount of information produced about firms’ productivities and about the quality of collateral backing their loans varies over time. These information dynamics determine the evolution of credit, output and productivity, which feeds back into incentives to produce information. We characterize this intricate dynamic relation. A credit boom happens when information about collateral depreciates. A financial crisis happens when information about collateral is suddenly generated. Information about firms’ individual productivities over credit booms can prevent or tame the crisis, acting as an endogenous macroprudential force. (JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)
records.abstract_cn: 关于企业生产率及其贷款抵押品质量的信息量随时间而变化。这些信息动态决定了信贷、产出和生产率的演变，进而反馈到生产信息的激励上。我们刻画了这一复杂的动态关系。当关于抵押品的信息贬值时，信贷繁荣发生。当关于抵押品的信息突然产生时，金融危机发生。在信贷繁荣期间，关于企业个体生产率的信息可以预防或缓和危机，起到内生宏观审慎力量的作用。(JEL D24, D83, E32, E44, G01, G32)

records.title_en: Optimal Policy for Macrofinancial Stability
records.title_cn: 宏观金融稳定的最优政策
records.abstract_en: There is a new and now large literature analyzing government policies for financial stability based on models with endogenous borrowing constraints. These normative analyses build upon the concept of constrained efficient allocation where the social planner is constrained by the same borrowing limit that agents face. In this paper, we show that there exists at least one set of tools implementing the constrained efficient allocation that can also be used by a Ramsey planner to replicate an unconstrained allocation, achieving higher welfare. Constrained efficiency may lead to inaccurate characterizations of welfare maximizing policies relative to Ramsey optimal policy. (JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)
records.abstract_cn: 有一个新的且现在庞大的文献，基于内生借款约束的模型分析政府金融稳定政策。这些规范分析建立在约束有效配置的概念之上，其中社会计划者受到与代理人相同的借款限制。在本文中，我们表明存在至少一套工具，可以实施约束有效配置，同时拉姆齐计划者也可以使用这些工具来复制无约束配置，实现更高的福利。相对于拉姆齐最优政策，约束效率可能导致对福利最大化政策的不准确描述。(JEL E32, E44, E61, G01, H21)

records.title_en: How Do Households Respond to Job Loss? Lessons from Multiple High-Frequency Datasets
records.title_cn: 家庭如何应对失业？来自多个高频数据集的经验教训
records.abstract_en: How much and through which channels do households self-insure against job loss? Combining data from a large bank and from government sources, we quantify a broad range of responses to job loss in a unified empirical framework. Cumulated over a two-year period, households reduce spending by 30 percent of their income loss. They mainly self-insure through adjustments of liquid balances, which account for 50 percent of the income loss. Other channels—spousal labor supply, private transfers, home equity extraction, mortgage refinancing, and consumer credit—contribute less to self-insurance. Both overall self-insurance and the channels vary with household characteristics in intuitive ways. (JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65)
records.abstract_cn: 家庭在多大程度上以及通过哪些渠道进行自我保险以应对失业？结合一家大型银行和政府来源的数据，我们在一个统一的实证框架中量化了对失业的广泛反应。在两年期间累计，家庭将支出减少了其收入损失的30%。他们主要通过调整流动性余额来自我保险，这占收入损失的50%。其他渠道——配偶劳动供给、私人转移、房屋净值提取、抵押贷款再融资和消费信贷——对自我保险的贡献较小。总体自我保险和各个渠道都随家庭特征以直观的方式变化。（JEL D12, G21, G51, J64, J65）

records.title_en: Improving Regulatory Effectiveness through Better Targeting: Evidence from OSHA
records.title_cn: 通过更好的目标定位提高监管有效性：来自OSHA的证据
records.abstract_en: We study how a regulator can best target inspections. Our case study is a US Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) program that randomly allocated some inspections. On average, each inspection led to 2.4 (9 percent) fewer serious injuries over the next 5 years. Using new machine learning methods, we find that OSHA could have averted as much as twice as many injuries by targeting inspections to workplaces with the highest expected averted injuries and nearly as many by targeting the highest expected level of injuries. Either approach would have generated up to $850 million in social value over the decade we examine. (JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究监管机构如何最好地定位检查。我们的案例研究是美国职业安全与健康管理局（OSHA）的一个项目，该项目随机分配了一些检查。平均而言，每次检查在接下来的2.4年内减少了9%（5）起严重伤害。使用新的机器学习方法，我们发现，如果OSHA将检查针对预期可避免伤害最高的工作场所，本可以避免多达两倍的伤害，而针对预期伤害水平最高的工作场所，本可以避免几乎同样多的伤害。在我们考察的十年间，这两种方法中的任何一种本可以产生高达850亿美元的社会价值。（JEL C63, J28, J81, K32, L51）

records.title_en: Temporal Instability of Risk Preference among the Poor: Evidence from Payday Cycles
records.title_cn: 贫困群体风险偏好的时间不稳定性：来自发薪日周期的证据
records.abstract_en: The poor live paycheck to paycheck and are repeatedly exposed to strong cyclical income fluctuations. We investigate whether such income fluctuations affect their risk preference. If risk preference temporarily changes around payday, optimal decisions made before payday may no longer be optimal afterward, which could reinforce poverty. By exploiting social security payday cycles in the United States, we find that the poor relying heavily on social security become more risk tolerant before payday. More than cognitive decline before payday, the deterioration of mental health and relative deprivation are likely to play a role. We find similar evidence among the Japanese elderly. (JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 穷人依赖薪水过活，反复暴露于强烈的周期性收入波动中。我们研究这种收入波动是否影响其风险偏好。如果风险偏好在发薪日前后暂时发生变化，那么发薪日前做出的最优决策在之后可能不再最优，这可能加剧贫困。利用美国社会保障发薪日周期，我们发现严重依赖社会保障的穷人在发薪日前变得更加风险容忍。与发薪日前认知衰退相比，心理健康恶化和相对剥夺感更可能发挥作用。我们在日本老年人中也发现了类似证据。(JEL D81, D91, G51, I12, I32, J14, J31)

records.title_en: Coming Apart? Cultural Distances in the United States over Time
records.title_cn: 分道扬镳？美国文化距离的历时变化
records.abstract_en: We analyze trends in cultural distances between groups in the United States defined by income, education, gender, race, and political ideology. We measure cultural distance as the ability to infer an individual's group based on media diet, consumer behavior, time use, social attitudes, or newborn's name. Gender difference in time-use decreased between 1965 and 1995 and has remained constant since. Differences in social attitudes by political ideology, and somewhat by income, have increased over the last four decades. Whites and non-Whites have diverged in consumer behavior. For all other demographic divisions and cultural dimensions, cultural distance has been broadly constant over time. (JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了美国按收入、教育、性别、种族和政治意识形态划分的群体之间文化距离的趋势。我们将文化距离衡量为基于媒体消费、消费者行为、时间使用、社会态度或新生儿姓名推断个人所属群体的能力。性别在时间使用上的差异在1965年至1995年间有所减少，此后保持不变。按政治意识形态划分的社会态度差异，以及在一定程度上按收入划分的差异，在过去四十年中有所增加。白人和非白人在消费者行为上出现分化。对于所有其他人口统计划分和文化维度，文化距离在时间上基本保持不变。（JEL D12, D91, J15, J16, L82, Z13）

records.title_en: Immigration, Crime, and Crime (Mis)Perceptions
records.title_cn: 移民、犯罪与犯罪（误）感知
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of immigration on crime and crime perceptions in Chile, where the foreign-born population tripled in less than ten years. We document null effects of immigration on crime but positive and significant effects on crime-related concerns and on preventive behavioral responses, such as investing in home security. We explore several channels and provide suggestive evidence related to low- versus high-education immigrants, ethnicity-related intergroup threats, and the role of local media. (JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了智利移民对犯罪和犯罪感知的影响，该国外国出生人口在不到十年内增长了两倍。我们记录了移民对犯罪的零效应，但对犯罪相关担忧和预防性行为反应（如投资家庭安全）有显著的正向效应。我们探讨了多个渠道，并提供了与低教育移民和高教育移民、与种族相关的群体间威胁以及地方媒体作用相关的提示性证据。（JEL D83, D91, J15, K42, L82, O15, O17）

records.title_en: Coordination and Bandwagon Effects: How Past Rankings Shape the Behavior of Voters and Candidates
records.title_cn: 协调与从众效应：过去的排名如何塑造选民和候选人的行为
records.abstract_en: Candidates' placements in polls and past elections can be powerful coordination devices for parties and voters. Using a regression discontinuity design in French two-round elections, we show that candidates who place first in the first round are more likely to stay in the race and win than those who placed second. These effects are even larger for ranking second versus third, and also present for third versus fourth. They stem from allied parties agreeing on which candidate should drop out, voters coordinating their choice, and the bandwagon effect of wanting to vote for the winner. We find similar results across 19 other countries. (JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)
records.abstract_cn: 候选人在民调和过往选举中的排名可以成为政党和选民的强大协调工具。利用法国两轮选举中的断点回归设计，我们表明在第一轮中排名第一的候选人比排名第二的候选人更有可能留在竞选中并获胜。这些效应对于排名第二与第三之间的比较甚至更大，并且在第三与第四之间也存在。它们源于联盟政党就哪位候选人应退出达成一致、选民协调其选择，以及希望投票给获胜者的从众效应。我们在其他19个国家发现了类似的结果。(JEL D72, D83, D91, K16)

records.title_en: Contagious Dishonesty: Corruption Scandals and Supermarket Theft
records.title_cn: 不诚实的传染性：腐败丑闻与超市盗窃
records.abstract_en: Is dishonest behavior contagious? We answer this question by studying whether corruption scandals affect the propensity of supermarket customers to steal while using a self-service checkout system. Crucially, this system allows shoppers to engage in dishonest behavior by underreporting the value of their shopping cart. Exploiting data from random audits on shoppers, we show that the probability of stealing increases by 16 percent after a local corruption scandal breaks. This effect is not driven by any change in material incentives. Suggestive evidence shows that it is driven by a reduction in the self-imposed cost of stealing. (JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 不诚实行为是否具有传染性？我们通过研究腐败丑闻是否影响超市顾客在使用自助结账系统时偷窃的倾向来回答这个问题。关键在于，该系统允许购物者通过低报其购物车价值来从事不诚实行为。利用对购物者随机审计的数据，我们表明，在当地腐败丑闻爆发后，偷窃的概率增加了16%。这一效应并非由物质激励的任何变化所驱动。提示性证据表明，它是由偷窃自我施加成本的降低所驱动的。(JEL D12, D73, D91, K42, L81, Z13)

records.title_en: Collateralized Marriage
records.title_cn: 抵押婚姻
records.abstract_en: Marriage rates have become increasingly stratified by homeownership. We investigate this in a household model where investments in public goods reduce future earnings and, thus, divorce risk creates inefficiencies. Access to a joint savings technology, like a house, collateralizes marriage, providing insurance to the lower-earning partner and increasing specialization, public goods, and value from marriage. We use idiosyncratic variation in housing prices to show that homeownership access indeed leads to greater specialization. The model also predicts that policies that erode the marriage contract in other ways will make wealth a more important determinant of marriage, which we confirm empirically. (JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 结婚率日益按房屋所有权分层。我们在一个家庭模型中研究这一问题，其中公共品投资会降低未来收入，因此离婚风险造成低效率。获得联合储蓄技术（如房屋）的机会将婚姻抵押化，为低收入伴侣提供保险，并增加专业化、公共品和婚姻价值。我们利用房价的异质性变化表明，获得房屋所有权确实导致更大的专业化。该模型还预测，以其他方式侵蚀婚姻契约的政策将使财富成为婚姻更重要的决定因素，我们在实证中证实了这一点。（JEL D12, D86, G51, H41, J12, R31）

records.title_en: How Cable News Reshaped Local Government
records.title_cn: 有线新闻如何重塑地方政府
records.abstract_en: This paper shows that partisan cable news broadcasts have a causal effect on the size and composition of budgets in US localities. Using exogenous channel positioning as an instrument for viewership, we show that exposure to the conservative Fox News channel reduces revenues and expenditures. Multiple mechanisms drive these results: Fox News improves election chances for local Republicans, alters politician campaign agendas, and shifts voter policy preferences on fiscal issues. Consistent with the priorities of small-government conservatism, we find evidence that private provision compensates for the reduced public services. The “Fox News effect” extends beyond vote shares to rightward policy shifts. (JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文表明，党派有线新闻广播对美国地方政府的预算规模和构成具有因果效应。利用外生的频道定位作为收视率的工具变量，我们表明接触保守派福克斯新闻频道会减少收入和支出。多种机制驱动这些结果：福克斯新闻提高了地方共和党人的选举机会，改变了政治家的竞选议程，并转变了选民在财政问题上的政策偏好。与小政府保守主义的优先事项一致，我们发现证据表明私人供给补偿了减少的公共服务。“福克斯新闻效应”超越了选票份额，延伸至右翼政策转变。（JEL D72, H71, H72, H75, I20, L82）

records.title_en: Hidden Income and the Perceived Returns to Migration
records.title_cn: 隐藏收入与迁移的感知回报
records.abstract_en: In many developing economies, urban workers earn substantially more than rural workers with the same level of education. Why don't more rural workers migrate to cities? I use two field experiments in Kenya to show that low migration is partly due to underestimation of urban incomes, which is sustained by income hiding by migrants. Parents at the origin underestimate their migrant children's incomes by nearly half, and underestimation is greater when a migrant's remittance obligations are high. Providing information about urban earnings increases migration to the capital city by about 40 percent over two years. (JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 在许多发展中经济体，城市工人比同等教育水平的农村工人收入高得多。为什么没有更多农村工人迁移到城市？我在肯尼亚进行了两项实地实验，表明低迁移率部分是由于对城市收入的低估，而这种低估是由迁移者隐藏收入所维持的。原籍地的父母低估其迁移子女的收入近一半，当迁移者的汇款义务较高时，低估程度更大。提供关于城市收入的信息使前往首都城市的迁移在两年内增加了约40%。(JEL C93, J31, J61, J82, O15, O18, R23)

records.title_en: Returns to International Migration: Evidence from a Bangladesh-Malaysia Visa Lottery
records.title_cn: 国际移民的回报：来自孟加拉国-马来西亚签证抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: South Asians traveling to richer Asian nations is the world's largest migration corridor. We track down applicants to a government lottery that randomly allocated visas to Bangladeshis for temporary labor contracts in Malaysia, five years later. Most lottery winners migrate, and migrants' earnings triple. Their remittance raises their family's standard of living in Bangladesh. The migrant's absence pauses marriage and childbirth and shifts decision-making power toward females. Migration removes enterprising individuals, lowering household entrepreneurship, but does not crowd out other family members' labor supply. A deferred migration offer never materialized for a subgroup. Their premigration investments in skills generate no returns in the domestic market. (JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 南亚人前往较富裕的亚洲国家是世界上最大的移民走廊。我们追踪了一项政府抽签的申请人，该抽签随机分配签证给孟加拉国人，以便他们在马来西亚获得临时劳动合同，五年后进行调查。大多数中签者移民，移民的收入增加了两倍。他们的汇款提高了家人在孟加拉国的生活水平。移民的缺席推迟了婚姻和生育，并将决策权转向女性。移民带走了有创业精神的个体，降低了家庭创业，但并未挤出其他家庭成员的家庭劳动力供给。一个推迟的移民提议对某个亚组从未实现。他们在移民前对技能的投资在国内市场没有产生回报。(JEL F22, F24, I31, J24, J31, J82, O15)

records.title_en: Civil Liberties in Times of Crisis
records.title_cn: 危机时期的公民自由
records.abstract_en: We study people's willingness to trade off civil liberties for increased health security in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic by deploying representative surveys involving around 550,000 responses across 15 countries. We document significant heterogeneity across groups in willingness to sacrifice rights: citizens disadvantaged by income, education, or race are less willing to sacrifice rights than their more advantaged peers in every country. Leveraging naturally occurring variation and experimental approaches, we estimate a one standard deviation increase in health insecurity increases willingness to sacrifice civil liberties by 68–83 percent of the difference between the average Chinese and US citizen. (JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过部署涉及约19万份回复、覆盖550000个国家的代表性调查，研究在COVID-15大流行背景下人们愿意以公民自由换取更高健康安全的程度。我们记录了不同群体在牺牲权利意愿上的显著异质性：在每个国家，收入、教育或种族方面处于不利地位的公民比其更有利的同伴更不愿意牺牲权利。利用自然发生的变异和实验方法，我们估计健康不安全感增加一个标准差会使牺牲公民自由的意愿增加平均中国公民与美国公民差异的68-83%。（JEL D12, D91, I12, I18, K38, O17, P36）

records.title_en: Discrimination in Times of Crises and the Role of the Media
records.title_cn: 危机时期的歧视与媒体的作用
records.abstract_en: Can the extent of ethnic discrimination change quickly, and what circumstances and mechanisms make such changes possible? I address these questions by using scraped data to study the daily evolution of customer discrimination against Arab doctors in Israel from January 2020 to June 2021. Results show that: (1) the outbreak of the coronavirus crisis in March 2020 led to a dramatic decline in discrimination; (2) the eruption of a wave of ethnic riots in May 2021 had the opposite effect; (3) media coverage of the contribution of Arab doctors to the fight against the pandemic helped bring about the first change. (JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 种族歧视的程度能否迅速变化，哪些环境和机制使这种变化成为可能？我通过使用抓取的数据研究以色列阿拉伯医生在2020年一月至2021年六月期间顾客歧视的日常演变来回答这些问题。结果表明：（1）2020年三月冠状病毒危机的爆发导致歧视急剧下降；（2）2021年五月种族骚乱的爆发产生了相反的效果；（3）媒体对阿拉伯医生抗击疫情的贡献的报道有助于促成第一个变化。（JEL D91, I12, J15, J44, L82）

records.title_en: Physical Disability and Labor Market Discrimination: Evidence from a Video Résumé Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 身体残疾与劳动力市场歧视：来自视频简历实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We sent fictitious applications to firms advertising job openings. We find that revealing a disability decreases callback rates by 25 percentage points. This result is not explained by accessibility constraints or lower productivity due to disability. We find that including a video résumé of a well-spoken applicant significantly increases callbacks by 10 percentage points for persons with and without disabilities, suggesting that discrimination is unaffected by quality signals in our context. Analysis of viewing activity suggests that employers seek less information when the applicant is disabled. Disclosing the disability later in the video increases employers' viewing time but leaves callback rates unchanged. (JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们向发布招聘广告的公司发送了虚构的求职申请。我们发现，披露残疾会使回电率降低25个百分点。这一结果并非由无障碍限制或残疾导致的生产率下降所解释。我们发现，包含一位口齿清晰的申请人的视频简历会显著提高有残疾和无残疾申请人的回电率10个百分点，这表明在我们的情境中，歧视不受质量信号的影响。对观看活动的分析表明，当申请人为残疾人时，雇主会寻求更少的信息。在视频中较晚披露残疾会增加雇主的观看时间，但回电率保持不变。(JEL C93, J14, J23, J24, J71, K31, M51)

records.title_en: The Effect of Hospital Postpartum Care Regulations on Breastfeeding and Maternal Time Allocation
records.title_cn: 医院产后护理法规对母乳喂养和母亲时间分配的影响
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of state hospital regulations intended to increase breastfeeding by requiring certain standards of care during the immediate postpartum hospital stay. We find that these regulations significantly increased breastfeeding initiation by 3.8 percentage points (5.1 percent) and the probability of breastfeeding at 3 and 6 months postpartum by approximately 7 percent. We also provide evidence that these breastfeeding-promoting policies significantly increased maternal time spent on child care, crowding out time spent on formal work. Observed reductions in employment are concentrated among mothers with infants between zero and three months of age. (JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了旨在通过要求产后住院期间特定护理标准来增加母乳喂养的州医院法规的影响。我们发现这些法规显著提高了母乳喂养的启动率，增加了3.8个百分点（5.1%），并使得产后3个月和6个月时母乳喂养的概率大约提高了7%。我们还提供了证据表明，这些促进母乳喂养的政策显著增加了母亲用于儿童护理的时间，挤占了用于正式工作的时间。观察到的就业减少主要集中在婴儿年龄在零到三个月之间的母亲中。（JEL H75, I11, I18, J13, J16, J22）

records.title_en: Do Credit Supply Shocks Affect Employment in Middle-Income Countries?
records.title_cn: 信贷供给冲击是否影响中等收入国家的就业？
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effect of bank credit supply shocks on formal employment in Mexico using a proprietary dataset containing information on all loans extended to firms by commercial banks during 2010–2015. We find large impacts on the formal employment of small and medium firms: a positive credit shock of 1 standard deviation increases yearly employment by 1.4 percentage points. The shares of uncollateralized credit and credit received by family firms, younger firms, and firms with no previous bank relationships also increase, suggesting that credit shocks may play a more prominent role for employment creation in credit-constrained settings. (JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用一个专有数据集，该数据集包含2010-2015年间商业银行向企业发放的所有贷款信息，研究了银行信贷供给冲击对墨西哥正规就业的影响。我们发现信贷冲击对中小企业的正规就业有显著影响：正向信贷冲击增加1个标准差，会使年就业增加1.4个百分点。无抵押信贷和由家族企业、年轻企业以及无先前银行关系的企业获得的信贷份额也有所增加，这表明在信贷受限的环境中，信贷冲击可能对就业创造发挥更突出的作用。（JEL D22, G21, G32, J23, L25, M51, O16）

records.title_en: Public and Private Options in Practice: The Military Health System
records.title_cn: 实践中的公共与私人选择：军事卫生系统
records.abstract_en: Recent debates over health care reform, including in the context of the Military Health System (MHS) and Veterans Administration, highlight the dispute between public and private provision of health care services. Using novel data on childbirth claims from the MHS and drawing on the combination of plausibly exogenous patient moves and heterogeneity across bases in the availability of base hospitals, we identify the impact of receiving obstetrical care on versus off military bases. We find evidence that off-base care is associated with slightly greater resource intensity, but also notably better outcomes, suggesting marginal efficiency gains from care privatization. (JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33)
records.abstract_cn: 近期关于医疗改革的辩论，包括在军事卫生系统（MHS）和退伍军人管理局的背景下，凸显了公共与私人提供医疗服务之间的争议。利用来自MHS的新颖分娩索赔数据，并结合看似外生的患者流动和不同基地在基地医院可用性上的异质性，我们识别了在军事基地内与基地外接受产科护理的影响。我们发现证据表明，基地外护理与略高的资源密集度相关，但同时也与显著更好的结果相关，这表明护理私有化带来了边际效率收益。（JEL H51, H56, I11, I18, J13, L33）

records.title_en: Age Discrimination across the Business Cycle
records.title_cn: 年龄歧视与经济周期
records.abstract_en: We test whether age discrimination rises during recessions using two complementary analyses. Confidential EEOC microdata reveal that age-related firing and hiring charges rise by 3.3 percent and 1.6 percent, respectively, for each percentage point increase in a state-industry’s monthly unemployment. Though the opportunity cost of filing falls, the fraction of meritorious claims increases—a sufficient condition for rising discrimination under plausible assumptions. Second, we repurpose data from hiring correspondence studies conducted across different cities and time periods during the recovery from the Great Recession. Each percentage point increase in local unemployment reduces the callback rate for older versus younger women by 15 percent. (JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过两项互补分析检验年龄歧视是否在经济衰退期间加剧。机密的EEOC微观数据显示，州-行业月度失业率每上升一个百分点，与年龄相关的解雇和招聘指控分别上升3.3%和1.6%。尽管提起诉讼的机会成本下降，但有理有据的索赔比例增加——在合理假设下，这是歧视加剧的充分条件。其次，我们重新利用大衰退复苏期间在不同城市和时间段进行的招聘对应研究数据。当地失业率每上升一个百分点，老年女性相对于年轻女性的回电率下降15%。(JEL E32, J14, J16, J23, J71, M51)

records.title_en: My Professor Cares: Experimental Evidence on the Role of Faculty Engagement
records.title_cn: 我的教授关心：教师参与作用的实验证据
records.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on the impact of specific faculty behaviors aimed at increasing student success for college students from historically underrepresented groups. The intervention was developed after conducting in-person focus groups and a pilot experiment. We find significant positive treatment effects across a multitude of short- and longer-run outcomes. Specifically, underrep-resented students in the treatment report more positive perceptions of the professor and earned higher course grades. These positive effects persisted over the next several years, with students in the treatment more likely to persist in college, resulting in increased credit accumulation and degree completion. (JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于特定教师行为对历史上代表性不足群体大学生学业成功影响的实验证据。该干预措施是在进行面对面焦点小组和试点实验后制定的。我们在众多短期和长期结果中发现了显著的正向处理效应。具体而言，处理组中代表性不足的学生对教授的看法更为积极，并获得了更高的课程成绩。这些积极效应在接下来的几年中持续存在，处理组的学生更有可能坚持完成大学学业，从而增加了学分积累和学位完成率。（JEL I22, I23, I28, J15, J44）

records.title_en: Public Pension Reforms and Retirement Decisions: Narrative Evidence and Aggregate Implications
records.title_cn: 公共养老金改革与退休决策：叙事证据与总体影响
records.abstract_en: We construct a database of public pension policy changes with motivation and implementation information for ten OECD countries. Structural pension reforms, motivated by long-run sustainability concerns, often come with prolonged phase-in periods. In response to pension retrenchments implemented immediately, people close to retirement stay in the workforce longer. News about future pension retrenchments with implementation lags, however, is likely to lead this group to exit the labor market. This decline in the labor force participation rate is particularly strong for reforms with long lags, ones that introduce fundamental policy changes, and ones where citizens have lower trust in the government. (JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个包含十个OECD国家公共养老金政策变化及其动机和实施信息的数据库。出于长期可持续性考虑的结构性养老金改革，往往伴随着较长的分阶段实施期。对于立即实施的养老金削减措施，接近退休年龄的人群会延长工作年限。然而，关于未来养老金削减且实施滞后的消息，则可能导致这一群体退出劳动力市场。这种劳动力参与率的下降，在实施滞后较长、引入根本性政策变化以及公民对政府信任度较低的情况下尤为显著。(JEL E62, H55, J14, J22, J26)

records.title_en: Moved to Poverty? A Legacy of the Apartheid Experiment in South Africa
records.title_cn: 被迫迁往贫困？南非种族隔离实验的遗产
records.abstract_en: During the South African apartheid, Black people were forced to move to homelands during the 1960s and 1970s, resulting in one of history’s largest segregation policy experiments. We examine how and why relocation to the homelands affected human capital attainment. Exploiting the staggered timing of homeland establishment in a cross-cohort identification strategy, we find that moving to the home-lands during childhood significantly reduces educational attainment, labor earnings, and employment rates in adulthood. The data suggest an important role for place effects. Moving to the homelands in childhood implies greater exposure to poorer neighborhoods, and it disproportionally reduces human capital attainment. (JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 在南非种族隔离期间，黑人在1960年代和1970年代被迫迁往“黑人家园”，这成为历史上最大规模的种族隔离政策实验之一。我们研究了迁往家园如何以及为何影响人力资本积累。利用家园建立时间在不同队列中的交错性作为识别策略，我们发现童年时期迁往家园显著降低了成年后的教育成就、劳动收入和就业率。数据表明，地点效应发挥了重要作用。童年时期迁往家园意味着更多地暴露于更贫困的社区，并且不成比例地减少了人力资本积累。(JEL I26, J15, J24, J31, N37, O15, R23)

records.title_en: Dynamic Impacts of School-Based Internet Access on Student Learning: Evidence from Peruvian Public Primary Schools
records.title_cn: 学校互联网接入对学生学习的动态影响：来自秘鲁公立小学的证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate the impacts of school-based internet access on second graders’ test scores, using over 2 million student observations from a panel of Peruvian public primary schools. We identify effects up to 6+ years after installation on different cohorts of second-grade students, exploiting variation in the timing of internet access induced by the rollout of a national program. We find positive but modest short-run impacts, but importantly, these effects grow for subsequent cohorts. Indeed, short-run estimates alone would have led to different conclusions. These dynamics underscore the value of extended evaluation windows to allow benefits of educational technology to materialize. (JEL I21, I26, I28, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用秘鲁公立小学的面板数据，包含超过2万个学生观测值，研究了学校互联网接入对二年级学生考试成绩的影响。我们利用国家项目推广过程中互联网接入时间的差异，识别了安装后长达6年以上的不同二年级学生群体的效应。我们发现短期影响虽为正但较为温和，但重要的是，这些效应在后续队列中有所增长。实际上，仅基于短期估计会得出不同的结论。这些动态变化强调了延长评估窗口的重要性，以便教育技术的好处得以显现。（JEL I21, I26, I28, O15）

records.title_en: Effects of Maturing Private School Choice Programs on Public School Students
records.title_cn: 成熟的私立学校选择项目对公立学校学生的影响
records.abstract_en: Using a rich dataset that merges student-level school records with birth records, and leveraging a student fixed effects design, we explore how a Florida private school choice program affected public school students’ outcomes as the program matured and scaled up. We observe growing benefits (higher standardized test scores and lower absenteeism and suspension rates) to students attending public schools with more preprogram private school options as the program matured. Effects are particularly pronounced for lower-income students, but results are positive for more affluent students as well. Local and district-wide private school competition are both independently related to student outcomes. (JEL H75, I21, I22, I28)
records.abstract_cn: 利用一个将学生层面的学校记录与出生记录合并的丰富数据集，并采用学生固定效应设计，我们探讨了佛罗里达州的一个私立学校选择项目在成熟和扩大规模过程中如何影响公立学校学生的结果。随着项目的成熟，我们观察到就读于项目前私立学校选择更多的公立学校的学生获得了越来越多的益处（标准化测试成绩更高，缺勤率和停学率更低）。对于低收入学生而言，这些效应尤为显著，但对较富裕学生而言结果也是积极的。地方和学区范围内的私立学校竞争均与学生结果独立相关。（JEL H75, I21, I22, I28）

records.title_en: Electoral Cycles in Macroprudential Regulation
records.title_cn: 宏观审慎监管中的选举周期
records.abstract_en: Do politics matter for macroprudential policies? I show that changes in macroprudential regulation exhibit a predictable electoral cycle in the run-up to 221 elections across 58 countries from 2000 through 2014. Policies restricting mortgages and consumer credit are systematically looser before elections, particularly during economic expansions. Consistent with theories of opportunistic political cycles, this pattern is stronger when election outcomes are uncertain, regulators are closely tied to politicians, and institutions are poor. These results suggest that political pressures may limit the ability of regulators to “lean against the wind.” (JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28)
records.abstract_cn: 政治因素对宏观审慎政策有影响吗？我展示了在2000年至2014年间，58个国家的宏观审慎监管变化在221次选举前呈现出可预测的选举周期。限制抵押贷款和消费信贷的政策在选举前系统性放松，尤其是在经济扩张期间。与机会主义政治周期理论一致，这种模式在选举结果不确定、监管者与政治家关系密切以及制度薄弱时更为明显。这些结果表明，政治压力可能限制监管者“逆风而行”的能力。（JEL D72, E32, G01, G21, G28）

records.title_en: Market Power and Price Exposure: Learning from Changes in Renewable Energy Regulation
records.title_cn: 市场势力与价格暴露：从可再生能源监管变化中学习
records.abstract_en: Given the critical role of renewable energies in current and future electricity markets, it is important to understand how they affect firms’ pricing incentives. We study whether the price-depressing effect of renewables depends on their degree of market price exposure. Paying renewables with fixed prices, rather than market-based prices, is more effective at curbing market power when the dominant firms own large shares of renewables, and vice versa. Our empirical short-lived changes to renewables regulation in the Spanish market and shows that switching from full-price exposure to fixed prices caused a 2–4 percent reduction in the average price-cost markup. (JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48)
records.abstract_cn: 鉴于可再生能源在当前和未来电力市场中的关键作用，理解它们如何影响企业的定价激励十分重要。我们研究了可再生能源的价格抑制效应是否取决于其市场价格暴露程度。当主导企业拥有大量可再生能源份额时，以固定价格而非市场价格支付可再生能源，在抑制市场势力方面更为有效，反之亦然。我们对西班牙市场可再生能源监管的短期变化进行的实证研究表明，从完全价格暴露转向固定价格导致平均价格-成本加成率下降了2-4%。（JEL L13, L94, L98, Q42, Q48）

records.title_en: The Effects of Import Competition on Unionization
records.title_cn: 进口竞争对工会化的影响
records.abstract_en: We study direct and indirect effects of Chinese import competition on union membership in the United States, 1990–2014. Import competition in manufacturing induced a modest decline in unionization within manufacturing industries. The magnitude is small because unionized manufacturers competed in higher-quality product segments. Manufacturers in right-to-work states experienced more direct competition with low-quality Chinese imports. Outside of manufacturing, however, import competition causes an important increase in union membership, as less educated women shift away from retail and toward jobs in health care and education where unions are stronger. We calculate that Chinese imports prevented 26 percent of the union density decline that would have otherwise occurred. (JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了1990-2014年间中国进口竞争对美国工会会员人数的直接和间接影响。制造业中的进口竞争导致制造业行业内工会化程度出现适度下降。这一幅度较小，因为工会化的制造商在更高质量的产品细分市场竞争。在拥有工作权法的州，制造商面临来自低质量中国进口商品的更直接竞争。然而，在制造业之外，进口竞争导致工会会员人数显著增加，因为受教育程度较低的女性从零售业转向医疗保健和教育行业，这些行业的工会更为强大。我们计算得出，中国进口阻止了本可能发生的工会密度下降的26%。（JEL F14, F16, J16, J51, L60, P33）

records.title_en: Information and Spillovers from Targeting Policy in Peru’s Anchoveta Fishery
records.title_cn: 秘鲁鳀鱼渔业中目标政策的信息与溢出效应
records.abstract_en: This paper establishes that a targeted policy backfires because it reveals information about nontargeted units. In the world’s largest fishery, the regulator attempts to reduce the harvesting of juvenile fish by temporarily closing areas where the share of juvenile catch is high. By combining administrative microdata with biologically richer data from fishing firms, I isolate variation in closures that is due to the regulator’s lower-resolution data. I estimate substantial temporal and spatial spillovers from closures. Closures increase total juvenile catch by 48 percent because closure announcements implicitly signal that fishing before, just outside, and after closures is high productivity. (JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)
records.abstract_cn: 本文证实了一项目标政策因揭示了非目标单位的信息而适得其反。在全球最大的渔业中，监管机构试图通过暂时关闭幼鱼捕捞比例较高的区域来减少幼鱼的捕捞。通过将行政微观数据与渔业公司提供的生物学更丰富的数据相结合，我分离了因监管机构较低分辨率数据而导致的关闭变化。我估计了关闭带来的显著时间和空间溢出效应。关闭使幼鱼总捕捞量增加了48%，因为关闭公告隐含地表明，在关闭之前、紧邻关闭区域之外以及关闭之后进行捕捞具有高生产率。(JEL D83, O13, Q21, Q22, Q28)

records.title_en: Digitization and the Market for Physical Works: Evidence from the Google Books Project
records.title_cn: 数字化与实体作品市场：来自谷歌图书项目的证据
records.abstract_en: The free digital distribution of creative works could cannibalize demand for physical versions, but it could also boost physical sales by enabling consumers to discover the original work. We study the impact of the Google Books digitization project on the market for physical books. We find that digitization significantly boosts the demand for physical versions and provide evidence for the discovery channel. Moreover, digitization allows independent publishers to introduce new editions for existing books, further increasing sales. Our results highlight the potential of free digital distribution to strengthen the demand for and supply of physical products. (JEL D12, L82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 创意作品的免费数字分发可能会蚕食实体版本的需求，但也可能通过使消费者发现原作来促进实体销售。我们研究了谷歌图书数字化项目对实体书市场的影响。我们发现数字化显著提升了实体版本的需求，并为发现渠道提供了证据。此外，数字化使独立出版商能够为现有书籍推出新版本，进一步增加销售。我们的结果凸显了免费数字分发在增强实体产品需求和供给方面的潜力。（JEL D12, L82, L86）

records.title_en: Brexit Uncertainty and Its (Dis)Service Effects
records.title_cn: 英国脱欧不确定性及其（非）服务效应
records.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of increased policy uncertainty from Brexit on UK trade in services. We apply an uncertainty-augmented gravity equation to UK services trade with the European Union at the industry level from 2016:I to 2018:IV. By exploiting the variation in the probability of Brexit from prediction markets interacted with a new trade policy risk measure across service industries, we identify a significant negative impact of the threat of Brexit on trade values and participation. The increased probability of Brexit in this period lowered services exports by at least 20 log points. (JEL F13, F14, F15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估算了英国脱欧带来的政策不确定性增加对英国服务贸易的影响。我们将不确定性增强的引力方程应用于2016年第一季度至2018年第四季度英国与欧盟在行业层面的服务贸易。通过利用预测市场中脱欧概率的变化与跨服务行业的新贸易政策风险度量之间的交互作用，我们识别出脱欧威胁对贸易额和参与度的显著负面影响。该时期脱欧概率的增加使服务出口至少下降了20个对数点。（JEL F13, F14, F15）

records.title_en: Do Tax Incentives Increase Firm Innovation? An RD Design for R&D, Patents, and Spillovers
records.title_cn: 税收激励是否增加企业创新？研发、专利和溢出效应的断点回归设计
records.abstract_en: We present causal evidence of R&D tax incentives’ positive impacts on a firm’s own innovation and that of its technological neighbors. Exploiting a change in size-based eligibility thresholds for R&D tax relief, we implement a Regression Discontinuity Design using administrative data. We find significant effects of tax relief on (quality-adjusted) patenting (and R&D) that persist up to seven years, and evidence of R&D spillovers on the innovation of technologically close firms. We can rule out elasticities of patenting with respect to R&D user cost of under 2 at the 5 percent level and show that our large effects are driven by financially constrained treated firms. (JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了研发税收激励对企业自身创新及其技术邻近企业创新的因果证据。利用基于规模资格的研发税收减免门槛变化，我们使用行政数据实施断点回归设计。我们发现税收减免对（质量调整后的）专利申请（和研发）有显著影响，且影响持续长达七年，并提供了研发溢出效应对技术相近企业创新的证据。我们可以在5%水平上排除专利申请相对于研发用户成本的弹性低于2的情况，并表明我们的显著效应是由财务受限的处理企业驱动的。（JEL D22, H25, H32, O31, O34）

records.title_en: Juvenile Crime and Anticipated Punishment
records.title_cn: 青少年犯罪与预期惩罚
records.abstract_en: Can sanctions deter juvenile crime? Research indicates that they may not, as offending barely decreases when individuals cross the age of criminal majority and begin to face harsher sanctions. Several models of criminal behavior predict, however, that these small reactions close to the threshold may mask larger behavioral responses among individuals below the age threshold. Policy variation between 2007–2015 in the United States is used to show evidence consistent with these predictions—juvenile crime increases when the age of majority is increased. This increase is driven by younger age groups and is considerably larger than discontinuity estimates at the threshold. (JEL D91, J13, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 制裁能否威慑青少年犯罪？研究表明，它们可能不能，因为当个人跨过刑事责任年龄并开始面临更严厉的制裁时，犯罪行为几乎没有减少。然而，几种犯罪行为模型预测，接近门槛的这些微小反应可能掩盖了低于年龄门槛的个体中更大的行为反应。利用美国2007-2015年间的政策变化，提供了与这些预测一致的证据——当成年年龄提高时，青少年犯罪增加。这种增加由较年轻的年龄组驱动，并且比门槛处的断点估计要大得多。（JEL D91, J13, K42）

records.title_en: Monitor Reputation and Transparency
records.title_cn: 监督者声誉与透明度
records.abstract_en: We study the disclosure policy of a regulator overseeing a monitor with reputation concerns. The monitor faces a manager, who chooses how much to manipulate based on the monitor’s reputation. Reputational incentives are strongest for intermediate reputations. Instead of providing transparency, the regulator’s disclosure policy aims to keep the monitor’s reputation intermediate, even at the cost of diminished incentives. Beneficial schemes feature random delay or noisy information. Schemes that feature verifiable disclosure destroy reputational incentives. The regulator discloses more aggressively when she has better enforcement tools. (JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个监管者对具有声誉顾虑的监督者的披露政策。监督者面对一个经理，经理根据监督者的声誉选择操纵程度。声誉激励在中等声誉时最强。监管者的披露政策并非提供透明度，而是旨在保持监督者的声誉处于中等水平，即使以激励减弱为代价。有益的方案具有随机延迟或噪声信息的特点。具有可验证披露的方案会破坏声誉激励。当监管者拥有更好的执法工具时，她会更积极地进行披露。（JEL D82, D83, G21, G28, G38, M42）

records.title_en: Multihoming and Oligopolistic Platform Competition
records.title_cn: 多归属与寡头平台竞争
records.abstract_en: We provide a general framework to analyze competition between any number of symmetric two-sided transaction platforms, in which buyers and sellers can multihome. We show how key primitives such as the number of platforms, the fraction of buyers that find multihoming costly, the value of transactions, and the degree of user heterogeneity jointly determine the level and structure of platform fees. Even though platform entry always reduces the total fee level, whether it shifts the fee structure in favor of buyers or sellers depends on whether most of the buyers are singlehoming or multihoming. (JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个一般性框架来分析任意数量的对称双边交易平台之间的竞争，其中买家和卖家可以多归属。我们展示了关键初始条件，如平台数量、发现多归属成本高昂的买家比例、交易价值以及用户异质性程度，如何共同决定平台费用的水平和结构。尽管平台进入总是降低总费用水平，但费用结构是偏向买家还是卖家，取决于大多数买家是单归属还是多归属。(JEL D43, L11, L13, L40)

records.title_en: Using Team Discussions to Understand Behavior in Indefinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma Games
records.title_cn: 利用团队讨论理解无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为
records.abstract_en: We compare behavior of two person teams with individuals in indefinitely repeated prisoner dilemma games with perfect monitoring. Team discussions are used to understand the rationale underlying these choices and how these choices come about. There are three main findings: (i) Teams learned to cooperate faster than individuals, and cooperation was more stable for teams. (ii) Strategies identified from team dialogues differ from those identified by the Strategy Frequency Estimation Method. This reflects the improvisational nature of teams’ decision making. (iii) Increasing cooperation was primarily driven by teams unilaterally cooperating in the hope of inducing their opponent to cooperate. (JEL C72, C73, C92)
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了两人团队与个体在具有完美监督的无限重复囚徒困境博弈中的行为。团队讨论被用来理解这些选择背后的理由以及这些选择是如何产生的。有三个主要发现：（i）团队比个体更快学会合作，且团队的合作更为稳定。（ii）从团队对话中识别的策略不同于通过策略频率估计方法识别的策略。这反映了团队决策的即兴性质。（iii）增加的合作主要是由团队单方面合作以期诱导对手合作所驱动的。（JEL C72, C73, C92）

records.title_en: Supervised Machine Learning for Eliciting Individual Demand
records.title_cn: 监督机器学习用于引出个体需求
records.abstract_en: The canonical direct-elicitation approach for measuring individuals’ valuations for goods is the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak procedure, which generates willingness-to-pay (WTP) values that are imprecise and systematically biased. We show that enhancing elicited WTP values with supervised machine learning (SML) can improve estimates of peoples’ out-of-sample purchase behavior. Furthermore, swapping WTP data with choice data generated from a simple task leads to comparable performance. We quantify the benefit of using various SML methods in conjunction with using different types of data. Our results suggest that prices set by SML would increase revenue by 29 percent over using the stated WTP, with the same data. (JEL C45, C91, D12)
records.abstract_cn: 衡量个体对商品价值的经典直接引出方法是Becker-DeGroot-Marschak程序，该方法产生的支付意愿（WTP）值不精确且存在系统性偏差。我们表明，用监督机器学习（SML）增强引出的WTP值可以改进对人们样本外购买行为的估计。此外，用简单任务产生的选择数据替换WTP数据可达到相当的性能。我们量化了使用各种SML方法结合不同类型数据的收益。我们的结果表明，使用相同数据，由SML设定的价格相比使用陈述的WTP将增加收入29%。（JEL C45, C91, D12）

records.title_en: Smaller Slices of a Growing Pie: The Effects of Entry in Platform Markets
records.title_cn: 增长蛋糕中的更小块：平台市场进入的影响
records.abstract_en: Entry of new firms onto a platform has an ambivalent effect on the incumbent firms operating on the platform: the main tension lies between the negative effects of increased competitive pressure and positive indirect network effects. This paper empirically studies the net effect of these countervailing forces and its dependence on firm quality, using a quasi-exogenous shock on a large online platform. On average, market expansion favors incumbents, though the average effect masks substantial heterogeneity: high-quality incumbents experience significant increases in sales and revenue, whereas low-quality firms perform unambiguously worse. Lastly, the paper explores the main mechanisms and firms’ responses. (JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84)
records.abstract_cn: 新企业进入平台对平台上现有企业具有矛盾的影响：主要张力在于竞争压力增加的负面效应与正向间接网络效应之间的权衡。本文利用大型在线平台上的准外生冲击，实证研究了这些相反力量的净效应及其对企业质量的依赖性。平均而言，市场扩张有利于现有企业，但平均效应掩盖了显著的异质性：高质量现有企业的销售额和收入显著增加，而低质量企业则表现明显更差。最后，本文探讨了主要机制和企业的应对策略。（JEL D22, D85, L14, L15, L84）

records.title_en: Monopolistic Competition and Efficiency under Firm Heterogeneity and Nonadditive Preferences
records.title_cn: 企业异质性与非可加偏好下的垄断竞争与效率
records.abstract_en: We consider the single-sector version of the Melitz-Ottaviano model of monopolistic competition with heterogeneous firms. We characterize the first-best and market allocations. We find that the market provides the first-best level of entry but too little selection; hence, the market provides too many varieties and too little aggregate quantity, and allocates too little (much) production to low (high) cost realizations. Allowing for a broad family of quantity allocation functions, we establish sufficient conditions for the global optimality of the first-best solution. Several important extensions are also examined. (JEL D21, D43, D50, D60)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考虑了具有异质性企业的梅利茨-奥塔维亚诺垄断竞争模型的单部门版本。我们刻画了最优和市场竞争配置。我们发现市场提供了最优水平的进入，但选择不足；因此，市场提供了过多的品种和过少的总量，并将过少（过多）的生产分配给低成本（高成本）实现。通过允许广泛的产量分配函数族，我们建立了最优解全局最优性的充分条件。还考察了几个重要的扩展。（JEL D21、D43、D50、D60）

records.title_en: Evaluating the Impact of Online Market Integration—Evidence from the EU Portable PC Market
records.title_cn: 评估在线市场整合的影响——来自欧盟便携式电脑市场的证据
records.abstract_en: We develop a framework to evaluate the impact of market integration, accounting for spillovers between multiple distribution channels. We adapt the standard random coefficients logit demand model to allow for substitution between channels and consumer arbitrage across countries. We apply our framework to the European portable PC market, where geoblocking practices that restrict online cross-border trade have recently been banned. Consumers in high income countries gain most from price convergence, while consumers in other countries may be worse off. The total consumer and welfare gains from online market integration are more modest and mainly due to increased product choice rather than reduced price discrimination. (JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个评估市场整合影响的框架，考虑了多个分销渠道之间的溢出效应。我们调整了标准随机系数logit需求模型，以允许渠道之间的替代和消费者跨国套利。我们将该框架应用于欧洲便携式电脑市场，该市场最近禁止了限制在线跨境贸易的地理封锁做法。高收入国家的消费者从价格趋同中获益最多，而其他国家的消费者可能受损。在线市场整合带来的总消费者和福利收益较为温和，主要归因于产品选择的增加而非价格歧视的减少。(JEL F13, F14, L13, L63, L81)

records.title_en: Slope Takers in Anonymous Markets
records.title_cn: 匿名市场中的斜率接受者
records.abstract_en: We present a learning-based selection argument for Linear Bayesian Nash equilibrium in a Walrasian auction. Endowments vary stochastically; traders model residual supply as linear, estimate its slope from past trade data, and periodically update these estimates. In the standard setting with quadratic preferences, we show that this learning process converges to the unique LBN. Anonymity and statistical learning therefore support this commonly used equilibrium selection rule. (JEL D43, D44, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个基于学习的筛选论证，用于瓦尔拉斯拍卖中的线性贝叶斯纳什均衡。禀赋随机变化；交易者将剩余供给建模为线性的，从过去的交易数据中估计其斜率，并定期更新这些估计。在具有二次偏好的标准设定中，我们证明了这一学习过程收敛于唯一的LBN。因此，匿名性和统计学习支持了这一常用的均衡筛选规则。（JEL D43, D44, D83）

records.title_en: A Model of Sequential Crisis Management
records.title_cn: 序贯危机管理模型
records.abstract_en: We propose a model of how multiple societies respond to a common crisis. A government faces a “damned-either-way” policymaking dilemma: aggressive intervention contains the crisis, but the resulting good outcome makes people skeptical about the costly response; light intervention worsens the crisis and causes the government to be faulted for not doing enough. When multiple societies encounter the crisis sequentially, due to this policymaking dilemma, late societies may underperform despite having more information, while early societies can benefit from a dynamic counterfactual effect. (JEL D72, D82, D83, H12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个关于多个社会如何应对共同危机的模型。政府面临一个“两头不讨好”的政策制定困境：激进的干预能够控制危机，但由此产生的良好结果会让人们对高昂的应对措施持怀疑态度；轻度的干预则会加剧危机，并使政府因做得不够而受到指责。当多个社会依次遭遇危机时，由于这种政策制定困境，后来的社会尽管拥有更多信息，表现却可能不佳，而早期的社会则能从动态反事实效应中受益。（JEL D72, D82, D83, H12）

records.title_en: Trade-ins and Transaction Costs in the Market for Used Business Jets
records.title_cn: 二手公务机市场中的以旧换新与交易成本
records.abstract_en: Manufacturers of durable goods can encourage consumers facing transaction costs to upgrade by accepting used units as trade-ins. These “buyback schemes” increase demand for new units, but increase the supply of used units if trade-ins are resold. I investigate the equilibrium effects of buyback schemes in the market for business jets. I find that buyback increases manufacturer revenue by 7.2 percent at fixed prices. However, in equilibrium this revenue gain is diminished by 43 percent due to substitution away from new jets among first time buyers. I show how the size of this cannibalization effect depends on preference heterogeneity. (JEL D23, G34, L13, L62)
records.abstract_cn: 耐用品制造商可以通过接受旧产品作为以旧换新，来鼓励面临交易成本的消费者升级。这些“回购计划”增加了对新产品的需求，但如果以旧换新的产品被转售，则会增加二手产品的供应。我研究了公务机市场中回购计划的均衡效应。我发现，在固定价格下，以旧换新使制造商收入增加了7.2%。然而，在均衡状态下，由于首次购买者对新飞机的替代效应，这一收入增长被削弱了43%。我展示了这种蚕食效应的大小如何取决于偏好的异质性。（JEL D23, G34, L13, L62）

records.title_en: How Do Institutions of Higher Education Affect Local Invention? Evidence from the Establishment of US Colleges
records.title_cn: 高等教育机构如何影响本地发明？来自美国大学设立的证据
records.abstract_en: I use narrative historical data on site selection decisions for a subset of US colleges to identify runner-up locations that were strongly considered to become the sites of new colleges. Using runner-up counties as counterfactuals in a difference-in-difference model, I find that establishing a college causes 62 percent more patents per year. Linking patents to novel college yearbook data reveals that only 12 percent of patents in a college’s county came from that college’s alumni or faculty. I find only small differences in patenting between establishing colleges and establishing other institutions as well as between colleges with different focuses on technical fields. (JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 我利用美国部分大学选址决策的叙事性历史数据，识别出曾被强烈考虑作为新大学校址的亚军地点。在双重差分模型中使用亚军县作为反事实，我发现设立一所大学每年会使专利数量增加62%。将专利与新颖的大学年鉴数据联系起来，结果显示，在大学所在县的专利中，仅有12%来自该大学的校友或教师。我发现，设立大学与设立其他机构之间，以及侧重技术领域的不同大学之间，在专利产出上仅存在微小差异。(JEL I23, N31, N32, N71, N72, O31, O34)

records.title_en: The Health Impacts of Hospital Delivery Practices
records.title_cn: 医院分娩实践的健康影响
records.abstract_en: Treatment practices vary widely across hospitals, often with little connection to patients’ medical needs. We assess impacts of these differences in delivery practices at childbirth. We find that infants quasi-randomly delivered at hospitals with higher C-section rates are born in better shape and are less likely to be readmitted, with suggestive evidence of improved survival. These benefits are driven by avoidance of prolonged labors that pose risks to infant health. In contrast, these infants are more likely to visit the emergency department for respiratory-related problems, consistent with a large observational literature linking C-section to chronic reductions in respiratory health. (JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 不同医院的治疗实践差异很大，往往与患者的医疗需求关系不大。我们评估了这些分娩实践差异对分娩结果的影响。我们发现，在剖宫产率较高的医院准随机分娩的婴儿出生时状况更好，再入院的可能性更低，并有提示性证据表明生存率有所提高。这些益处源于避免了威胁婴儿健康的产程延长。相比之下，这些婴儿因呼吸相关问题就诊急诊科的可能性更高，这与大量将剖宫产与慢性呼吸健康下降联系起来的观察性文献一致。(JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)

records.title_en: Optimal Income Taxation with Spillovers from Employer Learning
records.title_cn: 雇主学习溢出效应下的最优所得税
records.abstract_en: I study optimal income taxation when human capital investment is imperfectly observable by employers. In the model, Bayesian inference about worker productivity compresses the wage distribution, lowering the private return to human capital investment. An externality arises: given the same information, employers are more optimistic about each individual if workers are generally more productive. The significance of this externality hinges on the accuracy of employers’ beliefs and the responsiveness of human capital. For the United States, taking it into account lowers optimal marginal tax rates for most workers, reducing them by a maximum of 9–13 percentage points between $50,000 and $100,000. (JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了当雇主无法完全观察人力资本投资时的最优所得税。在模型中，关于工人生产率的贝叶斯推断压缩了工资分布，降低了人力资本投资的私人回报。由此产生一种外部性：在信息相同的情况下，如果工人普遍更具生产力，雇主对每个个体的看法会更加乐观。这种外部性的重要性取决于雇主信念的准确性和人力资本的响应性。对于美国而言，考虑到这一点，大多数工人的最优边际税率会降低，在9万至13万美元之间最多降低50000-100000个百分点。（JEL D83, H21, H24, J24, J31, M51, M52）

records.title_en: Pensions and Fertility: Microeconomic Evidence
records.title_cn: 养老金与生育：微观经济证据
records.abstract_en: This study identifies the causal effect of pension generosity on women’s fertility behavior. It capitalizes on Brazil’s expansion of the pension system to rural workers, whose pension wealth subsequently more than tripled. Difference-in-difference, instrumental variable, and event study methods show that the pension reform reduces the propensity of childbearing of women of fertile age by 8 percent in the short run. Completed fertility declines by 1.3 children within 20 years after the reform, reducing the contribution base of the pay-as-you-go long run. The fertility response is strongest at higher birth parities, among older women, and among mothers with sons. (JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究识别了养老金慷慨程度对女性生育行为的因果效应。研究利用巴西将养老金体系扩展至农村劳动者，其养老金财富随后增长超过两倍。双重差分、工具变量和事件研究法表明，养老金改革在短期内使育龄女性生育倾向降低8%。改革后20年内，完成生育率下降1.3个孩子，减少了现收现付制的长期缴费基数。生育反应在较高胎次、年长女性以及有儿子的母亲中最为强烈。(JEL H55, I38, J13, J16, O15)

records.title_en: Profiting from Most-Favored-Customer Procurement Rules: Evidence from Medicaid
records.title_cn: 从最惠顾客采购规则中获利：来自医疗补助的证据
records.abstract_en: Using a difference-in-difference approach, we find that an increase to Medicaid’s minimum drug rebate under the Affordable Care Act in 2010 lowered non-Medicaid drug spending by 2.5 percent. A stylized bargaining model shows that this is likely driven by the interaction of this reform with Medicaid’s “most-favored customer” clause (MFCC). By examining the response of drugs that faced a change in incentives equivalent to the removal of Medicaid’s MFCC, we estimate that removing the Medicaid MFCC would have reduced overall 2010 non-Medicaid drug spending by an additional 3.5 percent, though it would have likely also increased Medicaid spending. (JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65)
records.abstract_cn: 采用双重差分方法，我们发现《平价医疗法案》在2010年提高医疗补助最低药品回扣，使非医疗补助药品支出降低了2.5%。一个程式化的议价模型表明，这很可能由该改革与医疗补助的“最惠顾客”条款（MFCC）的相互作用所驱动。通过考察那些面临等同于取消医疗补助MFCC激励变化的药品的反应，我们估计取消医疗补助MFCC将使2010年非医疗补助药品支出额外减少3.5%，尽管这也可能增加医疗补助支出。（JEL C78, H51, I18, I38, L65）

records.title_en: No Spending without Representation: School Boards and the Racial Gap in Education Finance
records.title_cn: 没有代表就没有支出：学校董事会与教育财政中的种族差距
records.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence that greater minority representation on school boards translates into greater investment in minority students. Focusing on California school boards, I instrument for minority (specifically, Hispanic) representation using random ballot ordering and leverage new data from a statewide capital investment program to capture intradistrict resource allocations. I show that Hispanic board members invest the marginal dollar in high-Hispanic schools within their districts. High-Hispanic schools also exhibit gains in student achievement and decreased teacher turnover. I conclude that enhancing minority representation on school boards could help combat long-standing disparities in education. JEL (H75, I21, I22, I24, J15)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提供了因果证据，表明学校董事会中少数族裔代表性的增加会转化为对少数族裔学生的更多投资。以加利福尼亚州学校董事会为研究对象，我利用随机选票排序作为少数族裔（特别是西班牙裔）代表性的工具变量，并利用全州资本投资计划的新数据来捕捉学区内的资源分配。我表明，西班牙裔董事会成员将边际美元投资于其学区内的西班牙裔高占比学校。西班牙裔高占比学校的学生成绩也有所提高，教师流动率下降。我得出结论，增强学校董事会中的少数族裔代表性有助于解决长期存在的教育差距。JEL（H75，I21，I22，I24，J15）

records.title_en: Does Pay Transparency Affect the Gender Wage Gap? Evidence from Austria
records.title_cn: 薪酬透明度是否影响性别工资差距？来自奥地利的证据
records.abstract_en: We study the 2011 Austrian pay transparency law, which requires firms above a size threshold to publish internal reports on the gender pay gap. Using an event-study design, we show that the policy had no discernible effects on male and female wages, thus leaving the gender wage gap unchanged. The effects are precisely estimated, and we rule out that the policy narrowed the gender wage gap by more than 0.4 p.p.. Moreover, we do not find evidence for wage compression within establishments. We discuss several possible reasons why the reform did not reduce the gender wage gap. (JEL J16, J31, J71, K31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了2011年奥地利的薪酬透明度法律，该法律要求超过规模门槛的企业发布关于性别工资差距的内部报告。使用事件研究设计，我们表明该政策对男性和女性工资没有明显影响，因此性别工资差距保持不变。这些影响被精确估计，我们排除了该政策将性别工资差距缩小超过0.4个百分点的可能性。此外，我们没有发现企业内工资压缩的证据。我们讨论了改革未能缩小性别工资差距的几个可能原因。（JEL J16, J31, J71, K31）

records.title_en: Peer Effects in Police Use of Force
records.title_cn: 警察使用武力中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: We study the link between police officers’ on-duty injuries and their peers’ force use using a network of officers who attended the police academy together through a random lottery. On-duty injuries increase the probability of officers using force by 7 percent in the subsequent week. Officers are also more likely to injure suspects and receive complaints about neglecting victims and violating constitutional rights. The effect is concentrated in a narrow time window following the event and is not associated with significantly lower injury risk to the officer. Together, these findings suggest that emotional responses drive the effects rather than social learning. (JEL H76, J28, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用通过随机抽签共同进入警察学院的警官网络，研究了警官执勤受伤与其同伴使用武力之间的联系。执勤受伤会使警官在随后一周内使用武力的概率增加7%。警官也更有可能伤害嫌疑人，并收到关于忽视受害者和侵犯宪法权利的投诉。这种效应集中在事件发生后的一个狭窄时间窗口内，并且与警官受伤风险的显著降低无关。总之，这些发现表明情绪反应而非社会学习驱动了这些效应。(JEL H76, J28, K42)

records.title_en: Can Forward Commodity Markets Improve Spot Market Performance? Evidence from Wholesale Electricity
records.title_cn: 远期商品市场能否改善现货市场表现？来自批发电力的证据
records.abstract_en: Forward markets are believed to aggregate information about future spot prices and reduce the cost of producing the commodity. We develop a measure of the extent to which forward and spot prices agree in markets with transaction costs. Using this measure, we show that day-ahead prices better reflect real-time prices at all locations in California’s electricity market after the introduction of financial trading. We then present evidence suggesting that operating costs and input fuel use fell after the introduction of financial trading on days when the nonconvexities inherent to the production and transmission of electricity are especially relevant. (JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48)
records.abstract_cn: 远期市场被认为能够聚合关于未来现货价格的信息，并降低商品的生产成本。我们开发了一种衡量在存在交易成本的市场中远期价格与现货价格一致程度的指标。利用该指标，我们表明在引入金融交易后，加州电力市场中日前价格在所有地点更好地反映了实时价格。随后，我们提供的证据表明，在电力生产和传输固有的非凸性尤为相关的日子里，引入金融交易后运营成本和投入燃料使用量有所下降。（JEL D23, D24, G13, L94, L98, Q48）

records.title_en: Borrowing Costs after Sovereign Debt Relief
records.title_cn: 主权债务减免后的借贷成本
records.abstract_en: Can debt moratoria help countries weather negative shocks? We exploit the Debt Service Suspension Initiative (DSSI) to study the bond market effects of deferring official debt repayments. Using daily data on sovereign bond spreads and synthetic control methods, we show that countries eligible for official debt relief experience a larger decline in borrowing costs compared to similar, ineligible countries. This decline is stronger for countries that receive a larger relief, suggesting that the effect works through liquidity provision. By contrast, the results do not support the concern that official debt relief could generate stigma on financial markets. (JEL F34, G12, H63, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 债务暂停能否帮助国家抵御负面冲击？我们利用债务服务暂停倡议（DSSI）来研究推迟官方债务偿还对债券市场的影响。使用主权债券利差的日度数据和合成控制方法，我们表明，与类似的不符合条件国家相比，符合官方债务减免条件的国家借贷成本下降幅度更大。对于获得更大减免的国家，这种下降更为显著，表明该效应通过流动性供给发挥作用。相比之下，结果不支持官方债务减免可能在金融市场上产生污名效应的担忧。（JEL F34, G12, H63, O16）

records.title_en: Ask and You Shall Receive? Gender Differences in Regrades in College
records.title_cn: 有求必应？大学成绩复议中的性别差异
records.abstract_en: Using administrative data from a large public university, we show that male students are 18.6 percent more likely than female students to receive favorable grade changes made by instructors. Surveys of students and instructors reveal that regrade requests are prevalent and that male students are more likely to ask for regrades on the intensive margin. We corroborate the gender differences in regrade requests in an incentivized controlled experiment: we find that males have a higher willingness to pay to ask for regrades. Almost a third of the gender difference is due to gender differences in beliefs and the Big Five traits. (JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 利用一所大型公立大学的行政数据，我们表明，男生获得教师有利成绩更改的可能性比女生高18.6%。对学生和教师的调查显示，成绩复议请求普遍存在，且男生在集约边际上更可能提出复议请求。我们在一个激励性对照实验中证实了复议请求中的性别差异：我们发现，男性为请求复议而支付的意愿更高。性别差异中近三分之一归因于信念和大五人格特质的性别差异。(JEL D82, D91, I23, J16)

records.title_en: Climate Change and Labor Reallocation: Evidence from Six Decades of the Indian Census
records.title_cn: 气候变化与劳动力重新配置：来自印度人口普查六十年的证据
records.abstract_en: How do rising temperatures affect long-term labor reallocation in developing economies? In this paper we examine how increases in temperature impact structural transformation and urbanization within Indian districts between 1951 and 2011. We find that rising temperatures are associated with lower shares of workers in nonagricultural sectors, with effects intensifying over a longer time frame. Supporting evidence suggests that local demand effects play an important role: declining agricultural productivity under higher temperatures reduces the demand for nonagricultural goods and services, which subsequently lowers nonagricultural labor demand. Our results illustrate that rising temperatures limit sectoral and rural-urban mobility for isolated households. (JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 气温上升如何影响发展中经济体的长期劳动力重新配置？在本文中，我们研究了1951年至2011年间气温上升对印度各地区结构转型和城市化的影响。我们发现，气温上升与非农业部门工人占比下降相关，且这种影响在更长的时间范围内加剧。支持性证据表明，地方需求效应发挥着重要作用：高温下农业生产力下降减少了对非农业商品和服务的需求，进而降低了非农业劳动力需求。我们的结果表明，气温上升限制了孤立家庭在部门间和城乡间的流动性。（JEL J61, N35, O13, O15, O18, Q54, R23）

records.title_en: Taxing Billionaires: Estate Taxes and the Geographical Location of the Ultra-Wealthy
records.title_cn: 对亿万富翁征税：遗产税与超级富豪的地理位置
records.abstract_en: We contribute to the literature on the effect of taxes on the locational choices of wealthy individuals by examining the geographical sensitivity of the Forbes 400 richest Americans to state estate taxes. Though we find billionaires’ effective tax rates are only about half the statutory rate, their residential choices are highly sensitive to these taxes, as 35 percent of local billionaires leave states with an estate tax. This tax-induced mobility causes a large reduction in the aggregate tax base. Nonetheless, we find that the revenue benefit of an estate tax exceeds the cost for the vast majority of states. (JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过考察福布斯400位最富有的美国人对州遗产税的地理敏感性，为关于税收对富人区位选择影响的文献做出贡献。尽管我们发现亿万富翁的有效税率仅为法定税率的一半左右，但他们的居住选择对这些税收高度敏感，因为35%的本地亿万富翁会离开征收遗产税的州。这种由税收引起的流动性导致总税基大幅减少。尽管如此，我们发现对于绝大多数州而言，遗产税的收入收益超过了成本。(JEL H24, H31, H71, R23)

records.title_en: Go with the Politician
records.title_cn: 跟随政治家
records.abstract_en: Chinese local leaders are frequently moved across prefectures. By combining local leader rotation data and comprehensive firm land parcel purchase data across prefectures from 2006 to 2016, this paper examines how firm–politician connections affect resource allocation and finds that a firm headquartered in a leader’s previous work prefecture purchases three times more land parcels in that leader’s new governing prefecture than the prefecture-year mean, at half the unit prices. Identification is from within-firm-year variation in various prefectures through exogenous politician rotation. Land usage efficiency is lower for these follower firms’ land parcels. Land allocation distortion is also economically sizable. (JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)
records.abstract_cn: 中国地方领导人经常在各地级市之间调动。通过结合地方领导人轮换数据和2006年至2016年间各地级市的企业土地购置综合数据，本文研究了企业与政治家之间的联系如何影响资源配置，并发现总部位于领导人先前工作地级市的企业，在该领导人新任地级市购买的土地地块数量是地级市年均水平的三倍，而单位价格仅为一半。识别策略来自通过外生政治家轮换引起的同一企业在不同地级市的年内变化。这些追随企业的土地地块的土地利用效率较低。土地配置扭曲在经济规模上也是显著的。(JEL D22, D72, O17, O18, P25, P26)

records.title_en: Externalities in International Tax Enforcement: Theory and Evidence
records.title_cn: 国际税收执法中的外部性：理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We show that the fiscal authorities of high-tax countries can lack the incentives to combat profit shifting to tax havens. Instead, they have incentives to focus their enforcement efforts on relocating profits booked by multinationals in other high-tax countries, crowding out the enforcement on transactions that shift profits to tax havens, and reducing the global tax payments of multinational companies. The predictions of our model are motivated and supported by the analysis of two new datasets: the universe of transfer price corrections conducted by the Danish tax authority, and new cross-country data on international tax enforcement. (JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们表明，高税收国家的财政当局可能缺乏打击利润转移至避税天堂的激励。相反，他们有激励将执法工作重点放在重新定位跨国公司在其他高税收国家入账的利润上，从而挤出了对将利润转移至避税天堂的交易执法，并减少了跨国公司的全球纳税额。我们模型的预测得到了两个新数据集分析的支持和激励：丹麦税务机关进行的转让定价调整全集，以及关于国际税收执法的新的跨国数据。（JEL E62, F23, H25, H26, H87, K34）

records.title_en: Coase and Cap-and-Trade: Evidence on the Independence Property from the European Carbon Market
records.title_cn: 科斯与总量管制与交易：来自欧洲碳市场独立性属性的证据
records.abstract_en: I examine the Coasean independence property in a large multinational cap-and-trade scheme for greenhouse gas emissions, the EU Emissions Trading System. I analyze whether emissions of power producers are independent from allowance allocations by leveraging a change in allocation policy for a difference-in-difference strategy. The evidence suggests that the independence property holds overall and for larger emitters and that firms respond to the loss in allocation by increasing allowance purchases. Suggestive evidence for small emitters indicates that trading costs or behavioral bias distorts their emission decisions. However, their small emission share leaves the independence property intact at the sector level. (JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了科斯独立性属性在一个大型跨国温室气体排放总量管制与交易计划——欧盟排放交易体系中的表现。我通过利用分配政策的变化进行双重差分策略，分析了电力生产者的排放是否独立于配额分配。证据表明，独立性属性总体上成立，对于较大排放者也是如此，并且企业通过增加配额购买来应对分配损失。对小排放者的提示性证据表明，交易成本或行为偏差扭曲了他们的排放决策。然而，他们的排放份额较小，使得独立性属性在部门层面保持不变。(JEL L94, L98, Q48, Q51, Q54, Q58)

records.title_en: Dynamic Privacy Choices
records.title_cn: 动态隐私选择
records.abstract_en: I study a dynamic model of consumer privacy and platform data collection. In each period consumers choose their level of platform activity. Greater activity generates more information about the consumer, thereby increasing platform profits. When the platform can commit to the future privacy policy, it collects information by committing to gradually decreasing the level of privacy protection. In the long run consumers lose privacy and receive low payoffs but choose high activity levels. In contrast, the platform with weaker commitment power may attain the commitment outcome or fail to collect any data depending on consumer expectations regarding future privacy protection. (JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个关于消费者隐私和平台数据收集的动态模型。在每个时期，消费者选择他们的平台活动水平。更多的活动会产生关于消费者的更多信息，从而增加平台利润。当平台能够承诺未来的隐私政策时，它通过承诺逐渐降低隐私保护水平来收集信息。从长远来看，消费者失去隐私并获得低回报，但选择高活动水平。相比之下，承诺能力较弱的平台可能根据消费者对未来隐私保护的预期，达到承诺结果或无法收集任何数据。(JEL C93, D11, D82, D83, D84, L86)

records.title_en: Blind Disclosure
records.title_cn: 盲目披露
records.abstract_en: We develop and test a theory of blind disclosure. A sender chooses whether to disclose information based on a preliminary, private signal. In the unique equilibrium, contrary to the literature’s canonical unraveling result, senders disclose only if their preliminary signal exceeds a cutoff. This cutoff rule leads to partial unraveling in environments with either risk aversion or moral hazard, and disclosure decreases with uncertainty. Using unique administrative data on disclosed and undisclosed grades in a large university, we find that the model is consistent with student choices during spring 2020 to conceal letter grades by switching to optional pass-fail grades. (JEL D81, D82, I23)
records.abstract_cn: 我们开发并检验了一个盲目披露理论。发送者根据初步的私人信号选择是否披露信息。在唯一均衡中，与文献中的经典揭示结果相反，发送者仅在其初步信号超过某个临界值时才会披露。这一临界值规则在存在风险厌恶或道德风险的环境中导致部分揭示，且披露随不确定性增加而减少。利用某大型大学中已披露和未披露成绩的独特行政数据，我们发现该模型与学生在2020年春季通过转换为可选及格-不及格成绩来隐藏字母等级的选择一致。（JEL D81, D82, I23）

records.title_en: Optimal Nonlinear Pricing with Data-Sensitive Consumers
records.title_cn: 数据敏感型消费者的最优非线性定价
records.abstract_en: We study monopolistic screening when some consumers are data sensitive and incur a privacy cost if their purchase reveals information to the monopolist. The monopolist discriminates between data-sensitive and classical consumers using privacy mechanisms that consist of a direct mechanism and a privacy option. A privacy mechanism is optimal for large privacy costs and leaves classical consumers better off than data-sensitive consumers with the same valuation. When privacy preferences become public information, data-sensitive consumers and the monopolist gain, whereas classical consumers lose. Our results are relevant for policies targeting consumers’ data awareness, such as the European General Data Protection Regulation. (JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当部分消费者具有数据敏感性，且其购买行为向垄断者披露信息会带来隐私成本时的垄断者甄别问题。垄断者通过由直接机制和隐私选项组成的隐私机制来区分数据敏感型消费者和传统消费者。对于较大的隐私成本，隐私机制是最优的，并且使得具有相同估值的传统消费者比数据敏感型消费者获得更高的效用。当隐私偏好成为公开信息时，数据敏感型消费者和垄断者获益，而传统消费者受损。我们的研究结果对针对消费者数据意识的政策具有相关性，例如欧洲通用数据保护条例。（JEL D11, D42, D82, D83, L12）

records.title_en: Competition in Pricing Algorithms
records.title_cn: 定价算法中的竞争
records.abstract_en: We document new facts about pricing technology using high-frequency data, and we examine the implications for competition. Some online retailers employ technology that allows for more frequent price changes and automated responses to price changes by rivals. Motivated by these facts, we consider a model in which firms can differ in pricing frequency and choose pricing algorithms that are a function of rivals’ prices. In competitive (Markov perfect) equilibrium, the introduction of simple pricing algorithms can increase price levels, generate price dispersion, and exacerbate the price effects of mergers. (JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用高频数据记录了关于定价技术的新事实，并考察了其对竞争的影响。一些在线零售商采用的技术允许更频繁的价格变动以及对竞争对手价格变动的自动响应。受这些事实的启发，我们考虑了一个模型，其中企业可以在定价频率上有所不同，并选择作为竞争对手价格函数的定价算法。在竞争性（马尔可夫完美）均衡中，简单定价算法的引入可以提高价格水平，产生价格离散，并加剧合并的价格效应。（JEL D21, D22, D43, G34, L13, L81）

records.title_en: Targeted Product Design
records.title_cn: 目标产品设计
records.abstract_en: We propose an intuitive representation of product design in which firms locate inside a circle and consumers in its outer circumference. Designs trade off horizontal and vertical transport costs. Our setting encompasses all linear demand rotations.
