Firms with lower quality or higher marginal costs choose niche designs that cater to specific consumers at the expense of alienating the rest. Firms choose intermediate designs or more polarized ones, instead, depending on the convexity of the vertical transport cost. We examine such design choices in monopoly, duopoly, and monopolistic competition settings. (JEL D21, D24, D42, D43)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种直观的产品设计表示，其中企业位于圆内，消费者位于圆周上。设计在水平与垂直运输成本之间进行权衡。我们的设定涵盖了所有线性需求旋转。质量较低或边际成本较高的企业选择利基设计，以迎合特定消费者，但代价是疏远其他消费者。相反，企业选择中间设计或更两极化的设计，这取决于垂直运输成本的凸性。我们考察了垄断、双头垄断和垄断竞争环境中的此类设计选择。（JEL D21, D24, D42, D43）

records.title_en: The Good, the Bad, and the Complex: Product Design with Imperfect Information
records.title_cn: 好、坏与复杂：不完全信息下的产品设计
records.abstract_en: We study the joint determination of product quality and complexity. In our model complexity affects how difficult it is for an agent to acquire information about product quality. An agent can accept or reject a product proposed by a designer, who can affect the quality and the complexity of the product. We find that complexity is not a necessary feature of low-quality products. An increase in designer–agent alignment leads to more complex but better-quality products. However, higher product demand or lower competition among designers leads to more complex and lower-quality products. We relate our findings to the existing empirical evidence. (JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了产品质量与复杂性的联合决定。在我们的模型中，复杂性影响代理人获取产品质量信息的难度。代理人可以接受或拒绝设计师提出的产品，而设计师可以影响产品的质量和复杂性。我们发现，复杂性并非低质量产品的必要特征。设计师与代理人之间一致性的增加会导致产品更复杂但质量更高。然而，更高的产品需求或设计师之间更低的竞争会导致产品更复杂且质量更低。我们将我们的发现与现有的经验证据联系起来。（JEL D82, D83, G23, L15, L51, L84）

records.title_en: Ad Clutter, Time Use, and Media Diversity
records.title_cn: 广告拥挤、时间使用与媒体多样性
records.abstract_en: We introduce advertising congestion along with a time use model of consumer choice among media. Both consumers and advertisers multihome. Higher equilibrium advertising levels ensue on less popular media platforms because platforms treat consumer attention as a common property resource: smaller platforms internalize less of the congestion from advertising and so advertise more. Platform entry raises the ad nuisance price to consumers and diminishes the quality of the consumption experience on all platforms. For consumer welfare this price effect of entry dominates the positive effect of more variety in some settings; thus, consumers will then be worse off after entry. (JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 我们引入广告拥挤以及消费者在媒体间选择的时间使用模型。消费者和广告商都进行多归属。均衡广告水平在较不流行的媒体平台上更高，因为平台将消费者注意力视为公共财产资源：较小的平台较少内化广告带来的拥挤，因此广告更多。平台进入提高了消费者的广告滋扰价格，并降低了所有平台上消费体验的质量。对于消费者福利而言，在某些情况下，这种进入的价格效应超过了更多多样性的积极效应；因此，进入后消费者的境况可能会变差。（JEL D11, D43, L13, L82, M37）

records.title_en: Reference Dependence and Attribution Bias: Evidence from Real-Effort Experiments
records.title_cn: 参考依赖与归因偏差：来自真实努力实验的证据
records.abstract_en: We document a form of attribution bias wherein people wrongly ascribe sensations of positive or negative surprise to the underlying disutility of a real-effort task. Participants in our experiments learned from experience about two unfamiliar tasks, one more onerous than the other. We manipulated expectations about which task they would face: some participants were assigned their task by chance, while others knew their assignment in advance. Hours later, we elicited willingness to work again on that same task. Participants assigned the less (more) onerous task by chance were more (less) willing to work than those who knew their assignment in advance. (JEL C91, D84, D91, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了一种归因偏差形式，即人们错误地将积极或消极惊喜的感受归因于真实努力任务的基本负效用。在我们的实验中，参与者通过经验了解了两个不熟悉的任务，其中一个比另一个更繁重。我们操纵了他们对将要面对哪个任务的预期：一些参与者通过随机方式被分配任务，而另一些则提前知道他们的分配。数小时后，我们引出了他们再次从事同一任务的意愿。通过随机方式被分配到较不（更）繁重任务的参与者比那些提前知道分配的人更（不）愿意工作。（JEL C91, D84, D91, M54）

records.title_en: The Doors of Perception: Theory and Evidence of Frame-Dependent Rationalizability
records.title_cn: 知觉之门：框架依赖理性化的理论与证据
records.abstract_en: We investigate how strategic behavior is affected by the set of notions (frames) used when thinking about the game. In our games the action set consists of visual objects: each player must privately choose one, trying to match the counterpart’s choice. We propose a model where different player-types are aware of different attributes of the action set (hence, different frames). One of the novelties is an epistemic structure that allows players to think about new frames, after initial unawareness of some attributes. To test the model, our experimental design brings about multiple frames by varying subjects’ awareness of several attributes. (JEL C72, C78, C91, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在思考博弈时所使用的概念集（框架）如何影响策略行为。在我们的博弈中，行动集由视觉对象组成：每个参与者必须私下选择一个，试图与对手的选择相匹配。我们提出了一个模型，其中不同的参与者类型意识到行动集的不同属性（因此，有不同的框架）。新颖之处之一是一种认知结构，允许参与者在最初对某些属性无意识之后，思考新的框架。为了检验该模型，我们的实验设计通过改变参与者对几个属性的意识来产生多个框架。（JEL C72, C78, C91, D83）

records.title_en: Reference Pricing as a Deterrent to Entry: Evidence from the European Pharmaceutical Market
records.title_cn: 参考定价作为进入威慑：来自欧洲药品市场的证据
records.abstract_en: External reference pricing (ERP), the practice of benchmarking domestic drug prices to foreign prices, generates an incentive for firms to withhold products from low-income countries. Using a novel moment inequality approach, we estimate a structural model to measure how ERP policies affect access to innovative drugs across Europe. We find that ERP increases entry delays in eight low-income European countries by up to one year per drug. The European Union could remove these delays without replacing ERP by compensating firms through lump-sum transfers at the cost of around €18 million per drug. (JEL L13, L51, L65)
records.abstract_cn: 外部参考定价（ERP），即根据国外价格设定国内药品价格的基准做法，会产生企业向低收入国家扣留产品的激励。我们使用一种新颖的矩不等式方法，估计了一个结构模型，以衡量ERP政策如何影响欧洲创新药物的可及性。我们发现，ERP使八个低收入欧洲国家的药品进入延迟每药最多增加一年。欧盟可以通过一次性转移支付补偿企业，以每药约18百万欧元的成本消除这些延迟，而无需替换ERP。（JEL L13, L51, L65）

records.title_en: Complexity and Procedural Choice
records.title_cn: 复杂性与程序选择
records.abstract_en: We test the core ideas of the “automata” approach to bounded rationality, using simple experimental bandit tasks. Optimality requires subjects to use a moderately complex decision procedure, but most subjects in our baseline condition instead use simpler (often suboptimal) procedures that economize on “states” in the algorithmic structure of the rule. When we artificially remove the mental costs of tracking states by having the computer track and organize past events, subjects abandon these simpler rules and use maximally complex optimal rules instead. The results thus suggest that the main type of complexity described in the automata literature fundamentally influences behavior. (JEL C91, D12, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用简单的实验性老虎机任务，检验了“自动机”方法对有限理性的核心思想。最优性要求受试者使用中等复杂度的决策程序，但我们在基线条件下的多数受试者反而使用更简单（通常次优）的程序，这些程序在规则的算法结构中节省了“状态”。当我们通过让计算机跟踪和组织过去的事件来人为地消除跟踪状态的心理成本时，受试者放弃了这些更简单的规则，转而使用最大复杂度的最优规则。因此，结果表明，自动机文献中描述的主要复杂性类型从根本上影响了行为。（JEL C91, D12, D91）

records.title_en: Biased Beliefs in Search Markets
records.title_cn: 搜索市场中的有偏信念
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of biased consumer beliefs for search market outcomes in the seminal framework due to Diamond (1971). Biased consumers base their search strategy on a belief function that specifies for any (true) distribution of utility offers in the market a possibly incorrect distribution of utility offers. If biased consumers overestimate the best offer in the market, a novel type of equilibrium may emerge in which firms make exceptionally favorable offers in order to meet biased consumers’ unreasonably high expectations, which then become partially self-fulfilling. Consequently, the presence of biased consumers may improve the welfare of all consumers. (JEL D11, D21, D83, D84)
records.abstract_cn: 我们在Diamond（1971）的开创性框架中研究消费者有偏信念对搜索市场结果的影响。有偏消费者基于一个信念函数来制定其搜索策略，该信念函数针对市场中效用报价的任何（真实）分布，指定一个可能不正确的效用报价分布。如果有偏消费者高估了市场中的最优报价，可能会出现一种新型均衡，在这种均衡中，企业提供异常优惠的报价以满足有偏消费者不切实际的高期望，这些期望随后部分地自我实现。因此，有偏消费者的存在可能改善所有消费者的福利。（JEL D11, D21, D83, D84）

records.title_en: At the Helm, Kirk or Spock? The Pros and Cons of Charismatic Leadership
records.title_cn: 掌舵者，柯克还是斯波克？魅力型领导的利与弊
records.abstract_en: Charismatic leaders are often desired. At the same time, experience, especially with demagogues, as well as social science studies, raise doubts about such leaders. This paper offers explanations for charismatic leadership’s “mixed report card.” It offers insights into why and when charismatic leadership can be effective; which, when, and why certain groups will prefer more to less charismatic leaders; and how being more charismatic can make leaders worse in other dimensions, particularly causing them to work less hard on their followers’ behalf. (JEL D72, D83, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 魅力型领导往往备受追捧。与此同时，经验（尤其是与煽动家打交道的经验）以及社会科学研究，却对这种领导提出质疑。本文为魅力型领导的“好坏参半的成绩单”提供了解释。文中探讨了魅力型领导为何以及何时能够有效；哪些群体、在何种情况下以及为何会偏好魅力程度更高而非更低的领导；以及更具魅力如何可能使领导在其他方面表现更差，尤其是导致他们不再那么努力地为追随者谋福利。（JEL D72, D83, M54）

records.title_en: Too Good to Be True? Retention Rules for Noisy Agents
records.title_cn: 好得令人难以置信？对噪声代理人的留任规则
records.abstract_en: An agent who privately knows his type seeks to be retained by a principal. Agents signal their type with some ambient noise, but can alter this noise, perhaps at some cost. Our main finding is that in equilibrium, the principal treats extreme signals in either direction with suspicion, and retains the agent if and only if the signal falls in some intermediate bounded set. In short, she follows the maxim: “if it seems too good to be true, it probably is.” We consider extensions and applications, including non-normal signal structures, dynamics with term limits, risky portfolio management, and political risk-taking. (JEL D72, D82, G11, G41)
records.abstract_cn: 一个私下知晓自己类型的代理人寻求被委托人留任。代理人通过一些环境噪声来传递其类型信号，但可以改变这种噪声，或许需要付出一定成本。我们的主要发现是，在均衡中，委托人对任一方向的极端信号持怀疑态度，并且仅当信号落在某个中间有界集合内时才留任代理人。简言之，她遵循这样的准则：“如果某事好得令人难以置信，那它很可能就是假的。”我们考虑了扩展和应用，包括非正态信号结构、有任期限制的动态、风险投资组合管理以及政治风险承担。（JEL D72, D82, G11, G41）

records.title_en: Learning by Choosing: Career Concerns with Observable Actions
records.title_cn: 选择中学习：可观察行动下的职业关注
records.abstract_en: This paper explores potential inefficiencies of incomplete contracts in a dynamic career concerns context. In a firm-worker relationship, the worker performs public tasks that have trade-offs between productivity and informativeness. We show that the first-best outcome can be obtained with short-term contracts if the wage can depend on the task choice. This provides an explanation for wage jumps at promotions—the worker is assigned the more productive but less informative task after promotion. If task choice is not contractible, then inefficiency arises: the worker has an endogenous bias toward informativeness, while the firm is biased toward productivity. (JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了动态职业关注背景下不完全契约的潜在低效率。在企业与工人的关系中，工人执行公共任务，这些任务在生产率和信息量之间存在权衡。我们表明，如果工资可以依赖于任务选择，那么短期契约可以实现最优结果。这为晋升时的工资跃升提供了一种解释——晋升后，工人被分配到生产率更高但信息量更少的任务。如果任务选择不可契约化，则会出现低效率：工人对信息量存在内生偏好，而企业则偏向于生产率。（JEL D82, D83, D86, J24, J31, M51）

records.title_en: Relative Wealth Concerns, Executive Compensation, and Managerial Risk-Taking
records.title_cn: 相对财富关注、高管薪酬与管理层风险承担
records.abstract_en: This paper theoretically examines how relative wealth concerns affect equilibrium contracting and systemic risk-taking. We find that such externalities can generate pay for luck as an equilibrium strategy. In expectation of pay for luck in other firms, tying managerial pay to luck provides insurance to managers against a compensation shortfall relative to executive peers. We also show that an effort-inducing mechanism exists: managers have additional incentives to exert effort in utilizing investment opportunities, which helps them keep up with their peers during industry movements; however, pay for luck that is efficient within firms can nonetheless exacerbate aggregate fluctuations, especially during periods of heightened market risk. (JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 本文从理论上考察了相对财富关注如何影响均衡契约和系统性风险承担。我们发现，这种外部性可以产生为运气付费作为均衡策略。预期到其他公司存在为运气付费，将管理层薪酬与运气挂钩为管理者提供了相对于同行高管薪酬缺口的保险。我们还表明，存在一种努力激励机制：管理者在利用投资机会方面有额外的努力激励，这有助于他们在行业变动中跟上同行；然而，公司内部有效的为运气付费却可能加剧总体波动，尤其是在市场风险加剧时期。（JEL D81, D82, D86, G51, M12, M52）

records.title_en: Raising the Bar: Certification Thresholds and Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 提高门槛：认证阈值与市场结果
records.abstract_en: Certification of sellers by trusted third parties helps alleviate information asymmetries in markets, yet little is known about the impact of a certification’s threshold on market outcomes. Exploiting a policy change on eBay, we study how a more selective certification threshold affects the distribution of quality and incumbent behavior. We develop a stylized model that shows how changes in selectivity change the distribution of quality and prices in markets. Using rich data from hundreds of online categories on eBay.com , we find support for the model’s hypotheses. Our results help inform the design of certification selectivity in electronic and other markets. (JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 由可信第三方对卖家进行认证有助于缓解市场中的信息不对称，然而关于认证阈值对市场结果的影响却知之甚少。利用eBay上的一项政策变化，我们研究了更具选择性的认证阈值如何影响质量分布和现有卖家行为。我们构建了一个简化模型，展示了选择性变化如何改变市场中的质量分布和价格。利用来自eBay.com上数百个在线类别的丰富数据，我们找到了支持模型假设的证据。我们的结果有助于为电子市场及其他市场的认证选择性设计提供信息。(JEL D82, L11, L15, L86)

records.title_en: Stable and Efficient Resource Allocation with Contracts
records.title_cn: 契约下的稳定与高效资源分配
records.abstract_en: Consider indivisible-object allocation with contracts, such as college admissions, where contracts specify majors. Can a designer guarantee a stable and (student) efficient matching? I show that contracts put stability and efficiency at odds; a necessary condition to ensure these properties is student-lexicographic priorities—schools must rank contracts from “second-tier” students consecutively. I present the weakest restriction guaranteeing stability and efficiency, and characterize necessary and sufficient conditions for any mechanism within a general class to deliver a stable and efficient matching in an incentive compatible manner. I apply this result to two well-known mechanisms: deferred acceptance and top trading cycles. (JEL C78, D82, D86, I23)
records.abstract_cn: 考虑不可分割物品与契约的分配问题，例如大学录取，其中契约指定专业。设计者能否保证稳定且（学生）高效的匹配？我表明契约使稳定性与效率相互冲突；确保这些性质的必要条件是学生字典序优先级——学校必须将来自“二流”学生的契约连续排序。我提出了保证稳定性与效率的最弱限制，并刻画了一般类机制中任何机制以激励相容方式提供稳定且高效匹配的充分必要条件。我将此结果应用于两个著名机制：延迟接受和顶层交易循环。（JEL C78, D82, D86, I23）

records.title_en: Optimal Task Scheduling under Adverse Selection and Hidden Actions
records.title_cn: 逆向选择与隐藏行动下的最优任务调度
records.abstract_en: A Principal owns a project consisting of several tasks. Tasks differ, both in their innate success probabilities and their incremental benefits. Moreover, only specialists can perform these tasks. Subject to moral hazard and adverse selection, in what order should the Principal commission the tasks, and when should she terminate the project? What investments into changing tasks’ characteristics yield the highest marginal profit? These are typical issues that arise in sequencing R&D activities and other sequential production processes. We show that, despite informational constraints, a simple index—a task’s effective marginal contribution—determines the optimal schedule/mechanism. (JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31)
records.abstract_cn: 委托人拥有一个由若干任务组成的项目。任务在固有成功概率和增量收益方面各不相同。此外，只有专家才能执行这些任务。在道德风险和逆向选择的约束下，委托人应按照什么顺序委托任务，以及何时终止项目？对改变任务特征的投资中，哪些能产生最高的边际利润？这些是排序研发活动和其他顺序生产过程中出现的典型问题。我们表明，尽管存在信息约束，一个简单的指标——任务的有效边际贡献——决定了最优调度/机制。（JEL D82, L23, L24, L65, M11, O31）

records.title_en: Markets with Within-Type Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 具有类型内逆向选择的市场
records.abstract_en: We study bilateral trade with a seller owning multiple units of a good, where each unit is of binary quality. The seller privately knows her “type”—defined by the number of lemons that she owns—and which units in her endowments are the lemons (“ within-type adverse selection”). We characterize the set of informationally constrained Pareto optimal allocations and show that every such allocation must involve a trade characterized by a threshold λ ∗ , with types having less (more) than λ ∗ units of lemons selling only their lemons (selling their entire endowment). We provide conditions for a distribution shift that give Pareto-improving allocations. (JEL D82, D86, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一个卖方拥有多单位商品的双边贸易，其中每个单位具有二元质量。卖方私下知道她的“类型”——由她拥有的次品数量定义——以及在她的禀赋中哪些单位是次品（“类型内逆向选择”）。我们刻画了信息约束下帕累托最优配置的集合，并表明每个这样的配置必须涉及以阈值 λ ∗ 为特征的贸易，其中拥有少于（多于）λ ∗ 个次品的类型仅出售其次品（出售其全部禀赋）。我们提供了分布变化的条件，这些条件给出帕累托改进的配置。（JEL D82, D86, L15）

records.title_en: Estimating the Optimal Inflation Target from Trends in Relative Prices
records.title_cn: 从相对价格趋势估计最优通胀目标
records.abstract_en: We derive closed-form expressions for the optimal inflation target under Calvo and menu-cost frictions in a model featuring a product life cycle and multiple sources of heterogeneity across goods. We show that both frictions deliver the same optimal target and how it can be estimated from observed trends in relative prices. Using micro price data underlying the CPI in the United Kingdom, we document that relative prices fall over the product lifetime in most expenditure items. This causes the optimal inflation target to be positive, with our baseline estimate for the United Kingdom being equal to 2.6 percent in 2016. The optimal target has steadily increased over the prior two decades due to an acceleration in the rates of relative price decline over time. (JEL C51, D15, E31, L11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们在一个具有产品生命周期和商品间多种异质性来源的模型中，推导了Calvo摩擦和菜单成本摩擦下最优通胀目标的闭式表达式。我们表明，这两种摩擦产生相同的最优目标，并说明如何从观察到的相对价格趋势中估计该目标。利用英国CPI背后的微观价格数据，我们记录了大多数支出项目中相对价格在产品生命周期内下降的情况。这导致最优通胀目标为正，我们对英国的基线估计在2016年等于2.6%。由于相对价格下降率随时间加速，最优目标在过去二十年中稳步上升。(JEL C51, D15, E31, L11)

records.title_en: Measuring the Cost of Living in Mexico and the United States
records.title_cn: 衡量墨西哥和美国的生活成本
records.abstract_en: We use a dataset with prices and spending on consumer packaged goods matched at the bar code level across the United States and Mexico to measure the price index in Mexico relative to the United States. Mexican prices relative to the United States are 23 percent lower compared to the International Comparisons Project’s (ICP) price index. We decompose the 23 percent gap into the biases from imputation, sampling, quality, and variety. Quality bias increases Mexican prices by 48 percent. Imputation, sampling, and variety bias lowers Mexican prices by 11 percent, 13 percent, and 33 percent, respectively. (JEL C43, E31, I31, O11, O12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个在条形码级别上匹配美国和墨西哥的消费品价格和支出数据集，来衡量墨西哥相对于美国的价格指数。与国际比较项目（ICP）的价格指数相比，墨西哥相对于美国的价格低23%。我们将这23%的差距分解为插补、抽样、质量和品种的偏差。质量偏差使墨西哥价格提高48%。插补、抽样和品种偏差分别使墨西哥价格降低11%、13%和33%。（JEL C43, E31, I31, O11, O12）

records.title_en: Macroeconomic Implications of Uniform Pricing
records.title_cn: 统一定价的宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: We compile a new database of grocery prices in Argentina. We find uniform pricing both within and across regions—i.e., prices almost do not vary within the stores of a chain. In line with uniform pricing, prices in stores of chains operating in one region react to changes in regional employment while prices in multiregion chains do not. Using a quantitative regional model with multiregion firms and uniform pricing, we find a one-half smaller elasticity of prices to a regional than an aggregate shock. This result highlights that some caution may be necessary when using regional shocks to estimate aggregate elasticities. (JEL D22, L11, L81, O14, O18, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们编制了一个阿根廷杂货价格的新数据库。我们发现，无论是在区域内还是跨区域，价格都是统一的——即，同一连锁店内的价格几乎没有差异。与统一定价一致，在单一区域经营的连锁店的价格会对区域就业变化作出反应，而跨区域连锁店的价格则不会。利用一个包含跨区域企业和统一定价的定量区域模型，我们发现价格对区域冲击的弹性是对总体冲击弹性的一半。这一结果强调，在使用区域冲击来估计总体弹性时可能需要谨慎。(JEL D22, L11, L81, O14, O18, R32)

records.title_en: How Does Consumption Respond to News about Inflation? Field Evidence from a Randomized Control Trial
records.title_cn: 消费如何响应通胀新闻？来自随机对照试验的实地证据
records.abstract_en: We implement a survey of Dutch households in which random subsets of respondents receive information about inflation. The resulting exogenously generated variation in inflation expectations is used to assess how expectations affect consumption decisions. The causal effects of reduced inflation expectations on nondurable spending are imprecisely estimated, but there is a sharp positive effect on durable spending. This is likely driven by the fact that Dutch households seem to become more optimistic about their real income and aggregate spending when they decrease their inflation expectations. We find little role for cognitive or financial constraints in explaining spending responses. (JEL C83, D12, D83, D84, E21, E31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们对荷兰家庭进行了一项调查，其中随机抽取的受访者子集收到有关通胀的信息。由此产生的外生性通胀预期变化被用来评估预期如何影响消费决策。降低通胀预期对非耐用品支出的因果效应估计不精确，但对耐用品支出有显著的正向影响。这很可能是因为荷兰家庭在降低通胀预期时，对其实际收入和总支出变得更加乐观。我们发现认知或金融约束在解释支出反应方面的作用很小。(JEL C83, D12, D83, D84, E21, E31)

records.title_en: Efficient Consolidation of Incentives for Education and Retirement Savings
records.title_cn: 教育与退休储蓄激励的有效整合
records.abstract_en: We study optimal tax policies with human capital investment and retirement savings for present-biased agents. Agents are heterogeneous in their innate ability and make risky education investments, which determines their labor productivity. We demonstrate that the optimal distortions vary with education status. In particular, the optimal policy encourages human capital investment with savings incentives. Our implementation uses income-contingent student loans and existing retirement policies, augmented by a new tax instrument that subsidizes retirement savings for college graduates. The instrument mimics the latest policy proposals by allowing employers to offer 401(k) matching contributions proportional to student loans repayment. (JEL G51, H21, H24, I26, J24, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了针对现时偏差代理人的最优税收政策，其中涉及人力资本投资和退休储蓄。代理人先天能力各异，并进行有风险的教育投资，这决定了他们的劳动生产率。我们证明，最优扭曲随教育状况而变化。特别是，最优政策通过储蓄激励鼓励人力资本投资。我们的实施方案采用收入或有学生贷款和现有退休政策，并辅以一项新的税收工具，该工具为大学毕业生提供退休储蓄补贴。该工具模仿了最新的政策建议，允许雇主提供与学生贷款偿还成比例的401(k)匹配缴款。(JEL G51, H21, H24, I26, J24, J26)

records.title_en: Human Capital Accumulation at Work: Estimates for the World and Implications for Development
records.title_cn: 工作中的人力资本积累：全球估计及其对发展的启示
records.abstract_en: We (i) study wage-experience profiles and obtain measures of returns to potential work experience using data from about 24 million individuals in 1,084 surveys and census samples across 145 countries; (ii) show that workers in developed countries accumulate twice as much human capital at work as those in developing countries; (iii) use a simple accounting framework to find that the contribution of work experience and education to human capital accumulation and economic development might be equally important; and (iv) employ panel regressions to investigate how changes in the returns over time correlate with several factors such as economic recessions, transitions, and human capital stocks. (JEL D12, I25, I26, J24, J31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们（i）利用来自24个国家约1084万人的145项调查和人口普查样本数据，研究工资-经验曲线并获得潜在工作经验回报的度量；（ii）表明发达国家工人在工作中积累的人力资本是发展中国家的两倍；（iii）使用一个简单的核算框架发现，工作经验与教育对人力资本积累和经济发展的贡献可能同等重要；（iv）采用面板回归来研究回报随时间的变化如何与经济衰退、转型和人力资本存量等因素相关。（JEL D12, I25, I26, J24, J31, O15）

records.title_en: The Rise of Niche Consumption
records.title_cn: 小众消费的兴起
records.abstract_en: Over the last 15 years, individual households have concentrated their spending on a few preferred products. However, this is not driven by “superstar” products capturing larger market shares. Instead, households increasingly purchase different products from each other. As a result, aggregate spending concentration has decreased. We develop a model of heterogeneous household demand and use it to conclude that increasing product variety drives these divergent trends. When more products are available, households select products better matched to their tastes. This delivers welfare gains from selection equal to about half a percent per year in the categories covered by our data. (JEL D12, D91, E21, L66)
records.abstract_cn: 在过去15年中，个体家庭将支出集中在少数偏好的产品上。然而，这并非由“超级明星”产品占据更大市场份额所驱动。相反，家庭之间购买的产品日益不同。因此，总体支出集中度有所下降。我们开发了一个异质性家庭需求模型，并利用该模型得出结论：产品多样性的增加推动了这些分化趋势。当更多产品可用时，家庭会选择更符合其品味的产品。这带来的选择福利收益在我们数据覆盖的类别中每年约为半个百分点。（JEL D12, D91, E21, L66）

records.title_en: The Macroeconomic Impact of Europe’s Carbon Taxes
records.title_cn: 欧洲碳税的宏观经济影响
records.abstract_en: We estimate the macroeconomic impacts of carbon taxes on GDP and employment growth rates using 30 years of data on carbon taxation in various European countries. We find no evidence for a negative impact on employment or GDP growth but rather find a zero to modest positive impact. We also find a cumulative emissions reduction on the order of 4 to 6 percent for a $40/ton CO 2 tax covering 30 percent of emissions. Reductions would likely be greater for a broad-based US carbon tax since European carbon taxes typically do not cover those sectors with the lowest marginal abatement costs. (JEL E23, E24, H23, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用欧洲各国30年的碳税数据估算了碳税对 GDP 和就业增长率的宏观经济影响。我们没有发现任何证据表明对就业或 GDP 增长有负面影响，而是发现了零到适度的积极影响。我们还发现，对于覆盖 30% 排放量的 40 美元/吨二氧化碳 2 税，累积排放量减少量约为 4 至 6%。对于基础广泛的美国碳税来说，削减幅度可能更大，因为欧洲碳税通常不涵盖边际减排成本最低的部门。 （JEL E23、E24、H23、Q54、Q58）

records.title_en: The Causal Effects of Lockdown Policies on Health and Macroeconomic Outcomes
records.title_cn: 封锁政策对健康和宏观经济结果的因果效应
records.abstract_en: We assess the causal impact of pandemic-induced lockdowns on health and macroeconomic outcomes and measure the trade-off between containing the spread of a pandemic and economic activity. To do so, we estimate an epidemiological model with time-varying parameters and use its output as information for estimating SVARs and LPs that quantify the causal effects of nonpharmaceutical policy interventions. We apply our approach to Belgian data for the COVID-19 pandemic during 2020. We find that additional government-mandated mobility curtailments would have reduced deaths at a very small cost in terms of GDP. (JEL E23, H51, I12, I15, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 我们评估了疫情引发的封锁对健康和宏观经济结果的因果影响，并衡量了遏制疫情传播与经济活动之间的权衡。为此，我们估计了一个具有时变参数的流行病学模型，并将其输出作为估计SVAR和LP的信息，以量化非药物政策干预的因果效应。我们将该方法应用于比利时2020年COVID-19大流行的数据。我们发现，额外的政府强制出行限制将以非常小的GDP成本减少死亡人数。(JEL E23, H51, I12, I15, I18)

records.title_en: The Intensive Margin in Trade: How Big and How Important?
records.title_cn: 贸易中的集约边际：有多大，有多重要？
records.abstract_en: In benchmark trade models that feature a constant trade elasticity, bilateral exports vary entirely on the intensive margin (exports per firm) or entirely on the extensive margin (number of firms). Our empirical analysis documents that roughly one-half of this variation occurs along each margin, implying that the trade elasticity is not constant. We estimate a generalized Melitz model with a joint log-normal distribution for firm productivity, fixed costs, and demand shifters. Using exact-hat algebra, we quantify how trade costs affect trade flows and welfare. Welfare effects are similar to those in the Melitz-Pareto model, but implied trade flows differ significantly. (JEL D22, D24, D43, F12, F14, L13)
records.abstract_cn: 在具有恒定贸易弹性的基准贸易模型中，双边出口完全在集约边际（每家企业出口额）或完全在扩展边际（企业数量）上变化。我们的实证分析表明，这种变化大约有一半发生在每个边际上，这意味着贸易弹性不是恒定的。我们估计了一个广义的Melitz模型，其中企业生产率、固定成本和需求转移因子服从联合对数正态分布。使用精确帽子代数，我们量化了贸易成本如何影响贸易流量和福利。福利效应与Melitz-Pareto模型中的相似，但隐含的贸易流量显著不同。（JEL D22, D24, D43, F12, F14, L13）

records.title_en: Has the Information Channel of Monetary Policy Disappeared? Revisiting the Empirical Evidence
records.title_cn: 货币政策的信息渠道是否已经消失？重新审视经验证据
records.abstract_en: Does the Federal Reserve have an “information advantage” in forecasting macroeconomic variables beyond what is known to private sector forecasters? And are market participants reacting only to monetary policy shocks or also to information on the future state of the economy that the Federal Reserve communicates in its announcements via an “information channel”? This paper investigates the evolution of both the information advantage and the information channel over time. Although they appear to be important historically, we find substantially weaker empirical evidence of their presence in recent years once instabilities are accounted for. (JEL C53, E32, E37, E47, E52, E58)
records.abstract_cn: 美联储在预测宏观经济变量方面是否拥有超出私营部门预测者已知信息的“信息优势”？市场参与者是否仅仅对货币政策冲击做出反应，还是也对美联储通过“信息渠道”在其公告中传达的未来经济状况信息做出反应？本文研究了信息优势和信息渠道随时间的演变。尽管它们在历史上似乎很重要，但我们发现，在考虑不稳定性之后，近年来它们存在的经验证据明显减弱。（JEL C53, E32, E37, E47, E52, E58）

records.title_en: Labor Market Responses to Unemployment Insurance: The Role of Heterogeneity
records.title_cn: 劳动力市场对失业保险的反应：异质性的作用
records.abstract_en: We document considerable scope of heterogeneity within the unemployed, especially when they are divided along eligibility for and receipt of unemployment insurance (UI). We study the implications of this heterogeneity on UI’s insurance-incentive trade-off using a heterogeneous-agent job search model capable of matching the wealth and income differences that distinguish UI recipients from nonrecipients. Insurance benefits are larger for UI recipients who are predominantly wealth poor. Meanwhile, incentive costs are nonmonotonic in wealth because the poorest individuals, who value employment, exhibit weak responses. Differential elasticities imply that accounting for the composition of recipients is material to the evaluation of UI’s insurance-incentive trade-off. (JEL D91, E24, E32, J64, J65)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了失业者内部存在显著的异质性，尤其是当他们根据失业保险（UI）的资格和领取情况进行划分时。我们使用一个能够匹配UI领取者与非领取者之间财富和收入差异的异质性代理人工作搜索模型，研究这种异质性对UI的保险-激励权衡的影响。保险福利对主要是财富匮乏的UI领取者来说更大。同时，激励成本在财富方面是非单调的，因为最贫穷的个体，他们重视就业，表现出较弱的反应。差异弹性意味着，考虑领取者的构成对于评估UI的保险-激励权衡至关重要。（JEL D91, E24, E32, J64, J65）

records.title_en: When Sarah Meets Lawrence: The Effects of Coeducation on Women’s College Major Choices
records.title_cn: 当莎拉遇见劳伦斯：男女同校对女性大学专业选择的影响
records.abstract_en: We leverage variation in the adoption of coeducation by US women’s colleges to study how exposure to a mixed-gender collegiate environment affects women’s human capital investments. Our event-study analyses of newly collected historical data find a 3.0–3.5 percentage point (30–33 percent) decline in the share of women majoring in STEM fields. While coeducation caused a large influx of male peers and a modest increase in male faculty, we find no evidence that it altered the composition of the female student body or other gender-neutral inputs. Extrapolation of our main estimate suggests that coeducational environments explain 36 percent of the current gender gap in STEM majors. (JEL I23, I26, J16, J24)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用美国女子学院采用男女同校教育的差异来研究接触混合性别大学环境如何影响女性的人力资本投资。我们对新收集的历史数据进行的事件研究分析发现，女性选择STEM专业的比例下降了3.0-3.5个百分点（30-33%）。虽然男女同校导致了大量男性同龄人的涌入和男性教师的适度增加，但我们没有发现证据表明它改变了女性学生群体的构成或其他性别中性的投入。我们主要估计的外推表明，男女同校环境解释了当前STEM专业性别差距的36%。（JEL I23, I26, J16, J24）

records.title_en: Uncovering Peer Effects in Social and Academic Skills
records.title_cn: 揭示社交与学业技能中的同伴效应
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of adolescent peers who are central in their social network on the formation of social skills and academic performance of fellow students. I conduct a novel large-scale field experiment at selective public boarding schools in Peru with two treatments: (i) more socially central versus less socially central peers, and (ii) higher-achieving versus lower-achieving peers. Peer effects are more pronounced for social skills than academic performance, and both vary by gender. While socially central peers lead boys to better social skills, higher-achieving peers decrease girls' test scores. Gender differences in self-confidence can explain both findings. (JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在社交网络中处于中心地位的青少年同伴对同伴学生社交技能形成和学业表现的影响。我在秘鲁的精英公立寄宿学校进行了一项新颖的大规模实地实验，包含两种处理：（i）社交中心性较高与较低的同伴，以及（ii）学业成绩较高与较低的同伴。同伴效应对社交技能的影响比对学业表现更为显著，且两者均因性别而异。社交中心性高的同伴能提升男生的社交技能，而学业成绩高的同伴则降低了女生的考试成绩。性别在自信心上的差异可以解释这两个发现。（JEL C93, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15, Z13）

records.title_en: Does Discipline Decrease Police Misconduct? Evidence from Chicago Civilian Allegations
records.title_cn: 纪律处分是否会减少警察不当行为？来自芝加哥平民指控的证据
records.abstract_en: Reformers are calling for greater oversight of police behavior, in part through enhanced use of civilian complaints. However, others counter that greater oversight could chill effective policing. We assess police officer response to administrative determinations of misconduct. Using Chicago data, we find strong evidence that a sustained allegation reduces that officer’s future misconduct. We find no evidence that this effect is driven by incapacitation, such as assignment to desk duty, or by officer disengagement. We conclude that our findings are most consistent with improved officer conduct, in part from oversight and officer concerns over promotion, salary, and desirable assignments. (JEL H76, J45, K42, M54)
records.abstract_cn: 改革者呼吁加强对警察行为的监督，部分通过增强对平民投诉的使用。然而，其他人反驳说，加强监督可能会抑制有效的警务工作。我们评估了警察对行政不当行为认定的反应。利用芝加哥的数据，我们发现强有力的证据表明，持续的指控会减少该警官未来的不当行为。我们没有发现证据表明这种效应是由失能（如被分配到文职工作）或警官脱离工作所驱动的。我们得出结论，我们的发现与警官行为的改善最为一致，部分原因在于监督以及警官对晋升、薪水和理想工作安排的担忧。（JEL H76, J45, K42, M54）

records.title_en: Halfway Home? Residential Housing and Reincarceration
records.title_cn: 中途之家？住宅住房与再监禁
records.abstract_en: Every year, hundreds of thousands of people are released from prison. For many, the transition back to society includes a mandatory stay in residential housing. I estimate the effect of residential housing on reincarceration using administrative data from Iowa. I address selection into residential housing by instrumenting for residential housing assignment with the recommendation rate of randomly assigned case managers. I find no evidence that Iowa’s costly investment in residential housing results in reduced reincarceration relative to parole. Instead, residential housing increases reincarceration due to violent crimes and technical violations, while decreasing drug and public order crimes. (JEL K42, R23, R31, R38)
records.abstract_cn: 每年，数十万人从监狱获释。对许多人来说，重返社会的过渡包括强制性的住宅住房居住。我使用爱荷华州的行政数据估计住宅住房对再监禁的影响。我通过使用随机分配的案件管理员的推荐率作为住宅住房分配的工具变量来解决住宅住房的选择性问题。我没有发现证据表明爱荷华州在住宅住房上的昂贵投资相对于假释能减少再监禁。相反，住宅住房增加了因暴力犯罪和技术违规导致的再监禁，同时减少了毒品和公共秩序犯罪。（JEL K42, R23, R31, R38）

records.title_en: Does Cash Bail Deter Misconduct?
records.title_cn: 现金保释能否遏制违法行为？
records.abstract_en: Courts routinely use low cash bail as a financial incentive to ensure released defendants appear in court and abstain from crime. This can create burdens for defendants with little empirical evidence on its efficacy. We exploit a prosecutor-driven reform that led to a sharp reduction in low cash bail and pretrial supervision, with no effect on pretrial detention, to test whether such incentive mechanisms succeed at their intended purpose. We find no evidence that financial collateral has a deterrent effect on failure to appear or pretrial crime. This paper also contributes to the literature on legal actor discretion, showing that nonbinding reforms may have limited impact on jail populations. (JEL K41, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 法院通常使用低额现金保释作为经济激励，以确保被释放的被告出庭并避免犯罪。这可能给被告带来负担，而其有效性缺乏实证证据。我们利用一项由检察官推动的改革，该改革导致低额现金保释和审前监管大幅减少，但对审前拘留没有影响，以检验此类激励机制是否达到预期目的。我们没有发现财务抵押对未出庭或审前犯罪具有威慑作用的证据。本文还对法律行为者自由裁量权的文献做出了贡献，表明非约束性改革可能对监狱人口的影响有限。（JEL K41, K42）

records.title_en: When Do Politicians Appeal Broadly? The Economic Consequences of Electoral Rules in Brazil
records.title_cn: 政治家何时广泛诉求？巴西选举规则的经济后果
records.abstract_en: Electoral rules determine how voters’ preferences are aggregated and translated into political representation. Using a regression discontinuity design, I contrast single- and two-round elections in Brazil. In two-round elections, the eventual winner must obtain at least 50 percent of the vote. I show that two-round elections provide incentives for candidates to secure a broader base of support and provide public goods more broadly. Candidates represent a more geographically diverse group of voters, public schools have more resources, and there is less variation in resources across schools. Effects appear to be driven by strategic responses of candidates rather than differential entry into races. (JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 选举规则决定了选民的偏好如何被汇总并转化为政治代表。利用断点回归设计，我对比了巴西的单轮和两轮选举。在两轮选举中，最终获胜者必须获得至少50%的选票。我表明，两轮选举激励候选人确保更广泛的支持基础，并更广泛地提供公共物品。候选人代表更地理多样化的选民群体，公立学校拥有更多资源，且学校间资源差异较小。这些效应似乎是由候选人的策略性回应而非参选者的差异进入所驱动。（JEL D72, H41, H75, I21, I28, O15, O17）

records.title_en: School Attendance Boundaries and the Segregation of Public Schools in the United States
records.title_cn: 学校招生边界与美国公立学校的隔离
records.abstract_en: School segregation is determined both by residential sorting and local policies, such as the drawing of attendance boundaries and school siting. This paper develops an approach to understanding the relative importance of these factors by calculating the distance-minimizing assignment of students to schools and assessing whether actual assignments differ systematically by race. Using census data and attendance boundary maps for nearly 1,600 school districts, I find that attendance boundaries create 5 percent more integration than a distance-minimizing baseline, while school siting plays almost no role. Residential segregation alone explains more than 100 percent of school segregation in the United States. (JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 学校隔离既由居住分化决定，也由地方政策（如招生边界的划定和学校选址）决定。本文通过计算学生到学校距离最小化的分配方案，并评估实际分配是否因种族而存在系统性差异，提出了一种理解这些因素相对重要性的方法。利用近1,600个学区的普查数据和招生边界图，我发现招生边界比距离最小化基线多创造了5%的融合，而学校选址几乎不起作用。仅居住隔离就解释了美国学校隔离的100%以上。（JEL H75, I21, I28, J15, R23）

records.title_en: Working Their Way Up? US Immigrants’ Changing Labor Market Assimilation in the Age of Mass Migration
records.title_cn: 他们是否在向上流动？大规模移民时代美国移民劳动力市场同化的变迁
records.abstract_en: Whether immigrants advance in labor markets during their lifetimes relative to natives is a fundamental question in the economics of immigration. We examine linked census records for five cohorts spanning 1850–1940, when immigration to the United States was at its peak. We find a U-shaped pattern of assimilation: immigrants were “catching up” to natives in the early and later cohorts, but not in between. This change was not due to shifts in immigrants’ source countries. Instead, it was rooted in men’s early-career occupations, which we associate with structural change, strengthening complementarities, and large immigration waves in the 1840s and 1900s. (JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)
records.abstract_cn: 移民在其一生中相对于本地人在劳动力市场上是否有所进步，是移民经济学中的一个基本问题。我们考察了跨越1850-1940年的五个队列的关联人口普查记录，当时美国移民达到顶峰。我们发现同化呈U型模式：移民在早期和后期队列中“追赶”本地人，但在中间时期则不然。这一变化并非源于移民来源国的转变，而是根植于男性早期职业，我们将其与结构性变化、互补性增强以及1840年和1900年的大规模移民浪潮联系起来。(JEL J15, J24, J61, J82, N31, N32)

records.title_en: From Hashtag to Hate Crime: Twitter and Antiminority Sentiment
records.title_cn: 从标签到仇恨犯罪：推特与反少数族裔情绪
records.abstract_en: We study whether social media can amplify antiminority sentiment with a focus on Donald Trump’s political rise. Using an instrumental variable strategy based on Twitter’s early adopters at the South by Southwest festival in 2007, we find that higher Twitter use in a county is associated with a sizeable increase in anti-Muslim hate crimes after the 2016 presidential primaries. Trump’s tweets about Muslims predict increases in xenophobic tweets by his followers, cable news mentions of Muslims, and hate crimes on the following days. These results suggest that social media content can affect real-life out-comes. (JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究社交媒体是否能放大反少数族裔情绪，重点关注唐纳德·特朗普的政治崛起。利用基于2007年西南偏南音乐节上推特早期采用者的工具变量策略，我们发现，一个县的推特使用率越高，2016年总统初选后反穆斯林仇恨犯罪的数量就越大。特朗普关于穆斯林的推文预测了其追随者仇外推文、有线新闻对穆斯林的提及以及随后几天仇恨犯罪的增加。这些结果表明，社交媒体内容可以影响现实生活中的结果。(JEL D72, J15, K42, L82, Z12)

records.title_en: Adverse Selection in Low-Income Health Insurance Markets: Evidence from an RCT in Pakistan
records.title_cn: 低收入健康保险市场中的逆向选择：来自巴基斯坦随机对照试验的证据
records.abstract_en: We present robust evidence on adverse selection in hospitalization insurance for low-income individuals that received first-time access to insurance. A large randomized control trial from Pakistan allows us to separate adverse selection from moral hazard, estimate how selection changes at different points of the demand curve, and test simple measures to limit adverse selection. The results reveal substantial selection in individual policies, leading to welfare losses and the threat of a market breakdown. Bundling insurance policies at the household level or higher almost eliminates adverse selection, thus mitigating its welfare consequences and facilitating sustainable insurance supply. (JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于低收入个体首次获得住院保险时逆向选择的稳健证据。一项来自巴基斯坦的大型随机对照试验使我们能够将逆向选择与道德风险区分开来，估计选择在不同需求曲线点上的变化，并测试限制逆向选择的简单措施。结果揭示了个人保单中存在显著的选择，导致福利损失和市场崩溃的威胁。在家庭层面或更高层面捆绑保险单几乎消除了逆向选择，从而减轻了其福利后果并促进了可持续的保险供给。(JEL D82, G22, I13, I18, O15, O16)

records.title_en: What Difference Does a Health Plan Make? Evidence from Random Plan Assignment in Medicaid
records.title_cn: 健康计划有何不同？来自医疗补助计划中随机计划分配的证据
records.abstract_en: Exploiting the random assignment of Medicaid beneficiaries to managed care plans, we find substantial plan-specific spending effects despite plans having identical cost sharing. Enrollment in the lowest-spending plan reduces spending by at least 25 percent—primarily through quantity reductions—relative to enrollment in the highest-spending plan. Rather than reducing “wasteful” spending, lower-spending plans broadly reduce medical service provision—including the provision of low-cost, high-value care—and worsen beneficiary satisfaction and health. Consumer demand follows spending: a 10 percent increase in plan-specific spending is associated with a 40 percent increase in market share. These facts have implications for the government’s contracting problem and program cost growth. (JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 利用医疗补助受益人被随机分配到管理式护理计划的这一情况，我们发现尽管计划具有相同的成本分摊，但存在显著的特定计划支出效应。加入支出最低的计划相对于加入支出最高的计划，可使支出至少减少25%——主要通过数量减少实现。支出较低的计划并非减少“浪费性”支出，而是广泛减少了医疗服务提供——包括提供低成本、高价值的护理——并降低了受益人的满意度和健康状况。消费者需求随支出变化：特定计划支出增加10%与市场份额增加40%相关。这些事实对政府的签约问题和项目成本增长具有启示意义。(JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)

records.title_en: Generic Aversion and Observational Learning in the Over-the-Counter Drug Market
records.title_cn: 非处方药市场中的仿制药厌恶与观察学习
records.abstract_en: Through a labeling intervention at a national retailer, we test three hypotheses for consumer aversion to generic over-the-counter drugs: lack of information on the comparability of generic and brand drugs, inattention to their price differences, and uncertainty about generic quality that can be reduced with information on peer purchase rates. With a difference-in-differences strategy, we find that posted information on the purchases of other customers increases generic purchase shares significantly, while other treatments have mixed results. Consumers without prior generic purchases appear particularly responsive to this information. These findings have policy implications for promoting evidence-based, cost-effective choices. (JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 通过在一家全国性零售商处进行的标签干预，我们检验了消费者对非处方仿制药厌恶的三个假设：缺乏关于仿制药和品牌药可比性的信息、对其价格差异的忽视，以及可以通过同伴购买率信息减少的仿制药质量不确定性。采用双重差分策略，我们发现张贴其他顾客购买信息显著提高了仿制药购买份额，而其他处理的效果不一。先前没有仿制药购买经历的消费者对这一信息似乎尤为敏感。这些发现对促进基于证据的、成本有效的选择具有政策意义。（JEL D12, D83, L65, L81, M37）

records.title_en: Anchored Inflation Expectations
records.title_cn: 锚定的通胀预期
records.abstract_en: We develop a theory of low-frequency movements in inflation expectations, and use it to interpret joint dynamics of inflation and inflation expectations for the United States and other countries over the postwar period. In our theory, long-run inflation expectations are endogenous. They are driven by short-run inflation surprises, in a way that depends on recent forecasting performance and monetary policy. This distinguishes our theory from common explanations of low-frequency properties of inflation. The model, estimated using only inflation and short-term forecasts from professional surveys, accurately predicts observed measures of long-term inflation expectations and identifies episodes of unanchored expectations. (JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E31, E37, E52)
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个关于通胀预期低频变动的理论，并用它来解释战后时期美国及其他国家通胀与通胀预期的联合动态。在我们的理论中，长期通胀预期是内生的。它们由短期通胀意外驱动，其方式取决于近期的预测表现和货币政策。这使我们的理论区别于关于通胀低频特性的常见解释。该模型仅使用来自专业调查的通胀和短期预测进行估计，能准确预测观测到的长期通胀预期指标，并识别出预期未锚定的时期。（JEL D83, D84, E12, E23, E31, E37, E52）

records.title_en: Firm Entry and Exit and Aggregate Growth
records.title_cn: 企业进入与退出及总体增长
records.abstract_en: Applying the Foster, Haltiwanger, and Krizan (2001) decomposition to plant-level manufacturing data from Chile and Korea, we find that the entry and exit of plants account for a larger fraction of aggregate productivity growth during periods of fast GDP growth. To analyze this relationship, we develop a model of firm entry and exit based on Hopenhayn (1992). When we introduce reforms that reduce entry costs or reduce barriers to technology adoption into a calibrated model, we find that the entry and exit terms in the FHK decomposition become more important as GDP grows rapidly, just as they do in the data from Chile and Korea. (JEL D24, E23, L13, L60, O14, O32, O47)
records.abstract_cn: 将Foster、Haltiwanger和Krizan（2001）的分解方法应用于智利和韩国的工厂层面制造业数据，我们发现，在GDP快速增长时期，工厂的进入和退出对总体生产率增长的贡献份额更大。为分析这一关系，我们基于Hopenhayn（1992）构建了一个企业进入与退出模型。当我们在校准模型中引入降低进入成本或减少技术采用障碍的改革时，我们发现FHK分解中的进入和退出项在GDP快速增长时变得更加重要，这与智利和韩国的数据表现一致。（JEL D24, E23, L13, L60, O14, O32, O47）

records.title_en: Learning about Debt Crises
records.title_cn: 关于债务危机的学习
records.abstract_en: The European debt crisis presents a challenge to our understanding of the relationship between government bond yields and economic fundamentals. I argue that information frictions are an important missing element and support that claim with evidence on the evolution of GDP forecast errors after 2008. I build a quantitative model of sovereign default where output features rare disasters and agents learn about their realizations. Debt crises coincide with economic depressions and develop gradually while markets update their expectations about future income. Calibrated to the Portuguese economy, the model replicates the comovement of bond spreads and output before and after 2008. (JEL E23, E27, E32, E43, F34, H63)
records.abstract_cn: 欧洲债务危机对我们理解政府债券收益率与经济基本面之间的关系提出了挑战。我认为信息摩擦是一个重要的缺失要素，并通过2008年后GDP预测误差的演变证据支持这一主张。我构建了一个主权违约的定量模型，其中产出具有罕见灾难特征，且代理人学习其实现情况。债务危机与经济萧条同时发生，并在市场更新对未来收入预期时逐渐发展。以葡萄牙经济为校准对象，该模型复制了2008年前后债券利差与产出的共同变动。(JEL E23, E27, E32, E43, F34, H63)

records.title_en: Uncovering the Effects of the Zero Lower Bound with an Endogenous Financial Wedge
records.title_cn: 内生金融楔子下零利率下限效应的揭示
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of the zero lower bound (ZLB) on the severity of financial crises using an incomplete markets New Keynesian model with two occasionally binding constraints: a ZLB on the nominal interest rate and a borrowing constraint tied to an asset price. The model’s financial wedge corresponds to an endogenous multiplier on the borrowing constraint. Binding ZLB exacerbates financial crises through its interaction with the asset fire sale vicious cycle, driving up the financial wedge. Our results offer a novel reinterpretation of the negligible effect of the ZLB in representative agent New Keynesian models with exogenous wedges. (JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52, G01)
records.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个具有两个偶发约束的不完全市场新凯恩斯模型来研究零利率下限（ZLB）对金融危机严重程度的影响：名义利率的零下限和与资产价格相关的借款约束。模型的金融楔子对应于借款约束上的内生乘数。约束性的零利率下限通过与资产甩卖恶性循环的相互作用加剧金融危机，推高金融楔子。我们的结果为具有外生楔子的代表性主体新凯恩斯模型中零利率下限的微不足道效应提供了一种新的重新解释。（JEL E12, E31, E32, E43, E52, G01）

records.title_en: Robust Predictions for DSGE Models with Incomplete Information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息DSGE模型的稳健预测
records.abstract_en: We provide predictions for DSGE models with incomplete information that are robust across information structures. Our approach maps an incomplete-information model into a full-information economy with time-varying expectation wedges and provides conditions that ensure the wedges are rationalizable by some information structure. Using our approach, we quantify the potential importance of information as a source of business cycle fluctuations in an otherwise frictionless model. Our approach uncovers a central role for firm-specific demand shocks in supporting aggregate confidence fluctuations. Only if firms face unobserved local demand shocks can confidence fluctuations account for a significant portion of the US business cycle. (JEL D82, D83, E13, E31, E32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们为具有不完全信息的DSGE模型提供预测，这些预测在信息结构上具有稳健性。我们的方法将不完全信息模型转化为具有时变预期楔子的完全信息经济，并提供确保这些楔子可由某种信息结构合理化的条件。利用我们的方法，我们量化了信息作为商业周期波动来源在无摩擦模型中的潜在重要性。我们的方法揭示了企业特定需求冲击在支持总体信心波动中的核心作用。只有当企业面临未观察到的局部需求冲击时，信心波动才能解释美国商业周期的显著部分。(JEL D82, D83, E13, E31, E32)

records.title_en: The Government Spending Multiplier in a Multisector Economy
records.title_cn: 多部门经济中的政府支出乘数
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of aggregate government spending shocks in a production network economy where sectors differ in their price rigidity, factor intensities, use of intermediate inputs, and contribution to final demand. The model implies an aggregate value-added multiplier that is 75 percent (and $0.32) larger than that obtained in the average one-sector economy. This amplification is mainly driven by input–output linkages and—to a lesser extent—sectoral heterogeneity in price rigidity. Aggregate government spending shocks also lead to heterogeneous responses of sectoral value added, which are larger among upstream industries. We present novel empirical evidence supporting this prediction. (JEL E12, E16, E23, E43, E52, E62, H50)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了生产网络经济中总政府支出冲击的影响，在该经济中，各部门在价格刚性、要素密集度、中间投入使用以及对最终需求的贡献方面存在差异。该模型隐含的总增加值乘数比平均单部门经济中获得的乘数大75%（以及0.32美元）。这种放大效应主要由投入产出联系驱动，其次是价格刚性的部门异质性。总政府支出冲击还导致部门增加值的异质性反应，其中上游行业的反应更大。我们提供了支持这一预测的新颖经验证据。（JEL E12, E16, E23, E43, E52, E62, H50）

records.title_en: Skilled Labor Productivity and Cross-Country Income Differences
records.title_cn: 技能劳动力生产率与跨国收入差异
records.abstract_en: This paper revisits the question of how allowing for imperfect substitution among workers with different skill levels affects the results of development accounting. We consider a range of models that nest the approaches in the literature and calibrate them to a common set of moments, including particularly evidence on the wage gains of migrants. We obtain two main results. First, human capital accounts for between one-half and three-fourths of cross-country income gaps. Second, human capital accounts for only modest variation in the relative productivity of skilled versus unskilled labor. (JEL E24, E25, J22, J23, J24, J31, J61)
records.abstract_cn: 本文重新探讨了允许不同技能水平工人之间不完全替代如何影响发展核算结果的问题。我们考虑了一系列涵盖文献中各种方法的模型，并将它们校准到一组共同的矩条件，特别是包括移民工资收益的证据。我们得到两个主要结果。第一，人力资本解释了跨国收入差距的二分之一到四分之三。第二，人力资本仅解释了技能与非技能劳动力相对生产率的适度变化。（JEL E24, E25, J22, J23, J24, J31, J61）

records.title_en: Women, Wealth Effects, and Slow Recoveries
records.title_cn: 女性、财富效应与缓慢复苏
records.abstract_en: Business cycle recoveries have slowed in recent decades. This slowdown comes entirely from female employment, as women’s employment rates converged toward men’s during the past half-century. But does the slowdown in the growth of female employment rates translate into a slowdown for overall employment rates? We estimate the extent to which women “crowd out” men in the labor market across US states, and find that it is small. Through the lens of a general equilibrium model with home production, we show this statistic implies that 60-75 percent of the slowdown in recent business cycle recoveries can be explained by female convergence.(JEL D13, E24, E32, J16, J21)
records.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，商业周期复苏有所放缓。这种放缓完全来自女性就业，因为过去半个世纪中，女性就业率向男性趋同。但女性就业率增长的放缓是否转化为整体就业率的放缓？我们估算了美国各州劳动力市场中女性“挤出”男性的程度，发现这一程度很小。通过一个包含家庭生产的一般均衡模型的视角，我们表明这一统计量意味着，近期商业周期复苏放缓的60-75%可以由女性趋同来解释。(JEL D13, E24, E32, J16, J21)

records.title_en: Consumption Heterogeneity: Micro Drivers and Macro Implications
records.title_cn: 消费异质性：微观驱动因素与宏观影响
records.abstract_en: We document heterogeneity in the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) across household characteristics relevant to understanding heterogeneous agent models and monetary policy transmission. We find a strong negative relationship between household liquid wealth and MPC. We show that household liquid wealth predicts MPC closely for every other household characteristic we look at. We use a new empirical method that overcomes sources of bias found in the existing literature, along with administrative data from Denmark that allow us to identify heterogeneous behavior. We use our results to analyze monetary policy transmission mechanisms in both Denmark and the United States. (JEL D12, D31, E21, E43, E52, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们记录了不同家庭特征下边际消费倾向（MPC）的异质性，这些特征对于理解异质性代理人模型和货币政策传导至关重要。我们发现家庭流动性财富与MPC之间存在强烈的负相关关系。我们表明，对于我们所考察的每一个其他家庭特征，家庭流动性财富都能紧密预测MPC。我们采用了一种新的实证方法，克服了现有文献中存在的偏差来源，并结合丹麦的行政数据，使我们能够识别异质性行为。我们利用我们的结果来分析丹麦和美国的货币政策传导机制。（JEL D12, D31, E21, E43, E52, G51）

records.title_en: Assessing the Gains from E-Commerce
records.title_cn: 评估电子商务的收益
records.abstract_en: E-commerce represents a rapidly growing share of consumer spending in the United States. We use transactions-level data on credit and debit cards from Visa, Inc. between 2007 and 2017 to quantify the resulting consumer surplus. We estimate e-commerce reached 8 percent of consumption by 2017, yielding the equivalent of a 1 percent boost to their consumption, or over $1,000 per household per year. While some of the gains arose from avoiding travel costs to local merchants, most of the gains stemmed from substituting to merchants available online but not locally. Higher income consumers gained more, as did consumers in more densely populated counties. (JEL D12, E21, G51, L81, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 电子商务在美国消费者支出中所占份额迅速增长。我们使用Visa公司2007年至2017年间的信用卡和借记卡交易级数据来量化由此产生的消费者剩余。我们估计，到2017年，电子商务占消费的比例达到8%，相当于消费增长1%，即每户每年超过1,000美元。虽然部分收益来自避免前往当地商户的旅行成本，但大部分收益源于转向在线可得而本地没有的商户。高收入消费者获益更多，人口密度更高的县的消费者也是如此。（JEL D12, E21, G51, L81, L86）

records.title_en: Fiscal Policy, Relative Prices, and Net Exports in a Currency Union
records.title_cn: 货币联盟中的财政政策、相对价格与净出口
records.abstract_en: The hoped-for silver lining of euro-area austerity programs was to raise external competitiveness and improve current accounts. Using product- and industry-level data for 12 countries over the period 1999–2018, we show that reductions in government spending reduce prices and wages but only for products with low import content and industries with low export shares. This leads to asymmetric expenditure switching, with net exports improving through lower imports rather than higher exports. The standard small-open-economy model fails to rationalize these findings, but home bias in government spending and frictions preventing factor prices from equalizing across sectors considerably improve the fit of the model. (JEL E31, E62, F14, F33, F45, H20, H50)
records.abstract_cn: 欧元区紧缩计划的希望之光在于提高外部竞争力并改善经常账户。利用1999-2018年期间12个国家的产品和行业层面数据，我们表明政府支出的减少会降低价格和工资，但仅限于进口含量低的产品和出口份额低的行业。这导致了不对称的支出转换，净出口通过降低进口而非增加出口来改善。标准的小型开放经济模型无法合理化解这些发现，但政府支出的国内偏好以及阻止要素价格在行业间均等化的摩擦显著提高了模型的拟合度。(JEL E31, E62, F14, F33, F45, H20, H50)

records.title_en: House Prices and Consumption: A New Instrumental Variables Approach
records.title_cn: 房价与消费：一种新的工具变量方法
records.abstract_en: We introduce a novel Bartik-like instrument for house prices consisting of the local composition of housing characteristics interacted with aggregate changes in the marginal prices of these characteristics. Using household-level panel data, we estimate elasticities of nondurable consumption expenditures with respect to house prices of around 0.1. These consumption effects are concentrated among the young and those most likely to be facing tight borrowing constraints. A decomposition shows that identifying variation in the instrument is associated with times and locations where house prices have varied the most: during the housing bust of the mid-2000s and in the western United States. (JEL D12, E21, G51, R21, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种新颖的类似巴蒂克的房价工具变量，该工具由住房特征的本地构成与这些特征边际价格的总体变化相互作用而成。利用家庭层面面板数据，我们估计非耐用消费支出对房价的弹性约为0.1。这些消费效应集中在年轻人和最可能面临严格借贷约束的人群中。分解表明，工具中的识别变异与房价波动最大的时期和地点相关：在2000年代中期住房市场崩盘期间以及美国西部。(JEL D12, E21, G51, R21, R31)

records.title_en: A Risky Venture: Income Dynamics among Pass-Through Business Owners
records.title_cn: 风险事业：穿透型企业主的收入动态
records.abstract_en: We employ a large panel of US income tax returns for the period 1987–2018 to extensively characterize and quantify business income risk. Our findings show business income to be much riskier than labor income. Business income is less persistent and is characterized by higher tail risk. Furthermore, when compared to labor income, heterogeneity across households is less important in explaining the cross-sectional variation in business income, and within-household income variation is more important. Our results underscore the income risks business owners face and provide stylized facts and parameter estimates useful for quantitative macroeconomic models and policy analysis. (JEL D31, G51, H24, J23, J31, K34, L26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用1987-2018年间美国个人所得税申报表的大型面板数据，广泛刻画并量化了企业收入风险。我们的研究结果表明，企业收入的风险远高于劳动收入。企业收入的持续性较弱，且具有较高的尾部风险。此外，与劳动收入相比，家庭间异质性在解释企业收入的横截面差异方面重要性较低，而家庭内收入变动的重要性则更高。我们的结果强调了企业主面临的收入风险，并为定量宏观经济模型和政策分析提供了典型化事实和参数估计。(JEL D31, G51, H24, J23, J31, K34, L26)

records.title_en: Childcare Subsidies and Child Skill Accumulation in One- and Two-Parent Families
records.title_cn: 儿童保育补贴与单亲及双亲家庭儿童技能积累
records.abstract_en: I examine the role of family structure and childcare subsidies in child skill accumulation. I establish empirically that skill accumulation is more responsive to childcare price for one-parent families than for two-parent families. I analyze the effects of childcare subsidies in a model featuring endogenous family formation, parental altruism, and a baseline subsidy resembling that of the United States. I find that eliminating this subsidy generates welfare losses of 1.63 percent of lifetime consumption, that equilibrium adjustments act to mitigate these losses, and that increasing uptake among one-parent families yields the highest welfare gains per additional recipient. (JEL I21, I26, J12, J13, J24)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了家庭结构和儿童保育补贴在儿童技能积累中的作用。我通过实证发现，对于单亲家庭而言，技能积累对保育价格的响应程度高于双亲家庭。我在一个包含内生家庭形成、父母利他主义以及类似美国基线补贴的模型中分析了儿童保育补贴的影响。我发现，取消该补贴将造成相当于终身消费1.63%的福利损失，均衡调整会减轻这些损失，并且提高单亲家庭的补贴领取率能带来每位新增受助者最高的福利收益。(JEL I21, I26, J12, J13, J24)

records.title_en: Firm Wages in a Frictional Labor Market
records.title_cn: 摩擦性劳动力市场中的企业工资
records.abstract_en: This paper studies wage setting in a directed search model of multiworker firms facing within-firm equity constraints on wages. The constraints reduce wages, as firms exploit their monopsony power over their existing workers, rendering wages less responsive to productivity in doing so. They also give rise to a time inconsistency in the dynamic firm problem, as firms face a less elastic labor supply in the short run than in the long run, making commitment to future wages valuable. Constrained firms find it profitable to fix wages, and doing so is good for worker welfare and resource allocation in equilibrium. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J42, J63, J64, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了多工人企业在面临企业内部工资公平约束时的定向搜索模型中的工资设定。这些约束降低了工资，因为企业利用其对现有工人的垄断权力，从而使工资对生产率的反应减弱。它们还导致动态企业问题中的时间不一致性，因为企业在短期内面临的劳动力供给弹性小于长期，这使得对未来工资的承诺变得有价值。受约束的企业发现固定工资是有利可图的，这样做在均衡中对工人福利和资源配置是有益的。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J42, J63, J64, M52）

records.title_en: The Impact of Income-Driven Repayment on Student Borrower Outcomes
records.title_cn: 收入驱动还款对学生借款人结果的影响
records.abstract_en: In the United States, most student loans follow a fixed payment schedule that falls early in borrowers’ careers. This structure provides no insurance against earnings risk and may increase student loan defaults. Income-driven repayment (IDR) plans are designed to help distressed student borrowers by lowering their monthly payments to a share of income. Using random variation in a loan servicer’s automatic dialing system, I find that IDR reduces delinquencies by 22 percentage points and decreases outstanding balances within eight months of take-up. I find suggestive long-run impacts on borrower credit scores, mortgage-holding rates, and other measures of financial health. (JEL G23, G51, H52, I22)
records.abstract_cn: 在美国，大多数学生贷款采用固定还款计划，该计划在借款人职业生涯早期即开始还款。这种结构无法为收入风险提供保险，并可能增加学生贷款违约。收入驱动还款（IDR）计划旨在通过将月还款额降低至收入的一定比例来帮助陷入困境的学生借款人。利用贷款服务机构自动拨号系统的随机变异，我发现IDR在参与后八个月内将拖欠率降低了22个百分点，并减少了未偿余额。我发现了对借款人信用评分、抵押贷款持有率及其他财务健康指标的长期影响的暗示性证据。（JEL G23, G51, H52, I22）

records.title_en: Winners and Losers? The Effect of Gaining and Losing Access to Selective Colleges on Education and Labor Market Outcomes
records.title_cn: 赢家与输家？获得和失去选择性大学入学机会对教育与劳动力市场结果的影响
records.abstract_en: We use the introduction of the Texas Top Ten Percent rule to estimate the effect of access to a selective college on graduation and earnings outcomes for two groups of students. For highly ranked students at more disadvantaged high schools, who gained access under the policy, college enrollment and graduation increased. Less highly ranked students at more advantaged schools, who tended to lose access, shifted toward less-selective colleges under the policy, but did not see declines in overall college enrollment, graduation, or earnings. The policy thus benefited students targeted for admission without evidence of adverse effects on displaced students. (JEL I21, I23, I24, I26)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用德克萨斯州前百分之十规则的引入，估计了获得选择性大学入学机会对两组学生的毕业和收入结果的影响。对于在劣势高中排名靠前的学生，他们在该政策下获得了入学机会，大学入学率和毕业率有所提高。在优势学校排名较低的学生，他们往往失去入学机会，在政策下转向选择性较低的大学，但整体大学入学率、毕业率或收入并未下降。因此，该政策惠及了针对入学的学生，而没有证据表明对受替代的学生产生不利影响。(JEL I21, I23, I24, I26)

records.title_en: A Glimpse of Freedom: Allied Occupation and Political Resistance in East Germany
records.title_cn: 自由的惊鸿一瞥：盟军占领与东德的政治抵抗
records.abstract_en: This paper exploits the idiosyncratic line of contact separating Allied and Soviet troops within East Germany at the end of WWII to study political resistance in a non-democracy. When Nazi Germany surrendered, 40 percent of what would become the authoritarian German Democratic Republic was initially under Allied control but was ceded to Soviet control less than two months later. Brief Allied exposure increased protests during the major 1953 uprising. We use novel data on the appointment of local mayors and a retrospective survey to argue that even a “glimpse of freedom” can foster civilian opposition to dictatorship. (JEL D72, D74, N44, P16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用二战结束时盟军与苏军在东德境内接触线的特殊划分，研究非民主体制下的政治抵抗。当纳粹德国投降时，后来成为威权主义德意志民主共和国的地区中有40%最初处于盟军控制之下，但在不到两个月后被割让给苏联控制。短暂的盟军占领增加了1953年重大起义期间的抗议活动。我们使用关于地方市长任命的新数据和一项回顾性调查来论证，即使是“自由的惊鸿一瞥”也能激发平民对独裁统治的反对。(JEL D72, D74, N44, P16)

records.title_en: Employer Responses to Family Leave Programs
records.title_cn: 雇主对家庭休假计划的回应
records.abstract_en: Search frictions make worker turnover costly to firms. A three-month parental leave expansion in Sweden provides exogenous variation that we use to quantify firms’ adjustment costs upon worker absence. The reform increased women’s leave duration and likelihood of separating from pre-birth employers. Firms with greater exposure to the reform hired additional workers and increased coworkers to make it coworkers’ hours, incurring wage costs corresponding to 10 full-time equivalent months in addition to replacing the workers. These adjustment costs varied by firms’ availability of internal substitutes. We also analyze a daddy-month reform and find similar employer responses to male workers’ leave, albeit smaller in magnitude. (JEL J16, J22, J32, J64, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 搜索摩擦使得工人流动对企业而言成本高昂。瑞典一项为期三个月的育儿假扩展提供了外生变异，我们利用其来量化工人缺勤时企业的调整成本。该改革增加了女性休假时长及离开产前雇主的可能性。受改革影响较大的企业雇佣了额外工人，并增加了同事的工作时间，除了替换工人外，还产生了相当于10个全职等效月工资成本的费用。这些调整成本因企业内部替代者的可用性而异。我们还分析了父亲月改革，发现雇主对男性工人休假的类似回应，尽管规模较小。(JEL J16, J22, J32, J64, M52)

records.title_en: Labor Supply and Directed Technical Change: Evidence from the Termination of the Bracero Program in 1964
records.title_cn: 劳动力供给与定向技术变革：来自1964年布拉塞罗计划终止的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the impact of labor supply on the creation of new technology, exploiting a large exogenous shock to the US agricultural labor supply caused by the termination of the Bracero agreements between the US and Mexico at the end of 1964. Using a text-search algorithm allocating patents to crops, I show a negative labor-supply shock induced a sharp increase in innovation in technologies related to more affected crops. The effect is stronger for technology related to labor-intensive production tasks. Farm-value dynamics indicate that, despite the positive technology reaction, the policy change was undesirable for farm owners. (JEL J22, J43, N32, O33, O34, Q12, Q16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了劳动力供给对新技术创造的影响，利用1964年底美国和墨西哥之间布拉塞罗协议终止所导致的美国农业劳动力供给的巨大外生冲击。通过一种将专利分配到作物的文本搜索算法，我表明负向劳动力供给冲击引发了与受影响更严重作物相关的技术的急剧创新增加。这种效应在劳动密集型生产任务相关的技术中更为显著。农场价值动态表明，尽管存在积极的技术反应，政策变化对农场主来说仍是不利的。（JEL J22, J43, N32, O33, O34, Q12, Q16）

records.title_en: The Effect of Immigration Restrictions on Local Labor Markets: Lessons from the 1920s Border Closure
records.title_cn: 移民限制对地方劳动力市场的影响：来自1920年边境关闭的教训
records.abstract_en: In the 1920s, the United States substantially reduced immigration by imposing country-specific entry quotas. We compare local labor markets differentially exposed to the quotas due to variation in the national-origin mix of their immigrant population. US-born workers in areas losing immigrants did not benefit relative to workers in less exposed areas. Instead, in urban areas, European immigrants were replaced with internal migrants and immigrants from Mexico and Canada. By contrast, farmers shifted toward capital-intensive agriculture, and the immigrant-intensive mining industry contracted. These differences highlight the uneven effects of the quota system at the local level. (JEL J15, J18, J31, K37, N32, N42, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 1920年，美国通过实施针对特定国家的入境配额大幅减少了移民。我们将因移民人口国籍构成差异而受到配额不同影响的当地劳动力市场进行比较。在失去移民的地区，美国出生的工人相对于受影响较小的地区的工人并未受益。相反，在城市地区，欧洲移民被国内移民以及来自墨西哥和加拿大的移民所取代。相比之下，农民转向资本密集型农业，而移民密集的采矿业则出现收缩。这些差异凸显了配额制度在地方层面的不均衡影响。（JEL J15, J18, J31, K37, N32, N42, R23）

records.title_en: Temperature, Worker Productivity, and Adaptation: Evidence from Survey Data Production
records.title_cn: 温度、工人生产率与适应：来自调查数据生产的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impact of daily weather on worker productivity by using household survey data to study interviewers. Using data from over 9,000 Demographic and Health Surveys interviewers in 46 countries, I find that interviewers complete 13.6 percent fewer interviews per hour on the hottest and most humid days. Workers maintain the same total output by starting earlier in the day and spending more time on each interview at the expense of spending more hours in the field with the same total pay. In addition, interviewers become differentially less productive on tasks that are less easily monitored. (JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 本文利用住户调查数据研究访问员，估计每日天气对工人生产率的影响。利用来自46个国家的超过9,000名人口与健康调查访问员的数据，我发现访问员在最炎热和最潮湿的日子里每小时完成的访谈数减少13.6%。工人通过更早开始工作并在每次访谈上花费更多时间来维持相同的总产出，但代价是在田间花费更多小时且总报酬不变。此外，访问员在较不易监督的任务上的生产率下降幅度更大。（JEL C83, J22, J24, J81, O12, Q54）

records.title_en: Every Day Is Earth Day: Evidence on the Long-Term Impact of Environmental Activism
records.title_cn: 每一天都是地球日：环境行动主义长期影响的证据
records.abstract_en: We use variation in weather to study the long-term effects of activism during the original Earth Day on attitudes, environmental outcomes, and children’s health. Unusually bad weather on April 22, 1970 is associated with weaker support for the environment 10 to 20 years later, particularly among those who were school aged in 1970. Bad weather on Earth Day is also associated with higher levels of carbon monoxide in the air and greater risk of congenital abnormalities in infants born in the following decades. These results identify benefits to volunteer activity that would be impossible to identify until years after the volunteering occurs. (JEL D64, D91, Q51, Q53, Q54)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用天气变化来研究最初的地球日期间行动主义对态度、环境结果和儿童健康的长期影响。1970年四月22日异常恶劣的天气与10至20年后对环境支持力度减弱相关，尤其是在1970年处于学龄期的人群中。地球日的恶劣天气还与空气中一氧化碳水平升高以及随后几十年出生的婴儿先天性异常风险增加有关。这些结果识别了志愿活动的益处，而这些益处直到志愿活动发生多年后才能被识别。（JEL D64, D91, Q51, Q53, Q54）

records.title_en: Incentivized Peer Referrals for Tuberculosis Screening: Evidence from India
records.title_cn: 结核病筛查的激励性同伴推荐：来自印度的证据
records.abstract_en: We study whether and how peer referrals increase screening, testing, and identification of patients with tuberculosis, an infectious disease responsible for over one million deaths annually. In an experiment with 3,176 patients at 122 tuberculosis treatment centers in India, we find that small financial incentives raise the probability that existing patients refer prospective patients for screening and testing, resulting in cost-effective identification of new cases. Incentivized referrals operate through two mechanisms: peers have private information about individuals in their social networks to target for outreach, and they are more effective than health workers in inducing these individuals to get tested. (JEL H51, I12, I18, O15, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究同伴推荐是否以及如何提高结核病患者的筛查、检测和识别，结核病是一种每年导致超过一百万人死亡的传染病。在一项针对印度122个结核病治疗中心的3,176名患者的实验中，我们发现小额经济激励提高了现有患者推荐潜在患者进行筛查和检测的概率，从而以成本有效的方式识别新病例。激励性推荐通过两种机制发挥作用：同伴拥有关于其社交网络中个体私人信息以进行定向外展，并且他们在促使这些个体接受检测方面比卫生工作者更有效。（JEL H51, I12, I18, O15, Z13）

records.title_en: Strategic Formal Layoffs: Unemployment Insurance and Informal Labor Markets
records.title_cn: 战略性正式解雇：失业保险与非正规劳动力市场
records.abstract_en: Exploiting an unemployment insurance reform in Brazil, we study incentive effects of UI in the presence of informal labor markets. We find that eligibility for UI benefits increases formal layoffs by 11 percent. Most of the additional layoffs are related to workers transitioning to informal employment. We further document formal layoff and recall patterns consistent with rent extraction from the UI system. Workers are laid off as they become eligible for UI benefits and recalled when benefits cease. These patterns are stronger for industries and municipalities with a high degree of labor market informality. (JEL J22, J46, J63, J65, K31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 利用巴西的失业保险改革，我们研究了在存在非正规劳动力市场的情况下失业保险的激励效应。我们发现，失业保险金的领取资格使正式解雇增加了11%。大部分额外解雇与工人转向非正规就业有关。我们进一步记录了与从失业保险制度中提取租金相一致的正式解雇和召回模式。工人在有资格领取失业保险金时被解雇，并在福利停止时被召回。这些模式在劳动力市场非正规化程度较高的行业和城市更为明显。(JEL J22, J46, J63, J65, K31, O15)

records.title_en: Inefficient Water Pricing and Incentives for Conservation
records.title_cn: 低效水价与节水激励
records.abstract_en: Farmers often buy water using fixed fees—rather than with marginal prices. We use two randomized controlled trials in Bangladesh to study the relationship between marginal prices, adoption of a water-saving technology, and water usage. Our first experiment shows that the technology only saves water when farmers face marginal prices. Our second experiment finds that an encouragement to voluntarily convert to hourly pumping charges does not save water. Taken together, efforts to conserve water work best when farmers face marginal prices, but simply giving an option for marginal pricing is insufficient to trigger water-saving investments and reduce irrigation demands. (JEL O13, Q12, Q15, Q16, Q25)
records.abstract_cn: 农民通常以固定费用而非边际价格购买水。我们在孟加拉国进行了两项随机对照试验，研究边际价格、节水技术采用与用水量之间的关系。我们的第一项实验表明，只有当农民面临边际价格时，该技术才能节约用水。第二项实验发现，鼓励自愿转换为按小时计收抽水费用并不能节约用水。综合来看，当农民面临边际价格时，节水努力最为有效，但仅仅提供边际定价的选择并不足以引发节水投资和减少灌溉需求。（JEL O13, Q12, Q15, Q16, Q25）

records.title_en: High School Majors and Future Earnings
records.title_cn: 高中专业与未来收入
records.abstract_en: We study how high school majors affect adult earnings using a regression discontinuity design. In Sweden students are admitted to majors in tenth grade based on their preference rankings and ninth grade GPA. We find engineering, natural science, and business majors yield higher earnings than social science and humanities, with major-specific returns also varying based on next-best alternatives. There is either a zero or a negative return to completing an academic program for students with a second-best nonacademic major. Most of the differences in adult earnings can be attributed to differences in occupation, and to a lesser extent, college major. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用断点回归设计研究高中专业如何影响成年后的收入。在瑞典，学生根据其偏好排名和九年级平均绩点于十年级被录取至不同专业。我们发现，工程、自然科学和商科专业的收入高于社会科学和人文学科，且专业特定回报也因次优选择的不同而变化。对于次优选择为非学术性专业的学生，完成学术项目的回报要么为零，要么为负。成年收入的大部分差异可归因于职业差异，其次才是大学专业差异。(JEL I21, I26, J24, J31)

records.title_en: The Effects of Working While in School: Evidence from Employment Lotteries
records.title_cn: 在校期间工作的影响：来自就业抽签的证据
records.abstract_en: Does working while in school smooth students’ transition into the labor market? We provide evidence on this question by leveraging a one-year work-study program that randomized job offers among over 90,000 student applicants in Uruguay. Program rules forbade employers from employing participants in the same job after program completion, and less than 5 percent of participants ever worked in the same firm again. Two years after the program, participants had 8 percent higher earnings. Our results suggest that the program’s focus on work-related skills was a key mechanism for earnings impacts. (JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 在校期间工作是否能使学生的劳动力市场过渡更加平稳？我们利用乌拉圭一个为期一年的勤工助学项目为这一问题提供了证据，该项目在超过90,000名申请学生中随机分配了工作机会。项目规则禁止雇主在项目结束后继续雇用参与者从事同一工作，且不到5%的参与者曾在同一家公司再次工作。项目结束两年后，参与者的收入提高了8%。我们的结果表明，该项目对工作相关技能的重视是影响收入的关键机制。（JEL I21, I26, J13, J24, J31, O15）

records.title_en: The Employee Costs of Corporate Debarment in Public Procurement
records.title_cn: 公共采购中企业禁入的员工成本
records.abstract_en: This paper studies an anticorruption policy—corporate debarment, or blacklisting—to understand how disclosing illicit corporate practices and the sanctions for these practices affect firm and worker outcomes. Exploiting a policy change in Brazil that imposed stricter penalties for corrupt firms, I find that debarment is associated with a sizable decline in employment and an increase in the probability of exiting the formal sector. I also document that workers’ annual earnings fall after debarment. The impacts are driven by lost revenues from government contracts. The results shed light on the costs to workers in weighing the consequences of corruption crackdown. (JEL D73, E26, H57, H83, J31, K42, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一项反腐败政策——企业禁入，或称黑名单——以理解披露非法企业行为及其制裁如何影响企业和工人结果。利用巴西一项对腐败企业施加更严厉处罚的政策变化，我发现禁入与就业的大幅下降和退出正规部门概率的增加相关。我还记录了工人在禁入后年收入下降。这些影响是由政府合同收入损失驱动的。结果揭示了工人在权衡反腐败打击后果时所承担的成本。(JEL D73, E26, H57, H83, J31, K42, O17)

records.title_en: The Economic Incidence of Wildfire Suppression in the United States
records.title_cn: 美国野火扑救的经济归宿
records.abstract_en: This study measures the degree to which public expenditures on wild-fire protection subsidize development in harm’s way. We use administrative data on firefighting expenditures to measure the causal effect of nearby homes on the amount spent to extinguish wildfires. We use these estimates in an actuarial calculation yielding geographically differentiated expected implicit subsidies for homes across the western United States. The expected net present value of this subsidy can exceed 20 percent of home value, increases with fire hazard, and decreases surprisingly steeply with development density. We discuss potential behavioral responses by individuals and local governments using a simple economic model. (JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究衡量了公共野火保护支出在多大程度上补贴了处于危险之中的开发。我们使用扑救支出的行政数据来衡量邻近房屋对扑灭野火支出金额的因果效应。我们利用这些估计进行精算计算，得出美国西部各地理差异化房屋的预期隐性补贴。该补贴的预期净现值可超过房屋价值的20%，随火灾危险增加而增加，并随开发密度增加而急剧下降。我们使用一个简单的经济模型讨论个人和地方政府的潜在行为反应。（JEL D91, Q23, Q54, R52, R58）

records.title_en: Wage Stagnation and the Decline of Standardized Pay Rates, 1974–1991
records.title_cn: 工资停滞与标准化工资率的下降，1974-1991
records.abstract_en: Using new establishment-by-occupation microdata, we show that the use of discretionary wage setting significantly expanded in the 1970s and 1980s. Increasingly, wages for blue-collar workers were not standardized by job title or seniority but instead subject to managerial discretion. When establishments abandoned standardized pay rates, wages fell, particularly for the lowest-paid workers in a job and for those in establishments that previously paid above market rates. This shift away from standardized pay rates, in context of a broader decline in worker bargaining power, accelerated the decline in real wages experienced by blue-collar workers in the 1980s. (JEL J31, J33, J52, M52, O33)
records.abstract_cn: 利用新的企业-职业微观数据，我们表明自由裁量工资设定的使用在1970年代和1980年代显著扩大。蓝领工人的工资越来越不按职位或资历标准化，而是受管理层自由裁量权支配。当企业放弃标准化工资率时，工资下降，尤其是对于工作中最低工资的工人以及那些先前支付高于市场工资的企业中的工人。这种从标准化工资率的转变，在工人议价能力更广泛下降的背景下，加速了1980年代蓝领工人实际工资的下降。(JEL J31, J33, J52, M52, O33)

records.title_en: Housing in Medicaid: Should It Really Change?
records.title_cn: 医疗补助中的住房：是否真的应该改变？
records.abstract_en: Housing is mostly exempted from Medicaid and Supplemental Social Insurance means tests. Reforms of this special treatment have been debated, but little is known about its costs, benefits, and redistributive implications. I estimate a life cycle model of single retirees accounting for this exemption. It shows that the homestead exemption explains important patterns of Medicaid recipiency and that it is highly valued. It also shows that estate recovery could cover most of its costs with possibly limited negative welfare consequences. Finally, the model predicts that removing the homestead exemption or enforcing estate recovery programs would reduce redistribution toward lower-income retirees. (JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 住房在医疗补助和补充社会保险的资产审查中大多被豁免。关于这种特殊待遇的改革一直存在争议，但对其成本、收益和再分配影响知之甚少。我估计了一个考虑这一豁免的单身退休人员生命周期模型。该模型表明，宅基地豁免解释了医疗补助领取的重要模式，并且其价值很高。它还表明，遗产追偿可以覆盖其大部分成本，且可能带来有限的负面福利后果。最后，模型预测，取消宅基地豁免或强制执行遗产追偿计划将减少对低收入退休人员的再分配。（JEL D15, G51, H51, I13, I18, I38, J26）

records.title_en: The Effect of Early Childhood Education on Adult Criminality: Evidence from the 1960s through 1990s
records.title_cn: 早期儿童教育对成人犯罪的影响：来自1960年至1990年的证据
records.abstract_en: We compare the effects of early childhood education on adult criminal behavior across time periods, using administrative crime data that provide significant precision advantages over existing work. We find that improvements in early childhood education led to large (20 percent) reductions in later criminal behavior, reductions that far exceed those implied by estimates of test score gains in prior studies. While the benefits generated account for a large portion of the costs of the education provided, we find substantial relative gains from the targeting of funds to high-poverty areas and areas without existing access to subsidized care. (JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 我们利用行政犯罪数据比较了不同时期早期儿童教育对成人犯罪行为的影响，这些数据相比现有研究具有显著的精度优势。我们发现，早期儿童教育的改善导致了后来犯罪行为的大幅减少（20%），这一减少幅度远超先前研究中基于考试成绩提升的估计所暗示的幅度。虽然所产生的收益占教育提供成本的很大一部分，但我们发现，将资金定向投入到高贫困地区以及没有现有补贴护理获取途径的地区，会带来可观的相对收益。（JEL H75, I21, I26, I28, I32, I38, K42）

records.title_en: Exploring Residual Profit Allocation
records.title_cn: 探索剩余利润分配
records.abstract_en: Residual profit allocation (RPA) schemes have come to prominence in discussions of international tax reform but with almost nothing known about their economic impact. These schemes tax multinationals by allocating their “routine” profits to source countries and sharing their remaining “residual” profit across countries on some formulaic basis. This paper explores the implications, conceptual and empirical, of moving to some form of RPA.
