Residual profits are estimated to be substantial and concentrated in relatively few multinational enterprises. The impact on tax revenue appears beneficial for developing countries. Aggregate production efficiency is unlikely to increase unless routine profits are lightly taxed. (JEL F23, H25, H87, L25)
records.abstract_cn: 剩余利润分配（RPA）方案在国际税收改革讨论中日益突出，但对其经济影响几乎一无所知。这些方案通过对跨国公司的“常规”利润在来源国征税，并基于某种公式化基础在各国间分享其剩余的“剩余”利润来对其征税。本文探讨了转向某种形式的RPA在概念上和实证上的影响。估计剩余利润规模可观，且集中在相对较少的跨国企业中。对税收收入的影响似乎有利于发展中国家。除非常规利润被轻税，否则总体生产效率不太可能提高。（JEL F23, H25, H87, L25）

records.title_en: Tax Audits as Scarecrows: Evidence from a Large-Scale Field Experiment
records.title_cn: 税收审计作为稻草人：来自大规模实地实验的证据
records.abstract_en: The canonical model of Allingham and Sandmo (1972) predicts that firms evade taxes by optimally trading off between the costs and benefits of evasion. However, there is no direct evidence that firms react to audits in this way. We conducted a large-scale field experiment in collaboration with a tax authority to address this question. We sent letters to 20,440 small- and medium-sized firms that collectively paid more than US$200 million in taxes per year. We find that providing information about audits significantly affected tax compliance but in a manner that was inconsistent with Allingham and Sandmo (1972). (JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14)
records.abstract_cn: Allingham和Sandmo（1972）的经典模型预测，企业通过最优权衡逃税的成本与收益来逃税。然而，没有直接证据表明企业以这种方式对审计做出反应。我们与税务机关合作进行了一项大规模实地实验来解决这个问题。我们向20,440家中小企业发送了信件，这些企业每年共同缴纳超过200万美元的税款。我们发现，提供审计信息显著影响了税收合规，但其方式与Allingham和Sandmo（1972）不一致。（JEL C93, D22, H25, H26, K34, L25, O14）

records.title_en: The Employment Effects of Countercyclical Public Investments
records.title_cn: 逆周期公共投资的就业效应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates the causal impact of a sizable German public investment program on employment at the county level. The program focused on improving the energy efficiency of school buildings, making it possible to use the number of schools as an instrument for investments. It also enforced tight deadlines, reducing potential implementation lags. The program was cost-effective, creating, on average, one job for one year for an investment of €24,000. The employment gains are detectable after nine months and are accompanied by an unemployment reduction amounting to half of the job creation. Employment grew predominately in the directly affected industries. (JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23)
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了一项规模可观的德国公共投资计划在县级层面对就业的因果影响。该计划侧重于提高学校建筑的能源效率，从而可以利用学校数量作为投资的工具变量。该计划还规定了严格的截止日期，减少了潜在的落实滞后。该计划具有成本效益，平均每投资24,000欧元即可创造一个持续一年的工作岗位。就业增长在九个月后即可检测到，并伴随着失业减少，其规模相当于新增就业的一半。就业增长主要发生在直接受影响的行业。（JEL E24, E32, E62, H54, J23, R23）

records.title_en: SOEs and Soft Incentive Constraints in State Bank Lending
records.title_cn: 国有企业与国有银行贷款中的软激励约束
records.abstract_en: We study how Chinese state bank managers’ lending incentives impact lending to state-owned enterprises (SOEs). We show lending quantity increases and quality decreases at month’s end, indicating monthly lending targets that decrease lending standards. Increased quantity comes from both SOEs and private lending, whereas decreased quality is from only SOEs, which continue to receive loans even after prior defaults (particularly at month’s end). We suggest that SOE lending may thus be beneficial for state bank managers, who lend to delinquent state enterprises to meet targets, which in turn may exacerbate SOEs’ soft budget constraints. (JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34).
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究中国国有银行经理的贷款激励如何影响对国有企业的贷款。我们发现在月末，贷款数量增加而质量下降，这表明月度贷款目标降低了贷款标准。数量的增加来自国有企业和私人贷款，而质量的下降仅来自国有企业，这些企业在先前违约后仍继续获得贷款（尤其是在月末）。我们认为，国有企业贷款可能因此对国有银行经理有利，他们向违约的国有企业放贷以达到目标，这反过来可能加剧国有企业的软预算约束。（JEL G21, G28, L32, O16, P34）。

records.title_en: Economic Effects of Environmental Crises: Evidence from Flint, Michigan
records.title_cn: 环境危机的经济影响：来自密歇根州弗林特的证据
records.abstract_en: In April 2014 Flint, Michigan switched its drinking water supply from the Detroit water system to the Flint River as a temporary means to save $5 million. Over 18 months it was revealed that the switch exposed residents to dangerous levels of lead, culminating in an emergency declaration in October 2015. This paper examines the impact of this crisis on the Flint housing market. The value of Flint’s housing stock has fallen by $520 million to $559 million despite over $400 million in remediation spending. Home prices remain depressed through August 2019, 16 months after the water was declared safe for consumption. (JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)
records.abstract_cn: 2014年四月，密歇根州弗林特市将其饮用水供应从底特律供水系统切换到弗林特河，作为节省5万美元的临时手段。18个月后，人们发现这一切换使居民暴露于危险水平的铅中，最终于2015年十月宣布进入紧急状态。本文考察了这一危机对弗林特住房市场的影响。尽管 remediation 支出超过520亿美元，弗林特住房存量的价值仍下降了559亿至400亿美元。在饮用水被宣布安全可饮用2019个月后，即截至16年八月，房价仍处于低迷状态。(JEL H12, I12, Q25, Q51, Q53, R31)

records.title_en: The Extension of Credit with Nonexclusive Contracts and Sequential Banking Externalities
records.title_cn: 非排他性合约与顺序银行外部性下的信贷扩展
records.abstract_en: Nonexclusive sequential borrowing can increase default and impose externalities on prior lenders. We document that sequential banking is pervasive with substantial effects. Using credit card applications from a large bank and data on the applicants’ entire loan portfolios, we find that an additional credit line causes a 5.9 percentage point decline in default for high-score borrowers on previous loans. However, for low-score borrowers, it causes a 19 percentage point increase. The former use the new credit to smooth payments on preexisting loans, while the latter increase their total debt. These results have implications for “ no-universal-default” regulation and financial inclusion. (JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)
records.abstract_cn: 非排他性的顺序借款可能增加违约并对先前的贷款人施加外部性。我们记录了顺序银行普遍存在且具有实质性影响。利用一家大型银行的信用卡申请数据以及申请人全部贷款组合的数据，我们发现，对于高信用评分借款人，额外的一条信用额度导致先前贷款的违约率下降5.9个百分点。然而，对于低信用评分借款人，它导致违约率上升19个百分点。前者利用新信贷来平滑先前贷款的还款，而后者则增加了其总债务。这些结果对“非普遍违约”监管和金融包容性具有启示意义。(JEL D62, D82, G21, G51)

records.title_en: Expanding Access to Clean Water for the Rural Poor: Experimental Evidence from Malawi
records.title_cn: 扩大农村贫困人口获得清洁用水的途径：来自马拉维的实验证据
records.abstract_en: Data from an 18-month randomized trial show large and sustained impacts on water purification and child health of a program providing monthly coupons for free water treatment solution to households with young children. The program is more effective and much more cost effective than asking Community Health Workers (CHWs) to distribute free chlorine to households during routine monthly visits. This is because only 40 percent of households use free chlorine, targeting through CHWs is worse than self-targeting through coupon redemption, and water treatment promotion by CHWs does not increase chlorine use among beneficiaries of free chlorine. (JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53)
records.abstract_cn: 一项为期18个月的随机试验数据显示，一项为有幼儿家庭提供免费水处理溶液月度优惠券的计划，对水净化和儿童健康产生了显著且持续的影响。该计划比要求社区卫生工作者（CHWs）在常规月度家访期间向家庭分发免费氯更有效，且成本效益更高。这是因为只有40%的家庭使用了免费氯，通过社区卫生工作者进行定向投放不如通过优惠券兑换实现自我定向，且社区卫生工作者进行的水处理推广并未提高免费氯受益者中氯的使用率。（JEL I12, I18, J13, O12, O13, Q53）

records.title_en: Employed in a SNAP? The Impact of Work Requirements on Program Participation and Labor Supply
records.title_cn: 在SNAP中就业？工作要求对项目参与和劳动力供给的影响
records.abstract_en: Work requirements are common in US safety net programs. Evidence remains limited, however, on the extent to which work requirements increase economic self-sufficiency or screen out vulnerable individuals. Using linked administrative data on food stamps (SNAP) and earnings with a regression discontinuity design, we find robust evidence that work requirements increase program exits by 23 percentage points (64 percent) among incumbent participants. Overall program participation among adults who are subject to work requirements is reduced by 53 percent. Homeless adults are disproportionately screened out. We find no effects on employment and suggestive evidence of increased earnings in some specifications. (JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 工作要求在美国安全网项目中很常见。然而，关于工作要求在多大程度上提高经济自给自足或筛选出弱势个体的证据仍然有限。利用食品券（SNAP）和收入的关联行政数据以及断点回归设计，我们发现强有力的证据表明，工作要求使现有参与者的项目退出率增加了23个百分点（64%）。在受工作要求约束的成年人中，总体项目参与率降低了53%。无家可归的成年人被不成比例地筛选出去。我们发现对就业没有影响，并且在某些规格中暗示收入增加的证据。（JEL H75, I18, I32, I38, J22, J31）

records.title_en: Implications of Tax Loss Asymmetry for Owners of S Corporations
records.title_cn: 税收损失不对称对S公司所有者的影响
records.abstract_en: We study tax loss asymmetry for S corporate owners. These owners use most losses contemporaneously, reducing the tax asymmetry compared to C corporations. However, these owners face distortions due to the progressive individual tax schedule. The value of this asymmetry is approximately $3.5 billion per year. We find that this asymmetry creates disincentives for risky investment and causes allocative inefficiencies among loss and gains owners. Finally, we simulate the effects of certain provisions of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act; we estimate that these provisions—especially section 199A—reduce the behavioral distortions of the asymmetry for S corporate owners. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了S公司所有者的税收损失不对称性。这些所有者当期使用大部分损失，与C公司相比减少了税收不对称性。然而，这些所有者面临累进个人税表造成的扭曲。这种不对称的价值约为每年3.5亿美元。我们发现，这种不对称对风险投资产生了抑制作用，并导致损失和收益所有者之间的配置无效率。最后，我们模拟了《减税与就业法案》某些条款的影响；我们估计这些条款——尤其是第199A条——减少了S公司所有者不对称性的行为扭曲。(JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, K34)

records.title_en: Health Effects of Increasing Income for the Elderly: Evidence from a Chilean Pension Program
records.title_cn: 增加老年人收入对健康的影响：来自智利养老金计划的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effect of a permanent income increase on the health outcomes of the elderly poor. Our regression discontinuity design exploits an eligibility cutoff in a Chilean basic pension program that grants monthly payments to retirees without a contributory pension. Using administrative data, we find that four years after applying, basic pension recipients are 2.7 percentage points less likely to have died. Survey evidence suggests an increase in food consumption and visits to health centers as relevant drivers of the mortality reduction. (JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了永久性收入增加对贫困老年人健康结果的影响。我们的断点回归设计利用了智利基本养老金计划中的资格截止点，该计划向没有缴费型养老金的退休人员提供每月支付。使用行政数据，我们发现申请四年后，基本养老金领取者的死亡可能性降低了2.7个百分点。调查证据表明，食品消费和健康中心就诊的增加是死亡率降低的相关驱动因素。（JEL D63, G51, I12, I14, I38, J14, O15）

records.title_en: The Economic Consequences of Being Denied an Abortion
records.title_cn: 被拒绝堕胎的经济后果
records.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the financial and economic consequences of being denied an abortion. We link credit report data to the Turnaway Study, which collected high-quality, longitudinal data on women receiving or being denied a wanted abortion in the United States. We compare financial outcomes over a ten-year period for women who had pregnancies just above and below a gestational age limit allowing for a wanted abortion. Outcomes evolved similarly for the two groups prior to the abortion encounter. Following the encounter, women who were denied an abortion experience a large increase in financial distress that remains for several years. (JEL G51, I18, J13, J16)
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了被拒绝堕胎的财务和经济后果。我们将信用报告数据与Turnaway研究相关联，该研究收集了美国接受或拒绝想要堕胎的女性的高质量纵向数据。我们比较了妊娠年龄限制略高于和略低于允许想要堕胎的女性在十年期间的财务结果。在堕胎遭遇之前，两组的结果演变相似。在遭遇之后，被拒绝堕胎的女性经历了财务困境的大幅增加，这种困境持续了数年。（JEL G51, I18, J13, J16）

records.title_en: School Boards and Education Production: Evidence from Randomized Ballot Order
records.title_cn: 学校董事会与教育生产：来自随机选票顺序的证据
records.abstract_en: We examine the causal influence of educators elected to the school board on local education production. The key empirical challenge is that school board composition is endogenously determined through the electoral process. To overcome this, we develop a novel research design that leverages California’s randomized assignment of the order that candidate names appear on election ballots. We find that an additional educator elected to the school board reduces charter schooling and increases teacher salaries in the school district relative to other board members. We interpret these findings as consistent with educator board members shifting bargaining in favor of teachers’ unions. (JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们考察了当选为学校董事会的教育工作者对当地教育生产的因果影响。关键的经验挑战在于，学校董事会的构成是通过选举过程内生决定的。为了克服这一点，我们开发了一种新颖的研究设计，利用加利福尼亚州对候选人姓名在选举选票上出现顺序的随机分配。我们发现，相对于其他董事会成员，每多一位教育工作者当选为学校董事会成员，会减少特许学校教育并增加学区的教师工资。我们将这些发现解释为与教育工作者董事会成员将谈判转向有利于教师工会的方向一致。(JEL D72, H75, I21, J31, J45, J51)

records.title_en: What Does a Provider Network Do? Evidence from Random Assignment in Medicaid Managed Care
records.title_cn: 提供者网络的作用是什么？来自医疗补助管理护理随机分配的证据
records.abstract_en: Leveraging the random assignment of over 50,000 Medicaid enrollees in New York, I present causal evidence that narrower networks are a blunt instrument for reducing health care spending. While narrower networks constrain spending, they do so by generating hassle costs that reduce quantity, with modest effects on prices paid to providers. Enrollees assigned to narrower networks use fewer of both needed and unneeded services and are less satisfied with their plans. Using my causal estimates to construct counterfactuals, I identify an alternative assignment policy that reduces spending without harming satisfaction by matching consumers with narrower networks that include their providers. (JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)
records.abstract_cn: 利用纽约超过50,000名医疗补助参保者的随机分配，我提供了因果证据表明，较窄的网络是减少医疗保健支出的一个粗略工具。虽然较窄的网络限制了支出，但这是通过产生麻烦成本来减少数量，而对支付给提供者的价格影响不大。被分配到较窄网络的参保者使用的必要和非必要服务都较少，并且对计划的满意度较低。利用我的因果估计构建反事实，我确定了一种替代分配政策，该政策通过将消费者与包含其提供者的较窄网络匹配，在不损害满意度的情况下减少支出。(JEL H51, H75, I13, I18, I38)

records.title_en: Student Performance, Peer Effects, and Friend Networks: Evidence from a Randomized Peer Intervention
records.title_cn: 学生表现、同伴效应与朋友网络：来自随机同伴干预的证据
records.abstract_en: We estimate the effects of an educational peer intervention in which previously high- and low-achieving students are randomly paired as deskmates in elementary schools in China. Our treatment boosts the mathematics scores of the low-achieving students. Moreover, the treatment enhances the extraversion and agreeableness of high- and low-achieving students, thereby providing evidence that peers can influence personality traits. The positive treatment effects can be attributed to the deskmate-level peer effects. We document friend network structure changes and present additional evidence on how friendship ties help us better understand the mechanisms behind peer effects. (JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们估计了一项教育同伴干预的效果，在该干预中，中国小学中先前成绩高和成绩低的学生被随机配对为同桌。我们的处理提高了低成就学生的数学成绩。此外，该处理增强了高成就和低成就学生的外向性和宜人性，从而提供了同伴可以影响人格特质的证据。积极处理效应可归因于同桌层面的同伴效应。我们记录了朋友网络结构的变化，并提供了关于友谊联系如何帮助我们更好地理解同伴效应背后机制的额外证据。(JEL I21, I26, J24, O15, P36, Z13)

records.title_en: Price Transparency, Media, and Informative Advertising
records.title_cn: 价格透明度、媒体与信息性广告
records.abstract_en: We study the effects of a price transparency regulation in Israeli supermarkets. Using price data collected before and after the regulation and a difference-in-difference research design, we show that price levels and price dispersion declined significantly after the regulation. Chains also began setting identical prices in all stores. We use Robert and Stahl (1993) to interpret our findings, showing that low-priced chains extensively used price advertising after prices became transparent. These chains referenced price-comparison surveys conducted by the media to induce credibility for ads. Our findings highlight the importance of price transparency and the procompetitive role of informative advertising. (JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了以色列超市价格透明度监管的影响。利用监管前后收集的价格数据和双重差分研究设计，我们表明监管后价格水平和价格离散度显著下降。连锁店也开始在所有门店设定相同的价格。我们使用Robert和Stahl（1993）来解释我们的发现，表明低价连锁店在价格变得透明后广泛使用价格广告。这些连锁店引用媒体进行的价格比较调查以增强广告的可信度。我们的发现强调了价格透明度的重要性以及信息性广告的促进竞争作用。（JEL D22, D83, L11, L81, L82, L88, M37）

records.title_en: Compatibility Choices, Switching Costs, and Data Portability
records.title_cn: 兼容性选择、转换成本与数据可携性
records.abstract_en: We study mix-and-match compatibility choices of firms selling complementary products in a dynamic setting. Contrary to what happens in a static setting where symmetric firms choose compatibility (Matutes and Regibeau 1988), when switching costs are high and firms make price discrimination based on past purchases, symmetric firms choose incompatibility to soften future competition if the discount factor is large, which harms consumers. Interoperability increases consumer surplus at least for high switching costs. Data portability, by reducing switching costs, induces the firms to choose compatibility more often but, given a compatibility regime, benefits consumers only if a nonnegative pricing constraint binds. (JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在动态环境中销售互补产品的企业的混合搭配兼容性选择。与静态环境中对称企业选择兼容性的情况（Matutes和Regibeau 1988）相反，当转换成本较高且企业基于过去的购买行为进行价格歧视时，如果贴现因子较大，对称企业会选择不兼容以缓和未来竞争，这损害了消费者利益。互操作性至少在高转换成本下增加了消费者剩余。数据可携性通过降低转换成本，促使企业更频繁地选择兼容性，但在给定的兼容性制度下，只有在非负定价约束起作用时才对消费者有利。（JEL D11, D21, D43, D82, L86）

records.title_en: Alert the Inert? Switching Costs and Limited Awareness in Retail Electricity Markets
records.title_cn: 唤醒惰性？零售电力市场中的转换成本与有限认知
records.abstract_en: We quantify how switching costs and limited awareness affect consumer inertia in liberalized retail electricity markets by developing and estimating a structural demand model using a novel dataset on electricity contract choices in Belgium. Our data allow us to disentangle different sources of inertia by using a rich combination of macromoments and micromoments. We find that consumers perceive contracts as differentiated and both limited awareness and switching costs hinder efficient choices. Our counterfactuals reveal substantial welfare gains from alleviating both frictions, in particular switching costs, and that a well-regulated monopoly can generate similar consumer surplus as the current deregulated market. (JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98)
records.abstract_cn: 我们通过开发并估计一个结构需求模型，利用比利时电力合同选择的新数据集，量化了转换成本和有限认知如何影响自由化零售电力市场中的消费者惰性。我们的数据使我们能够通过宏观时刻和微观时刻的丰富组合来区分惰性的不同来源。我们发现消费者认为合同是有差异的，并且有限认知和转换成本都阻碍了有效选择。我们的反事实分析揭示了缓解这两种摩擦（尤其是转换成本）所带来的巨大福利收益，并且一个监管良好的垄断企业可以产生与当前放松管制市场相似的消费者剩余。（JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98）

records.title_en: Product Quality and Consumer Search
records.title_cn: 产品质量与消费者搜索
records.abstract_en: An increase in quality shifts up the distribution of match utilities offered by firms and makes consumers pickier. The number of products that consumers inspect does not necessarily increase in quality. Higher search costs may lead to less quality investment, and the equilibrium price may decrease. If the equilibrium is inefficient, it is because of the inadequacy of quality investment. The market level of quality investment is excessive (insufficient) and consumers are too (little) picky from the point of view of welfare maximization if and only if a rise in quality results in consumers inspecting a higher (lower) number of products. (JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 质量的提高会使企业提供的匹配效用的分布上移，并使消费者变得更加挑剔。消费者检查的产品数量不一定随质量提高而增加。较高的搜索成本可能导致较低的质量投资，均衡价格可能下降。如果均衡是无效率的，那是因为质量投资不足。从福利最大化的角度看，当且仅当质量提高导致消费者检查更多（更少）的产品时，市场质量投资水平是过度（不足）的，消费者过于（不够）挑剔。（JEL D11, D21, D83, G31, L15）

records.title_en: Primary-Market Auctions for Event Tickets: Eliminating the Rents of “Bob the Broker”?
records.title_cn: 活动门票的一级市场拍卖：消除“黄牛鲍勃”的租金？
records.abstract_en: Economists have long been puzzled by event-ticket underpricing: underpricing reduces revenue for the performer and encourages socially wasteful rent-seeking by ticket brokers. What about using an auction? This paper studies the introduction of auctions into this market by Ticketmaster in the mid-2000s. By combining primary-market auction data from Ticketmaster with secondary-market resale value data from eBay, we show that Ticketmaster’s auctions “worked”: they substantially improved price discovery, roughly doubled performer revenues, and, on average, nearly eliminated the potential arbitrage profits associated with underpriced tickets. We conclude by discussing why, nevertheless, the auctions failed to take off. (JEL D44, D47, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 经济学家长期以来对活动门票定价偏低感到困惑：定价偏低降低了表演者的收入，并鼓励了票务黄牛进行社会浪费的寻租行为。那么使用拍卖会怎样呢？本文研究了Ticketmaster在2000年代中期将拍卖引入这一市场的情况。通过将Ticketmaster的一级市场拍卖数据与eBay的二级市场转售价值数据相结合，我们表明Ticketmaster的拍卖“奏效了”：它们显著改善了价格发现，大致使表演者收入翻倍，并且平均而言，几乎消除了与定价偏低门票相关的潜在套利利润。最后，我们讨论了为什么尽管如此，拍卖未能普及。（JEL D44, D47, L82）

records.title_en: Misbehavior in Common Value Auctions: Bidding Rings and Shills
records.title_cn: 共同价值拍卖中的不当行为：竞标联盟与托儿
records.abstract_en: We characterize the optimal misbehavior by bidding rings or an auctioneer in the ascending English auction with common values. We also show, in an extended game, that in equilibrium potential members join and truthfully reveal their signals. Under a separability assumption, behavior does not change if nonring bidders are informed about the ring’s existence. In general, misbehavior in dynamic settings is more profitable than in outcome-equivalent static settings. However, under a stronger separability assumption, the ring can do no better in the dynamic English format than in the outcome-equivalent, static Sophi format. (JEL D44, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了在具有共同价值的升序英式拍卖中，竞标联盟或拍卖师的最优不当行为。我们还证明，在扩展博弈中，均衡状态下潜在成员会加入并如实透露其信号。在可分离性假设下，如果非联盟竞标者知晓联盟的存在，行为不会改变。一般而言，动态环境中的不当行为比结果等价的静态环境中更有利可图。然而，在更强的可分离性假设下，联盟在动态英式拍卖中的表现不会优于结果等价的静态Sophi拍卖。（JEL D44, D82）

records.title_en: Contest Design with Stochastic Performance
records.title_cn: 随机绩效下的竞赛设计
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal contest design in contests with noisy performance. Here, contest design is a team moral hazard problem that endogenizes the assignment rule that maps performance profiles into winning probabilities. The optimal design features endogenous standards for eligibility, and the number of prizes that are awarded may be stochastic. Generally, one group of agents is identified as “first claimants” of prizes, contingent on performance exceeding a threshold of excellence. However, which group wins prizes more often depends on the designer’s objective function and the performance technologies. Finally, the approach derives endogenous, microfounded, and fully optimal contest success functions. (JEL D44, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在具有噪声绩效的竞赛中的最优竞赛设计。在此，竞赛设计是一个团队道德风险问题，它将绩效概况映射到获胜概率的分配规则内生化。最优设计具有内生性的资格标准，且授予的奖品数量可能是随机的。通常，一组代理人被认定为奖品的“第一索取者”，取决于绩效是否超过卓越阈值。然而，哪一组更频繁地赢得奖品取决于设计者的目标函数和绩效技术。最后，该方法推导出内生的、基于微观基础的、完全最优的竞赛成功函数。（JEL D44, D82）

records.title_en: Two-Stage Contests with Private Information
records.title_cn: 两阶段私人信息竞赛
records.abstract_en: In perfectly discriminating contests with private information, low-ability contestants prefer to appear strong, while high-ability contestants prefer to appear weak. In a two-stage contest, this leads to a unique symmetric equilibrium with partial pooling in the first stage. A higher output in the first contest leads to a weakly higher belief about the contestant’s ability entering the second contest. We characterize this unique equilibrium when cost of effort is linear and show how the prize allocation and type distribution impact contestants’ expected output, payoffs, and the probability of surprise victories. (JEL D44, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 在具有私人信息的完全歧视性竞赛中，低能力参赛者倾向于表现强大，而高能力参赛者倾向于表现弱小。在两阶段竞赛中，这导致第一阶段存在部分混同的唯一对称均衡。第一次竞赛中的更高产出导致进入第二次竞赛时对参赛者能力的信念弱更高。我们刻画了当努力成本为线性时的这一唯一均衡，并展示了奖金分配和类型分布如何影响参赛者的预期产出、收益以及意外胜利的概率。（JEL D44, D82, D83）

records.title_en: A Theory of Stability in Matching with Incomplete Information
records.title_cn: 不完全信息匹配中的稳定性理论
records.abstract_en: We provide a framework for studying two-sided matching markets with incomplete information. The framework accommodates two-sided incomplete information as well as heterogeneous information among the agents. We propose a notion called stability for a market state, which, based upon agents’ information structure, requires (i) individual rationality, (ii) no blocking, and (iii) information stability. The novelty of our stability notion lies in how the agents evaluate a blocking prospect in the presence of general two-sided incomplete information. We show that a stable state exists; moreover, if a state is stable, then coarsening agents’ information leads to another stable state. (JEL C78, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了一个研究具有不完全信息的双边匹配市场的框架。该框架既适应双边不完全信息，也适应代理人之间的异质信息。我们提出了一个称为市场状态稳定性的概念，基于代理人的信息结构，要求（i）个体理性，（ii）无阻塞，以及（iii）信息稳定性。我们稳定性概念的新颖之处在于，在存在一般双边不完全信息的情况下，代理人如何评估阻塞前景。我们证明了稳定状态的存在；此外，如果一个状态是稳定的，那么对代理人信息进行粗化会导致另一个稳定状态。（JEL C78, D83）

records.title_en: An Information Theory of Efficient Differential Treatment
records.title_cn: 有效差别待遇的信息理论
records.abstract_en: When are differential treatment policies—such as preferential treatment, affirmative action, and gender equity policies—justified by efficiency concerns? I propose a nonparametric assignment model where a policymaker assigns agents to different treatments or positions to maximize total surplus, based on the agents’ characteristics and noisy information about their types. I provide necessary and sufficient conditions on the agents’ signal structures, which characterize whether surplus maximization requires differential treatment or not, and study how the bias and informativeness of signal structures determine the efficiency implications of differential treatment. I examine implications of this model for inequality, decentralization, and empirical work. (JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71)
records.abstract_cn: 差别待遇政策——如优惠待遇、平权行动和性别平等政策——何时因效率考虑而合理？我提出了一个非参数分配模型，其中政策制定者根据代理人的特征及其类型的噪声信息，将代理人分配到不同的待遇或职位以最大化总剩余。我提供了关于代理人信号结构的必要且充分条件，这些条件刻画了剩余最大化是否需要差别待遇，并研究了信号结构的偏差和信息量如何决定差别待遇的效率含义。我考察了该模型对不平等、分权化和实证工作的启示。（JEL D63, D82, D83, I23, I24, J71）

records.title_en: Dynamic Information Design under Constrained Communication Rules
records.title_cn: 受约束沟通规则下的动态信息设计
records.abstract_en: An information designer wishes to persuade agents to invest in a project of unknown quality. To do so, she must induce investment and collect feedback from these investments. Motivated by data regulations and simplicity concerns, our designer faces communication constraints. These constraints hinder her without benefiting the agents: they impose an upper bound on the induced belief spread, limiting persuasion. Nevertheless, two-rating systems (direct recommendations) are the optimal design when experimentation is needed to generate information and approximate the designer’s first-best payoff for specific feedback structures. When the designer has altruistic motives, constrained rules significantly decrease welfare. (JEL D64, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 一位信息设计者希望说服代理人投资于一个质量未知的项目。为此，她必须诱导投资并从这些投资中收集反馈。出于数据监管和简洁性的考虑，我们的设计者面临沟通约束。这些约束阻碍了她而不利于代理人：它们对诱导信念的扩散施加了上限，限制了说服力。然而，当需要实验来生成信息并为特定反馈结构近似设计者的最优收益时，两级评级系统（直接推荐）是最优设计。当设计者具有利他动机时，受约束的规则会显著降低福利。（JEL D64, D82, D83）

records.title_en: Sequential Learning
records.title_cn: 序贯学习
records.abstract_en: We develop a model in which two players sequentially and publicly examine a project. In our model the player who moves first can fabricate evidence to influence the second mover, which creates a moral hazard problem. We find that early strategic uncertainty can mitigate this problem. In particular, for intermediate prior beliefs about the project’s quality, the Pareto-dominant equilibrium is in mixed strategies and consists of an early stage in which evidence may be fabricated and a later stage in which evidence is always authentic. Our findings shed light on the dynamics of R&D, quality assurance, and drug approval. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，其中两个参与者序贯且公开地审查一个项目。在我们的模型中，先行动者可以伪造证据以影响后行动者，这产生了道德风险问题。我们发现，早期的战略不确定性可以缓解这一问题。特别是，对于关于项目质量的中等先验信念，帕累托占优均衡是混合策略均衡，包括一个可能伪造证据的早期阶段和一个证据始终真实的后期阶段。我们的发现揭示了研发、质量保证和药物批准的动态。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

records.title_en: When Is a Contrarian Adviser Optimal?
records.title_cn: 何时逆势顾问是最优的？
records.abstract_en: We compare contrarian to conformist advice, a contrarian expert being one whose preference bias is against the decision-maker’s prior optimal decision. Optimality of an expert depends on characteristics of prior information and learning. If either the expert is fully informed or fine information can be acquired cheaply, then for symmetric distributions F of the state, a conformist (contrarian) is superior if F is single peaked (bimodal). If only coarse information can be acquired, then a contrarian acquires more on average and hence is superior. If information is verifiable, a contrarian has less incentive to hide unfavorable evidence and again is superior. (JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94)
records.abstract_cn: 我们比较了逆势建议与顺势建议，逆势专家是指其偏好偏差与决策者先验最优决策相反的专家。专家的最优性取决于先验信息和学习的特点。如果专家完全知情或者可以廉价获取精细信息，那么对于状态的对称分布F，如果F是单峰的（双峰的），则顺势（逆势）顾问更优。如果只能获取粗略信息，则逆势顾问平均获取更多信息，因此更优。如果信息是可验证的，则逆势顾问隐藏不利证据的激励较小，同样更优。（JEL D72, D82, D83, G34, H71, I12, L94）

records.title_en: Debunking Rumors in Networks
records.title_cn: 揭穿网络中的谣言
records.abstract_en: We study the diffusion of a true and a false message (the rumor) in a social network. Upon hearing a message, individuals may believe it, disbelieve it, or debunk it through costly verification. Whenever the truth survives in steady state, so does the rumor. Communication intensity in itself is irrelevant for relative rumor prevalence, and the effect of homophily depends on the exact verification process and equilibrium verification rates. Our model highlights that successful policies in the fight against rumors increase individuals’ incentives to verify. (JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究真实信息和虚假信息（谣言）在社交网络中的传播。听到信息后，个体可能相信、不相信或通过昂贵的信息核实来揭穿它。只要真相在稳态下存续，谣言也会存续。沟通强度本身与谣言的相对流行度无关，而同质性的影响取决于具体的核实过程和均衡核实率。我们的模型强调，打击谣言的成功政策会增加个体核实的激励。（JEL D83, D85, L82, Z13）

records.title_en: Censorship and Reputation
records.title_cn: 审查与声誉
records.abstract_en: I study how a firm manages its reputation by both investing in the quality of its product and censoring, hiding bad news from consumers. Without censorship, the threat of bad news provides strong incentives for investment. I highlight discontinuities in the firm’s maximum equilibrium payoff that censorship creates. When censorship is inexpensive, the firm never invests and a patient firm’s payoffs approach the lowest possible. In contrast, when censorship is moderately expensive, there exist equilibria where product quality is persistently high and payoffs approach the first-best, which can exceed the maximum equilibrium payoff if it was unable to censor. (JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究企业如何通过投资于产品质量和审查（即向消费者隐藏坏消息）来管理其声誉。在没有审查的情况下，坏消息的威胁为投资提供了强有力的激励。我强调了审查给企业最大均衡收益带来的不连续性。当审查成本低廉时，企业从不投资，耐心企业的收益接近最低可能水平。相反，当审查成本适中时，存在产品质量持续高且收益接近最优的均衡，这可能超过无法审查时的最大均衡收益。（JEL D21, D82, D83, G31, G32, L15）

records.title_en: Togetherness in the Household
records.title_cn: 家庭中的共处
records.abstract_en: Spending time with a spouse is a major gain from marriage. We extend the classical collective model of the household to allow for togetherness between spouses. Togetherness takes the form of joint leisure and joint care for children. Using revealed preference conditions and Dutch data over the years 2009–2012, we find that households are willing to pay €1.20 per hour—10 percent of the average wage—to convert private leisure to joint leisure and €2.10 per hour to convert private childcare to joint childcare. Our results suggest togetherness is an important component of household time use despite being overlooked in the economics literature. (JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)
records.abstract_cn: 与配偶共度时光是婚姻的一大收益。我们将经典的家庭集体模型扩展，允许配偶之间的共处。共处表现为共同休闲和共同照顾孩子。利用显示性偏好条件和荷兰2009-2012年的数据，我们发现家庭愿意为将私人休闲转换为共同休闲支付每小时1.20欧元——占平均工资的10%——以及为将私人育儿转换为共同育儿支付每小时2.10欧元。我们的结果表明，尽管共处在经济学文献中被忽视，但它是家庭时间使用的重要组成部分。(JEL D12, D13, J12, J13, J16, J22)

records.title_en: Ten Isn’t Large! Group Size and Coordination in a Large-Scale Experiment
records.title_cn: 十并不大！大规模实验中的群体规模与协调
records.abstract_en: We provide experimental evidence on coordination within large groups that could proxy the atomistic nature of real-world markets. We use a bank run game where the two pure-strategy equilibria can be ranked by payoff and risk dominance and a sequence of public announcements introduces stochastic sunspot equilibria. We find systematic group size effects that theory fails to predict. When the payoff-dominant strategy is risky enough, the behavior of small groups is uninformative of the behavior in large groups: unlike smaller groups of size ten, larger groups exclusively coordinate on the Pareto-inferior strategy and never coordinate on sunspots. (JEL C92, D83, D91, G21)
records.abstract_cn: 我们提供了关于大群体内协调的实验证据，这些群体可以代表现实世界市场的原子性质。我们使用一个银行挤兑博弈，其中两个纯策略均衡可以按支付和风险优势排序，一系列公开公告引入了随机太阳黑子均衡。我们发现了理论无法预测的系统性群体规模效应。当支付占优策略足够有风险时，小群体的行为无法反映大群体的行为：与规模为十的较小群体不同，较大群体完全协调于帕累托劣势策略，并且从不协调于太阳黑子。（JEL C92, D83, D91, G21）

records.title_en: The Effects of Time Preferences on Cooperation: Experimental Evidence from Infinitely Repeated Games
records.title_cn: 时间偏好对合作的影响：来自无限重复博弈的实验证据
records.abstract_en: This paper studies the effects of time preferences on cooperation in an infinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemma game experiment. Subjects play repeated games in the lab, all decisions at once, but stage game payoffs are paid over an extended period of time. Changing the time window of stage game payoffs (weekly or monthly) varies discount factors, and a delay for the first-stage game payoffs eliminates/weakens present bias. First, subjects with weekly payments cooperate more than subjects with monthly payments—higher discount factors promote greater cooperation. Second, the rate of cooperation is higher when there is a delay—present bias reduces cooperation. (JEL C72, C73, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 本文通过无限重复囚徒困境博弈实验研究时间偏好对合作的影响。受试者在实验室中进行重复博弈，所有决策一次性做出，但阶段博弈收益在较长时间内分期支付。改变阶段博弈收益的时间窗口（每周或每月）会改变贴现因子，而第一阶段博弈收益的延迟支付则消除或削弱了现时偏误。首先，每周支付的受试者比每月支付的受试者合作更多——更高的贴现因子促进更多合作。其次，存在延迟时合作率更高——现时偏误降低合作。（JEL C72, C73, D91）

records.title_en: Implications of Unequal Discounting in Dynamic Contracting
records.title_cn: 动态契约中不等贴现的含义
records.abstract_en: This paper studies a canonical dynamic screening problem where the agent has Markovian private information and limited commitment and the principal and the agent have different discount factors. Unequal discounting captures unequal access to capital markets. In comparison to standard models of dynamic mechanism design, the principal no longer finds it optimal to maximally back-load the agent’s information rents: a new force of inter-temporal cost of incentive provision pushes toward front-loading agents’ payoffs. The optimal contract settles into a cycle with infinite memory. The introduction of unequal discounting renders the standard relaxed-problem approach invalid for certain parameters. A simple and approximately optimal contract is then provided. (JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个典型的动态筛选问题，其中代理人具有马尔可夫私人信息和有限承诺，且委托人与代理人具有不同的贴现因子。不等贴现反映了进入资本市场的机会不平等。与标准动态机制设计模型相比，委托人不再认为最大化地延迟代理人的信息租金是最优的：一种新的跨期激励提供成本力量推动代理人报酬的前置。最优契约进入一个具有无限记忆的周期。不等贴现的引入使得标准的松弛问题方法在某些参数下失效。随后提供了一个简单且近似最优的契约。（JEL D21, D61, D82, D86, L14）

records.title_en: Moral Hazard and Efficiency in a Frictional Market
records.title_cn: 摩擦市场中的道德风险与效率
records.abstract_en: Principals seek to trade with homogeneous agents by posting incentive contracts, which direct their search. Search and moral hazard interact in equilibrium. If using transfers to compensate agents failing to contract, the equilibrium allocation is always constrained-welfare-optimal in contrast to the one-to-one principal-agent problem. Search frictions thus correct that inefficiency because search requires internalizing the utility of agents. Incentives are weaker than in bilateral contracting, and agents enjoy more efficient risk sharing. With a constraint on transfers the allocation may become inefficient; principal competition results in overinsurance of the agents, too little effort in equilibrium, and excessive entry by principals. (JEL D82, D83, D86)
records.abstract_cn: 委托人通过发布激励合同来寻求与同质代理人交易，这些合同引导着他们的搜索。搜索与道德风险在均衡中相互作用。如果使用转移支付来补偿未能签约的代理人，均衡配置总是受约束的福利最优，这与一对一的委托-代理问题形成对比。因此，搜索摩擦纠正了这种无效率，因为搜索要求内化代理人的效用。激励比双边缔约时更弱，代理人享受更有效的风险分担。在转移支付受限的情况下，配置可能变得无效率；委托人竞争导致对代理人的过度保险、均衡中的努力不足以及委托人的过度进入。（JEL D82, D83, D86）

records.title_en: Sin Taxes and Self-Control
records.title_cn: 罪恶税与自我控制
records.abstract_en: According to theory, “sin taxes” are welfare improving if consumers with low self-control respond at least as much to the tax as consumers with high self-control. We investigate empirically if demand response to soft drink and fat tax variations in Denmark depends on consumers’ self-control. We use a unique home-scan panel that includes a survey measure of self-control. When taxes increase, consumers with low self-control reduce purchases less strongly than consumers with high self-control. When taxes decrease, both groups increase their purchases similarly. The results show an asymmetry in price elasticities by self-control that is more pronounced when taxes increase. (JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)
records.abstract_cn: 根据理论，如果自我控制能力低的消费者对税收的反应至少与自我控制能力高的消费者一样大，那么“罪恶税”就能提高福利。我们通过实证研究，探讨丹麦软饮料税和脂肪税的变化对消费者需求的影响是否取决于消费者的自我控制能力。我们使用了一个独特的家庭扫描面板，其中包含自我控制的调查测量。当税收增加时，自我控制能力低的消费者减少购买的程度低于自我控制能力高的消费者。当税收减少时，两组消费者的购买增加情况相似。结果表明，价格弹性在自我控制方面存在不对称性，这种不对称性在税收增加时更为明显。(JEL D12, D91, H25, H31, I12, I18, L66)

records.title_en: Special Economic Zones and Human Capital Investment: 30 Years of Evidence from China
records.title_cn: 经济特区与人力资本投资：来自中国的30年证据
records.abstract_en: By exploiting the large quantity and rich variety of special economic zones (SEZs) in China, this study investigates how such zones affect human capital investment. Results show that SEZs significantly increase the local high school enrollment rate, but the impact varies across zone types: technology-oriented zones encourage education, while export-led zones discourage it. The increased job opportunities and wage premiums inside SEZs for employees with high school education increase high school enrollment, while such opportunities and wages for employees with middle school education decrease enrollment. A very small portion of the impact, if any, can be attributed to increased income. (JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 通过利用中国经济特区数量多、种类丰富的特点，本研究考察了这些特区如何影响人力资本投资。结果表明，经济特区显著提高了当地高中入学率，但影响因特区类型而异：技术导向型特区鼓励教育，而出口导向型特区则抑制教育。特区内为高中教育程度员工提供的更多工作机会和工资溢价提高了高中入学率，而为初中教育程度员工提供的此类机会和工资则降低了入学率。影响中极小部分（如果有的话）可归因于收入增加。（JEL I21, I26, J24, J31, O15, P23, R32）

records.title_en: Common Practice: Spillovers from Medicare on Private Health Care
records.title_cn: 常见实践：医疗保险对私人医疗保健的溢出效应
records.abstract_en: Efforts to raise US health-care productivity have proceeded slowly, potentially due to the fragmentation of payment across insurers. Each insurer’s efforts to improve care could influence how doctors practice for other insurers, leading to unvalued externalities. We study a randomized letter intervention by Medicare to curtail overuse of antipsychotics. The letters did not mention private insurance but reduced prescribing to these patients by 12 percent, much like the 17 percent effect in Medicare. We cannot reject onefor-one spillovers, suggesting that physicians use similar medical practice styles across insurers. Our findings establish that insurers can affect health care well outside their direct purview. (JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)
records.abstract_cn: 提高美国医疗保健生产力的努力进展缓慢，这可能是由于各保险公司之间支付的碎片化。每个保险公司改善护理的努力可能会影响医生对其他保险公司的实践方式，导致未被重视的外部性。我们研究了医疗保险为遏制抗精神病药物过度使用而进行的随机信件干预。这些信件未提及私人保险，但将这些患者的处方减少了12%，与医疗保险中17%的效果非常相似。我们不能拒绝一对一溢出效应，这表明医生在不同保险公司之间使用相似的医疗实践风格。我们的发现确立了保险公司可以影响其直接管辖范围之外的医疗保健。(JEL D24, G22, I11, I13, I18)

records.title_en: Spending Responses to High-Frequency Shifts in Payment Timing: Evidence from the Earned Income Tax Credit
records.title_cn: 支出对付款时间高频变化的反应：来自劳动所得税抵免的证据
records.abstract_en: This study explores the spending response to tax refunds for Earned Income Tax Credit recipients using a novel dataset combining transaction-based measures of retail spending with administrative IRS data on tax refunds. Our dataset allows us to exploit variation in the timing of EITC refunds, including changes related to the 2017 PATH Act, along with cross-state differences in refund magnitudes to identify spending responses. Results show EITC recipients spend about $0.30 per refund dollar ($1,150 for the average refund) within just two weeks of issuance, suggesting stimulus targeted at this population may provide a quick boost to aggregate demand. (JEL D12, E32, G51, H24, I38, K34)
records.abstract_cn: 本研究使用一个新颖的数据集，将基于交易的零售支出指标与国税局的行政退税数据相结合，探讨了所得税抵免受益人对退税的支出反应。我们的数据集使我们能够利用 EITC 退款时间的变化，包括与 2017 PATH 法案相关的变化，以及退款幅度的跨州差异来确定支出反应。结果显示，EITC 领取者在发放后的短短两周内，每美元退款支出约为 0.30 美元（平均退款为 $1,150 美元），这表明针对这一人群的刺激措施可能会迅速提振总需求。 (JEL D12、E32、G51、H24、I38、K34)

records.title_en: How Social Security Reform Affects Retirement and Pension Claiming
records.title_cn: 社会保障改革如何影响退休和养老金领取
records.abstract_en: A reform increasing the full retirement age (FRA) by one year leads to larger than expected delays in pension claiming and retirement, while making late claiming more lucrative leads to a smaller than expected delay in pension claiming. Survey evidence shows people view the FRA as the “normal” retirement age and prefer to couple pension claiming and retirement decisions together, even though these two decisions are not coupled through social security provisions. Two mechanisms are at work: reference dependence with loss aversion in pension claiming, and spillovers from pension claiming on retirement choices. The FRA increase leads to large government savings. (JEL H55, J26)
records.abstract_cn: 一项将完全退休年龄（FRA）提高一年的改革导致养老金领取和退休的延迟幅度大于预期，而提高延迟领取的吸引力则导致养老金领取的延迟幅度小于预期。调查证据显示，人们将FRA视为“正常”退休年龄，并倾向于将养老金领取和退休决策结合起来，尽管这两项决策在社会保障条款中并未相互关联。两种机制在起作用：养老金领取中的参考依赖与损失厌恶，以及养老金领取对退休选择的溢出效应。FRA的提高带来了巨大的政府储蓄。（JEL H55, J26）

records.title_en: Investing in Ex Ante Regulation: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Patent Examination
records.title_cn: 投资于事前监管：来自药品专利审查的证据
records.abstract_en: We explore how the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office may improve the quality of issued patents on “secondary” drug features by giving examiners more time to review drug patent applications. Our findings suggest that current time allocations are causing examiners to issue low-quality secondary patents on the margin. To assess the merits of expanding ex ante scrutiny of drug patent applications at the agency, we set forth estimates of the various gains and losses associated with giving examiners more time, including reduced downstream litigation costs and added personnel expenses, along with both the static gains and dynamic innovation losses associated with earlier generic entry. (JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38)
records.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了美国专利商标局如何通过给予审查员更多时间审查药品专利申请，来提高“次要”药物特征专利的质量。我们的研究结果表明，当前的时间分配正导致审查员在边际上颁发低质量的次要专利。为了评估在该机构扩大药品专利申请事前审查的利弊，我们提出了与给予审查员更多时间相关的各种收益和损失的估计，包括减少下游诉讼成本和增加人员开支，以及早期仿制药进入带来的静态收益和动态创新损失。（JEL K11, L65, O31, O34, O38）

records.title_en: The Impact of Organizational Boundaries on Health Care Coordination and Utilization
records.title_cn: 组织边界对医疗协调和利用的影响
records.abstract_en: We measure organizational concentration—the distribution of a patient’s health care across organizations—to examine how firm boundaries affect health care efficiency. First, when patients move to regions where outpatient visits are typically concentrated within a small set of firms, their health care utilization falls. Second, for patients whose primary care providers (PCPs) exit the market, switching to a PCP with 1 standard deviation higher organizational concentration reduces utilization by 21 percent. This finding is robust to controlling for the spread of health care across providers. Increases in organizational concentration predict improvements in diabetes care and are not associated with greater use of emergency department or inpatient care. (JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32)
records.abstract_cn: 我们衡量组织集中度——患者在不同组织间医疗服务的分布——以考察企业边界如何影响医疗效率。首先，当患者迁移到门诊就诊通常集中在一小部分企业的地区时，其医疗利用下降。其次，对于其主要护理提供者（PCP）退出市场的患者，转向组织集中度高出1个标准差的PCP会使医疗利用减少21%。这一发现在控制医疗服务在提供者间的分散程度后依然稳健。组织集中度的提高预示着糖尿病护理的改善，并且与急诊或住院护理的更多使用无关。（JEL D22, D23, D24, I11, J14, R32）

records.title_en: Corporate Tax Breaks and Executive Compensation
records.title_cn: 公司税收减免与高管薪酬
records.abstract_en: I analyze the effect of two corporate tax breaks, bonus depreciation and the Domestic Production Activities Deduction (DPAD), on executive compensation in publicly traded US firms. I find both tax breaks significantly increase executive compensation. For every dollar a firm benefits from the tax breaks, compensation of the firm’s top five highest-paid executives increases by $0.17 to $0.25. The tax breaks increase compensation primarily in firms with weaker governance structures, suggesting the compensation response is driven by executive rent extraction. (JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52)
records.abstract_cn: 我分析了两种公司税收减免，即奖金折旧和国内生产活动扣除（DPAD），对美国上市公司高管薪酬的影响。我发现这两种税收减免都显著增加了高管薪酬。公司从税收减免中每受益一美元，其薪酬最高的五位高管的薪酬就会增加0.17至0.25美元。税收减免主要在治理结构较弱的公司中增加薪酬，这表明薪酬反应是由高管租金提取驱动的。（JEL D22, G34, H25, M12, M52）

records.title_en: Incentivizing School Attendance in the Presence of Parent-Child Information Frictions
records.title_cn: 在亲子信息摩擦存在的情况下激励上学
records.abstract_en: Many countries use CCTs targeted to parents to promote schooling. Attendance conditions may work through two channels: incentivization and information. If children have private information, (i) providing attendance information to parents may increase attendance inexpensively relative to CCTs and (ii) it may be more effective to incentivize children, who have full information, than parents. Tackling both questions in a unified experimental setting, we find that information alone improves parental monitoring and has a large effect relative to our CCT. Incentivizing children is at least as effective as incentivizing parents––importantly, not because parents were able to appropriate transfers to children. (JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15)
records.abstract_cn: 许多国家使用针对家长的现金转移支付（CCT）来促进就学。出勤条件可能通过两个渠道起作用：激励和信息。如果儿童拥有私人信息，（i）向家长提供出勤信息可能相对于CCT以较低成本增加出勤率，（ii）激励拥有完全信息的儿童可能比激励家长更有效。在统一的实验环境中解决这两个问题，我们发现仅信息就能改善家长监督，并且相对于我们的CCT具有较大的效果。激励儿童至少与激励家长同样有效——重要的是，这不是因为家长能够挪用转移给儿童的资源。（JEL D82, D83, I21, I22, I28, L31, O15）

records.title_en: The Costs of Misaligned Incentives: Energy Inefficiency and the Principal-Agent Problem
records.title_cn: 激励错位的成本：能源效率与委托-代理问题
records.abstract_en: In many settings, misaligned incentives and inadequate monitoring lead employees to take self-interested actions. This paper identifies and quantifies the costs of this principal-agent problem in the context of an energy efficiency appliance replacement program. I show that contractors (agents) hired by the electric utility (the principal) increase their compensation by intentionally misreporting program data to authorize the replacement of nonqualified refrigerators. I estimate that each unqualified replacement reduces program benefits by $106 and saves 30 percent less electricity than replacements that follow program guidelines. The same program without a principal-agent distortion would increase program benefits by $60 per replacement. (JEL D82, L68, L94, L98)
records.abstract_cn: 在许多情境下，激励错位和监管不足导致员工采取自利行为。本文在能效电器更换项目的背景下，识别并量化了这种委托-代理问题的成本。我展示了由电力公司（委托人）雇佣的承包商（代理人）通过故意虚报项目数据以授权更换不合格冰箱，从而增加其报酬。我估计，每次不合格更换使项目收益减少106美元，并且比遵循项目指南的更换节省的电力少30%。没有委托-代理扭曲的同一项目，每次更换将使项目收益增加60美元。（JEL D82, L68, L94, L98）

records.title_en: Interregional Contact and the Formation of a Shared Identity
records.title_cn: 跨区域接触与共同身份的形成
records.abstract_en: We study the long-run effects of contact with individuals from other regions in early adulthood on preferences, beliefs, and national identity. We combine a natural experiment, the random assignment of male conscripts to different locations throughout Spain, with tailored survey data. Being randomly assigned to complete military service outside of one’s region of residence fosters contact with conscripts from other regions and increases sympathy and trust toward people from the region of service, as measured decades later. We also observe a long-lasting increase in identification with Spain for individuals originating from regions with strong peripheral nationalism. (JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13.)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了成年早期与来自其他地区的个体接触对偏好、信念和国家认同的长期影响。我们将一个自然实验——男性应征者被随机分配到西班牙各地服役——与定制的调查数据相结合。被随机分配到居住地区以外的地方完成兵役，促进了与来自其他地区的应征者的接触，并在数十年后测量时，增加了对服役地区人群的同情和信任。我们还观察到，对于来自具有强烈地方民族主义地区的个体，其对西班牙的认同感出现了持久的增强。(JEL D12, D83, D91, J45, R23, Z13。)

records.title_en: More than Words: Leaders’ Speech and Risky Behavior during a Pandemic
records.title_cn: 不止于言辞：疫情期间领导人的讲话与风险行为
records.abstract_en: This paper investigates whether the anti-scientific rhetoric of modern populists can induce followers to engage in risky behavior. We gather electoral information, credit card expenses, and geo-localized mobile phone data for approximately 60 million devices in Brazil. After the president publicly dismissed the risks of the COVID-19 pandemic and challenged scientific recommendations, social distancing in pro-government localities declined. Consistently, credit card expenses increased immediately. Results are driven by localities with higher media penetration levels, active Twitter accounts, and a larger proportion of evangelical Christians, a critical electoral group. (JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了现代民粹主义者的反科学言论是否会诱导追随者从事风险行为。我们收集了巴西约60百万台设备的选举信息、信用卡支出和地理定位手机数据。在总统公开淡化COVID-19疫情风险并挑战科学建议后，亲政府地区的社交距离措施有所减少。与此一致，信用卡支出立即增加。结果由媒体渗透率较高、活跃推特账户较多以及福音派基督徒（一个关键的选举群体）比例较大的地区驱动。（JEL D72, D91, I12, I18, L82, O15, Z12）

records.title_en: ACE—Analytic Climate Economy
records.title_cn: ACE——分析性气候经济
records.abstract_en: I study optimal carbon taxation in an analytic quantitative integrated assessment model (IAM) that links IAM components, parametric assumptions, and calibration approaches directly to their policy impacts. I show how temperature’s tax impact differs from that of previously analytically modeled carbon dynamics. Novel to analytic IAMs are a general economy, energy sectors including capital, varying degrees of substitutability across energy sources, an approximation of capital persistence, objective functions that include CES preferences and population weighting, and an explicit model of the greenhouse effect and ocean-atmosphere temperature dynamics. The paper enables economists to develop better-informed opinions about the social cost of carbon. (JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58)
records.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个分析性定量综合评估模型（IAM）中的最优碳税，该模型将IAM组成部分、参数假设和校准方法直接与其政策影响联系起来。我展示了温度对税收的影响与先前分析性建模的碳动态有何不同。分析性IAM的新颖之处包括：一般经济、包括资本在内的能源部门、能源来源之间不同程度的可替代性、资本持续性的近似、包括CES偏好和人口加权的目标函数，以及温室效应和海洋-大气温度动态的显式模型。本文使经济学家能够对社会碳成本形成更明智的观点。（JEL H23, H43, Q54, Q58）

records.title_en: Immigrant Integration in the United States: The Role of Adult English Language Training
records.title_cn: 美国移民融合：成人英语培训的作用
records.abstract_en: The ability to speak and understand a host country’s primary language is strongly associated with measures of immigrant integration. We estimate the causal effects of English language training for adult immigrants on participants’ civic and economic outcomes using randomized enrollment lotteries from a public adult education program in Massachusetts. Participation doubles voter participation and increases annual earnings by $2,400 (56 percent). Increased tax revenue from earnings gains cover program costs over time, generating a 6 percent return for taxpayers. Ours is the first randomized evaluation of adult English language training as a standalone intervention in the United States. (JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31)
records.abstract_cn: 掌握东道国主要语言的听说能力与移民融合的衡量指标密切相关。我们利用马萨诸塞州一项公共成人教育项目的随机入学抽签，估计了成人移民英语培训对参与者公民和经济结果的因果效应。参与使选民参与率翻倍，并使年收入增加2,400美元（56%）。收入增长带来的税收增加随时间推移覆盖了项目成本，为纳税人带来6%的回报。这是美国首次对成人英语培训作为独立干预措施进行的随机评估。（JEL D72, H75, I21, I26, J15, J24, J31）

records.title_en: Voting for Democracy: Chile’s Plebiscito and the Electoral Participation of a Generation
records.title_cn: 为民主投票：智利的全民公决与一代人的选举参与
records.abstract_en: This paper assesses the long-term consequences of voting for democracy. We study Chile’s 1988 plebiscite, which ended 15 years of dictatorship and reestablished democracy. Taking advantage of individual-level voting data, we implement an age-based regression discontinuity design comparing long-run registration and turnout rates across marginally eligible and ineligible individuals. We find plebiscite eligibility increased electoral turnout three decades later. The magnitude of the initial mobilization emerges as the mechanism. Plebiscite eligibility induced a sizable share of less-educated voters to register compared to other upstream elections. The event contributed to the emergence of one-party rule the 20 years following democratization. (JEL D72, D82, O17)
records.abstract_cn: 本文评估了为民主投票的长期后果。我们研究了智利1988年的全民公决，该公决结束了15年的独裁统治并重建了民主。利用个人层面的投票数据，我们实施了一种基于年龄的断点回归设计，比较了勉强符合资格和不符合资格的个体的长期登记率和投票率。我们发现，公决资格在三十年后提高了选举投票率。初始动员的规模是其中的机制。与其他上游选举相比，公决资格促使相当大比例的受教育程度较低的选民进行登记。这一事件在民主化后的20年中促成了一党统治的出现。（JEL D72, D82, O17）

records.title_en: College Enrollment and Mandatory FAFSA Applications: Evidence from Louisiana
records.title_cn: 大学入学与强制FAFSA申请：来自路易斯安那州的证据
records.abstract_en: I estimate the impact of a Louisiana state policy that mandated Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) applications as a high school graduation requirement. I find significant increases in FAFSA completion rates (19 percentage points), and my estimates imply an increase of 1–2 percentage points in college enrollment. There is suggestive evidence that these effects were more concentrated among lower-income students/schools, and merit-based state financial aid applications also increased. The design of this mandate implies that pushing students into action may be more effective than informational nudges and that localized support systems such as counselors are important for the success of a top-down policy. (JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28)
records.abstract_cn: 我评估了路易斯安那州一项将联邦学生援助免费申请（FAFSA）作为高中毕业要求的州政策的影响。我发现FAFSA完成率显著提高（19个百分点），我的估计表明大学入学率提高了1-2个百分点。有提示性证据表明，这些影响在低收入学生/学校中更为集中，且基于成绩的州财政援助申请也有所增加。这项任务的设计表明，推动学生采取行动可能比信息提示更有效，而辅导员等本地化支持系统对于自上而下政策的成功至关重要。（JEL D91, H75, I21, I22, I23, I28）

records.title_en: Competition for Attention and News Quality
records.title_cn: 注意力竞争与新闻质量
records.abstract_en: Over the past decades the number of news outlets has increased dramatically, but the quality of news products has declined. We propose a model to reconcile these facts where consumers’ attention allocation decisions not only depend on but also affect news outlets’ quality choices. When competition is intensified by new entries, the informativeness of the news industry rises. Thus, attention is diverted from existing outlets, reducing their incentives to improve news quality, which begets a downward spiral. Furthermore, when attention becomes cheaper, a larger number of news outlets can be accommodated in equilibrium, but news quality still falls. (JEL D83, L15, L82)
records.abstract_cn: 在过去几十年中，新闻机构的数量急剧增加，但新闻产品的质量却有所下降。我们提出了一个模型来调和这些事实，其中消费者的注意力分配决策不仅取决于新闻机构的质量选择，而且影响这些选择。当新进入者加剧竞争时，新闻业的信息量上升。因此，注意力从现有机构转移，降低了它们改进新闻质量的激励，从而引发恶性循环。此外，当注意力变得更便宜时，均衡中可以容纳更多的新闻机构，但新闻质量仍然下降。(JEL D83, L15, L82)

records.title_en: Working for References
records.title_cn: 为推荐信而工作
records.abstract_en: We analyze the incentive and welfare consequences of job references in a large economy marked by moral hazard, limited liability, exogenous job separation, and structural unemployment. In the firm-optimal equilibrium, employers provide references whenever production is successful, and workers holding references are hired with certainty in the ensuing period. Compared to a setting without references: the bonus-contract offers are lower, yet the workers’ equilibrium effort is higher. Profits and welfare are higher, yet aggregate worker welfare is lower. Also, firms do not fully internalize the incentive effect of references and could typically increase profits and welfare by jointly raising bonuses. (JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个以道德风险、有限责任、外生离职和结构性失业为特征的大型经济体中，工作推荐信的激励和福利后果。在厂商最优均衡中，雇主在生产成功时提供推荐信，持有推荐信的工人在随后的时期被确定雇佣。与没有推荐信的情况相比：奖金合同报价更低，但工人的均衡努力水平更高。利润和福利更高，但工人总福利更低。此外，厂商并未完全内化推荐信的激励效应，通常可以通过联合提高奖金来增加利润和福利。(JEL D82, D86, E24, J33, J41, L25, M51)

records.title_en: Information Spillover in Multi-Good Adverse Selection
records.title_cn: 多商品逆向选择中的信息溢出
records.abstract_en: This paper analyzes information spillover in a multi-good adverse selection model in which a privately informed seller trades two different goods in two different markets. Buyers learn the seller’s information from both the market they participate in and the trading outcomes in the other market. We identify a sufficient negative correlation condition under which information spillover reduces efficiency loss. We also discover a novel type of coordination friction that leads to multiple equilibria, which can be welfare-ranked by the number of initial no-trade periods. When the sufficient negative correlation condition fails, the efficiency loss is the same as in the case without information spillover. (JEL D82, D83, L15)
records.abstract_cn: 本文分析了多商品逆向选择模型中的信息溢出，在该模型中，拥有私人信息的卖方在两个不同市场上交易两种不同商品。买方从他们参与的市场以及其他市场的交易结果中了解卖方的信息。我们识别出一个充分的负相关条件，在该条件下信息溢出减少了效率损失。我们还发现了一种新型的协调摩擦，导致多重均衡，这些均衡可以根据初始无交易时期的数量进行福利排序。当充分的负相关条件不成立时，效率损失与没有信息溢出时的情况相同。(JEL D82, D83, L15)

records.title_en: A Buyer Power Theory of Exclusive Dealing and Exclusionary Bundling
records.title_cn: 买方势力下的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论
records.abstract_en: We develop a unified theory of exclusive dealing and exclusionary bundling. In a framework with two competing manufacturers that supply their product(s) through a monopolist retailer, we show that buyer power restores the profitability of such practices involving inefficient exclusion. The mechanism underlying this exclusion is that the compensation required by the retailer to renounce selling the rival product erodes with its buyer power. We further show that our theory holds when buyer power differs across manufacturers or when the retailer can strategically narrow (or expand) its product assortment. (JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81)
records.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个统一的排他交易与排他性捆绑理论。在一个由两家竞争性制造商通过垄断零售商供应其产品的框架中，我们表明买方势力恢复了涉及低效排他的此类做法的盈利能力。这种排他背后的机制是，零售商放弃销售竞争对手产品所需的补偿随着其买方势力的增强而减少。我们进一步表明，当买方势力在不同制造商之间存在差异，或者当零售商可以战略性地缩小（或扩大）其产品种类时，我们的理论仍然成立。（JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81）

records.title_en: Equilibrium Screening and Categorical Inequality
records.title_cn: 均衡筛选与类别不平等
records.abstract_en: We analyze equilibrium outcomes under costly screening of candidates from distinct categories. Candidates choose how much effort to invest in skill acquisition, and the screener decides how carefully to screen each candidate. Typically, there are multiple equilibria, and ex ante identical individuals in different categories can receive different equilibrium treatment. The imposition of a quota for an initially disadvantaged group can result in increased screening intensity and skill investment by destabilizing the least active equilibrium. The endogeneity of screening enables powerful comparative statics, which we use to unify different strands in the literature on discrimination. (JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51)
records.abstract_cn: 我们分析了在来自不同类别的候选人进行昂贵筛选下的均衡结果。候选人选择在技能获取上投入多少努力，而筛选者决定对每位候选人进行多仔细的筛选。通常存在多重均衡，且事前相同的个体在不同类别中可能受到不同的均衡待遇。对初始弱势群体实施配额可以通过破坏最不活跃的均衡来增加筛选强度和技能投资。筛选的内生性使得比较静态分析具有强大的力量，我们利用这一点来统一歧视文献中的不同分支。（JEL D63, D82, D83, J24, J31, J71, M51）

records.title_en: Judicial Mechanism Design
records.title_cn: 司法机制设计
records.abstract_en: This paper proposes a mechanism-design approach to study criminal justice systems. We derive properties of optimal mechanisms for two notions of welfare distinguished by their treatment of deterrence. These properties provide insights into the effects of defendants’ private information about their guilt; highlight forces that may underlie certain features of existing systems, such as plea bargaining and binary verdicts and the separation of fact-finding and sentencing; and indicate directions for possible improvements of criminal trials, such as varying the standard for conviction across crimes. (JEL D82, K41, K42)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种机制设计方法来研究刑事司法系统。我们推导了两种福利概念下最优机制的性质，这两种概念的区别在于对威慑的处理方式。这些性质为被告关于自己有罪的私人信息的影响提供了见解；强调了可能构成现有系统某些特征（如辩诉交易、二元裁决以及事实认定与量刑分离）的力量；并指出了刑事审判可能改进的方向，例如在不同犯罪之间调整定罪标准。（JEL D82, K41, K42）

records.title_en: Influence Campaigns
records.title_cn: 影响力运动
records.abstract_en: Firms and politicians, among others, invest heavily to influence people’s opinions. Because peers influence one another, these efforts must account for social networks. Using a model of opinion dynamics with a non-degenerate steady state, I develop a new measure of influence, and I highlight how opinion fluctuations impact influence campaigns. If agents interact less frequently with those holding different opinions, the variance of public opinion decreases. Consequently, a risk-averse planner focuses on persuading a large majority of agents in a small set of tightly knit groups, while a risk-loving planner makes much broader appeals. (JEL D11, D72, D83, D85, Z13)
records.abstract_cn: 企业、政治家等主体投入大量资源以影响人们的观点。由于同伴之间相互影响，这些努力必须考虑社交网络。通过使用一个具有非退化稳态的观点动态模型，我开发了一种新的影响力衡量方法，并强调了观点波动如何影响影响力运动。如果主体与持有不同观点的人互动频率降低，公众观点的方差会减小。因此，风险规避的规划者侧重于说服少数紧密联系群体中的绝大多数主体，而风险偏好的规划者则进行更广泛的呼吁。（JEL D11, D72, D83, D85, Z13）

records.title_en: The Dynamics of Property Rights in Modern Autocracies
records.title_cn: 现代威权政体中的产权动态
records.abstract_en: We study a dynamic model of property appropriation in autocracies. To maintain the appearance of the rule of law, an autocrat reassigns property only when the reassignment is acceptable to all affected citizens. Nevertheless, the autocrat can appropriate public and private property by exploiting enforcement gaps. After an adjustment period, wealth shares of public property and the private property of out-groups decline. The model rationalizes the connection between wealth inequality and privatization in many autocracies. Calibrating to Russian and Chinese data, simulations to mid-twenty-first century display widening wealth gaps between elites and the populace. Anocracies mitigate this outcome. (JEL D31, D72, K11, L33, O17, P26, P36)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究威权政体中财产侵占的动态模型。为了维持法治的表象，独裁者仅在重新分配对所有受影响公民都可接受时才重新分配财产。然而，独裁者可以利用执法漏洞侵占公共和私人财产。经过调整期后，公共财产和外部群体私人财产的财富份额下降。该模型合理化了许多威权政体中财富不平等与私有化之间的联系。根据俄罗斯和中国数据进行校准，模拟到二十一世纪中叶显示精英与民众之间的财富差距扩大。混合政体缓解了这一结果。(JEL D31, D72, K11, L33, O17, P26, P36)

records.title_en: Similarity Nash Equilibria in Statistical Games
records.title_cn: 统计博弈中的相似性纳什均衡
records.abstract_en: A statistical game is a game in which strategic interaction is mediated via a binary outcome y, coupled with a prediction problem where a characteristic x of the game may be used to predict its outcome y based on past values of (x, y) . In Similarity Nash Equilibria, players combine statistical and strategic reasoning, using an estimate of y as a coordination device. They predict y by its similarity-weighted frequency and learn the optimal notion of similarity from the data. We prove that the model captures the importance of precedents and the endogenous formation of sunspots. (JEL C72, C73)
records.abstract_cn: 统计博弈是一种博弈，其中战略互动通过二元结果y进行中介，并伴随一个预测问题，其中博弈的特征x可用于基于(x, y)的过去值来预测其结果y。在相似性纳什均衡中，参与者结合统计和战略推理，使用y的估计作为协调机制。他们通过y的相似性加权频率来预测y，并从数据中学习最优的相似性概念。我们证明该模型捕捉了先例的重要性和太阳黑子的内生形成。(JEL C72, C73)

records.title_en: Bargaining over Treatment Choice under Disagreement
records.title_cn: 分歧下的治疗选择谈判
records.abstract_en: A group of experts with different prior beliefs must choose a treatment. A dataset is made public and leads to revisions of beliefs. We propose a model where the experts’ disagreements are resolved through bargaining, using the Nash bargaining solution. Experts bargain after disclosure of the dataset. Bargaining may lead to an inefficient use of information in a strong sense: experts receive a lower payoff in every state and for any prior belief (i.e., inadmissibility). Bargaining exhibits underreaction to information as compared to the normative solution in which experts bargain ex ante on the procedure used to exploit the data. (JEL C78, D82, D83)
records.abstract_cn: 一组具有不同先验信念的专家必须选择一种治疗方法。一个数据集被公开，并导致信念的修正。我们提出了一个模型，其中专家的分歧通过谈判解决，使用纳什谈判解。专家在数据集披露后进行谈判。谈判可能导致在强意义上的信息利用无效率：专家在每个状态下和任何先验信念下都获得较低的收益（即不可采纳性）。与专家在事前就利用数据的程序进行谈判的规范解相比，谈判表现出对信息的反应不足。（JEL C78, D82, D83）

records.title_en: Bid Caps in Noisy Contests
records.title_cn: 噪声竞赛中的投标上限
records.abstract_en: This paper studies optimal bid caps in a multiplayer noisy contest in which a higher bid does not guarantee a sure win. The bid cap can be either rigid or flexible. The former imposes outright bidding restrictions on players’ bids, while the latter taxes bids. A designer structures the bid cap to maximize a weighted sum between aggregate bid and tax revenue. Our analysis characterizes the optimum. A rigid bid is always outperformed by flexible ones, and a laissez-faire policy—i.e., no cap—is optimal when the designer maximizes the aggregate bid. The results also generate novel practical implications. (JEL C72, D44, D82)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了多人噪声竞赛中的最优投标上限，其中较高的投标并不保证确定获胜。投标上限可以是刚性的或灵活的。前者对参与者的投标施加直接的投标限制，而后者则对投标征税。设计者通过构建投标上限来最大化总投标与税收收入的加权和。我们的分析刻画了最优解。刚性投标总是劣于灵活投标，而当设计者最大化总投标时，自由放任政策——即无上限——是最优的。结果还产生了新颖的实践意义。（JEL C72, D44, D82）

records.title_en: Keeping Up with “The Joneses”: Reference-Dependent Choice with Social Comparisons
records.title_cn: 与“邻居”攀比：社会比较下的参照依赖选择
records.abstract_en: Keeping up with “The Joneses” matters. This paper examines a model of reference-dependent choice where reference points are determined by social comparisons. An increase in the strength of social comparisons, even by only a few agents, increases consumption and decreases welfare for everyone. Strikingly, a higher marginal cost of consumption can increase welfare. In a labor market, social comparisons with coworkers create a big fish in a small pond effect, inducing incomplete labor market sorting. Further, it is the skilled workers with the weakest social networks who are induced to give up income to become the big fish. (JEL D85, J22, J24, J61)
records.abstract_cn: 与“邻居”攀比很重要。本文研究了一个参照依赖选择模型，其中参照点由社会比较决定。社会比较强度的增加，即使仅由少数代理人引起，也会提高所有人的消费并降低福利。引人注目的是，更高的边际消费成本可以提高福利。在劳动力市场中，与同事的社会比较会产生“小池塘里的大鱼”效应，导致劳动力市场不完全分类。此外，正是那些社会网络最弱的熟练工人被诱导放弃收入以成为“大鱼”。(JEL D85, J22, J24, J61)

records.title_en: Disclosure in Markets for Ratings
records.title_cn: 评级市场中的披露
records.abstract_en: We study the implications of the disclosure regime of ratings on the level of information released to the public. Specifically, we compare mandatory and voluntary disclosure. We analyze a model where the potential issuers are initially endowed with homogeneous soft information about their values before paying to acquire ratings. We find that for every accuracy level of the issuers’ initial information, voluntary disclosure results in a more informative equilibrium than mandatory disclosure. This finding identifies a dimension in which the existing European Union regulations that impose the mandatory disclosure of ratings may lead to a loss of information to the public. (JEL D21, D42, D43, D82, D83, G24)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了评级的披露制度对向公众发布的信息水平的影响。具体而言，我们比较了强制披露和自愿披露。我们分析了一个模型，其中潜在的发行人最初拥有关于其价值的同质软信息，然后付费获取评级。我们发现，对于发行人初始信息的每一个准确度水平，自愿披露比强制披露产生更具信息量的均衡。这一发现确定了一个维度，即现有的欧盟法规强制要求披露评级可能导致公众信息的损失。（JEL D21, D42, D43, D82, D83, G24）

records.title_en: Decreasing Impatience
records.title_cn: 递减的不耐烦
records.abstract_en: We characterize decreasing impatience, a common behavioral phenomenon in intertemporal choice. Discount factors that display decreasing impatience are characterized through a convexity axiom for investments at fixed interest rates. Then we show that they are equivalent to a geometric average of generalized quasi-hyperbolic discount rates. Finally, they emerge through parimutuel preference aggregation of exponential discount factors. (JEL D15, D61, D91)
records.abstract_cn: 我们刻画了递减的不耐烦，这是跨期选择中一种常见的行为现象。表现出递减不耐烦的贴现因子通过固定利率下投资的凸性公理来刻画。然后我们证明它们等价于广义拟双曲贴现率的几何平均。最后，它们通过指数贴现因子的帕里穆图偏好聚合而出现。（JEL D15，D61，D91）

records.title_en: Bounds on a Slope from Size Restrictions on Economic Shocks
records.title_cn: 经济冲击规模限制下的斜率界限
records.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning about the effect of one market-level variable (e.g., price) on another (e.g., quantity) in the presence of shocks to unobservables (e.g., preferences). We show that economic intuitions about the plausible size of the shocks can be informative about the parameter of interest. We illustrate with a main application to the grain market. (JEL D83, E23, G13, Q11)
records.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在市场层面一个变量（如价格）对另一个变量（如数量）的影响，同时存在不可观测冲击（如偏好）的问题。我们表明，关于冲击合理规模的经济直觉可以告知感兴趣的参数。我们以谷物市场为主要应用进行说明。（JEL D83, E23, G13, Q11）

records.title_en: Earnings-Based Borrowing Constraints and Macroeconomic Fluctuations
records.title_cn: 基于收益的借贷约束与宏观经济波动
records.abstract_en: Microeconomic evidence reveals a direct link between firms' current earnings and their access to debt. This paper studies macroeconomic implications of earnings-based borrowing constraints. In a macro model, firms with earnings-based constraints borrow more in response to positive investment shocks, whereas firms with collateral constraints borrow less. Empirically, aggregate and firm-level credit responds to identified investment shocks according to the predictions with earnings-based constraints. Moreover, with sticky prices, earnings-based constraints imply that supply shocks are quantitatively more important. This is validated in an estimated version of the model, highlighting the importance of carefully modeling credit constraints to understand policy trade-offs. (JEL E22, E32, G31, G32)
records.abstract_cn: 微观经济证据揭示了企业当前收益与其债务获取之间的直接联系。本文研究了基于收益的借贷约束的宏观经济影响。在一个宏观模型中，面临基于收益约束的企业在正向投资冲击下会借入更多，而面临抵押品约束的企业则会借入更少。实证上，总体和公司层面的信贷对识别出的投资冲击的反应符合基于收益约束的预测。此外，在价格粘性下，基于收益的约束意味着供给冲击在数量上更为重要。这一点在模型的估计版本中得到了验证，强调了仔细建模信贷约束以理解政策权衡的重要性。(JEL E22, E32, G31, G32)

records.title_en: Collective Moral Hazard and the Interbank Market
records.title_cn: 集体道德风险与银行间市场
records.abstract_en: The concentration of risk within the financial system leads to systemic instability. We propose a theory to explain the structure of the financial system and show how it alters the risk-taking incentives of financial institutions when the government optimally intervenes during crises. By issuing interbank claims, risky institutions endogenously become large and interconnected. This concentrated structure enables institutions to share the risk of systemic crises in a privately optimal way but leads to excessive risk taking even by peripheral institutions. Interconnectedness and excessive risk taking reinforce one another. Macroprudential regulation that limits the interconnectedness of risky institutions improves welfare. (JEL D82, E44, G01, G21, G28)
records.abstract_cn: 金融体系内的风险集中导致系统性不稳定。我们提出一个理论来解释金融体系的结构，并展示当政府在危机期间进行最优干预时，这一结构如何改变金融机构的风险承担激励。通过发行银行间债权，高风险机构内生地变得庞大且相互关联。这种集中结构使机构能够以私人最优的方式分担系统性危机的风险，但即使外围机构也会导致过度风险承担。相互关联性与过度风险承担相互强化。限制高风险机构相互关联性的宏观审慎监管能够改善福利。(JEL D82, E44, G01, G21, G28)

records.title_en: Cross-Sectional Uncertainty and the Business Cycle: Evidence from 40 Years of Options Data
records.title_cn: 横截面不确定性与经济周期：来自40年期权数据的证据
records.abstract_en: This paper presents a novel and unique measure of cross-sectional uncertainty constructed from stock options on individual firms. Cross-sectional uncertainty varied little between 1980 and 1995 and subsequently had three distinct peaks—during the tech boom, the financial crisis, and the coronavirus epidemic. Cross-sectional uncertainty has had a mixed relationship with overall economic activity, and aggregate uncertainty is much more powerful for forecasting aggregate growth. The data and moments can be used to calibrate and test structural models of the effects of uncertainty shocks. In international data, we find similar dynamics and a strong common factor in cross-sectional uncertainty. (JEL D21, D81, E23, E24, E32, G13, O34)
records.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种新颖且独特的横截面不确定性度量，该度量基于个股期权构建。横截面不确定性在1980年至1995年间变化不大，随后出现了三个明显的峰值——科技繁荣时期、金融危机时期和冠状病毒疫情时期。横截面不确定性与总体经济活动之间的关系较为复杂，而总体不确定性在预测总体增长方面更为有力。这些数据和矩可用于校准和检验不确定性冲击的结构模型。在国际数据中，我们发现了类似的动态特征以及横截面不确定性中的强共同因子。（JEL D21, D81, E23, E24, E32, G13, O34）

records.title_en: Self-Harming Trade Policy? Protectionism and Production Networks
records.title_cn: 自伤性贸易政策？保护主义与生产网络
records.abstract_en: Using monthly data on temporary trade barriers (TTBs), we estimate the dynamic employment effects of protectionism through vertical production linkages. First, exploiting high-frequency data and TTB procedural details, we identify trade policy shocks exogenous to economic fundamentals. We then use input-output tables to construct measures of protectionism affecting downstream producers. Finally, we estimate panel local projections using the identified trade policy shocks. Protectionism has small and insignificant beneficial effects in protected industries. The effects in downstream industries are negative, sizable, and significant. The employment decline follows an increase in intermediate input and final goods prices and a decline in stock market returns. (JEL E24, F13, F14, F16, G14, L14)
records.abstract_cn: 利用临时贸易壁垒（TTBs）的月度数据，我们通过纵向生产关联估计了保护主义的动态就业效应。首先，利用高频数据和TTB程序细节，我们识别出对经济基本面外生的贸易政策冲击。然后，我们使用投入产出表构建影响下游生产者的保护主义度量。最后，我们使用已识别的贸易政策冲击估计面板局部投影。保护主义在受保护行业中具有微小且不显著的有利效应。在下游行业中的效应为负、规模可观且显著。就业下降伴随着中间投入品和最终商品价格的上涨以及股票市场回报的下降。（JEL E24, F13, F14, F16, G14, L14）

records.title_en: The Response of Consumer Spending to Changes in Gasoline Prices
records.title_cn: 消费者支出对汽油价格变化的反应
records.abstract_en: This paper estimates how overall consumer spending responds to changes in gasoline prices. It uses the differential impact across consumers of the sharp drop in gasoline prices in 2014 for identification. This estimation strategy is implemented using comprehensive, high-frequency, transaction-level data for a large panel of individuals. The average estimated marginal propensity to consume (MPC) out of unanticipated, permanent shocks to income is approximately one. This estimate accounts for the elasticity of demand for gasoline and potential slow adjustment to changes in prices. The high MPC implies that changes in gasoline prices have large aggregate effects. (JEL D12, G51, L11, L71, L81, Q35)
records.abstract_cn: 本文估计了总体消费者支出如何响应汽油价格的变化。它利用2014年汽油价格急剧下跌对不同消费者的差异化影响进行识别。该估计策略使用了一个大型个体面板的综合、高频、交易级数据。对未预期的、永久性收入冲击的平均估计边际消费倾向（MPC）约为一。该估计考虑了汽油需求的弹性以及对价格变化的潜在缓慢调整。高MPC意味着汽油价格的变化具有较大的总体效应。（JEL D12, G51, L11, L71, L81, Q35）

records.title_en: State-Dependent Attention and Pricing Decisions
records.title_cn: 状态依赖的注意力与定价决策
records.abstract_en: This paper studies price-setting decisions under rational inattention. Prices are set by tracking an unobserved target whose distribution is also unknown. Information acquisition is dynamic and fully flexible since, given information acquired previously, price setters choose the amount of information they collect as well as how they want to learn about both the outcome and its distribution. We show that by allowing for imperfect information to be the unique source of rigidity, the model can reconcile stylized facts in the microeconomic evidence on price setting while simultaneously being consistent with empirical results on state-dependent attention. (JEL D21, D82, D83, E32, L11, L25)
records.abstract_cn: 本文研究了理性疏忽下的定价决策。价格通过追踪一个分布也未知的未观测目标来设定。信息获取是动态且完全灵活的，因为给定先前获取的信息，价格设定者选择他们收集的信息量以及他们希望如何了解结果及其分布。我们表明，通过允许不完全信息作为刚性的唯一来源，该模型可以调和关于定价的微观经济证据中的典型事实，同时与关于状态依赖注意力的实证结果一致。(JEL D21, D82, D83, E32, L11, L25)

records.title_en: Capital-Reallocation Frictions and Trade Shocks
records.title_cn: 资本再配置摩擦与贸易冲击
records.abstract_en: What are the short-term effects of an import-competition shock on capital reallocation and aggregate productivity? To address this question, we develop a quantitative model with heterogeneous firms and capital-reallocation frictions. We discipline the model with micro data on investment dynamics of Peruvian manufacturing firms and trade flows between China and Peru. Because of large frictions in firm downsizing and exit, an import-competition shock induces a temporary aggregate-productivity loss and larger dispersion in marginal products, due to investment inaction and exit of some productive firms. Empirical evidence on the effects of trade shocks on capital reallocation supports the model mechanism. (JEL E22, E23, F14, L60, O14, O16, O19)
records.abstract_cn: 进口竞争冲击对资本再配置和总体生产率的短期影响是什么？为回答这一问题，我们构建了一个包含异质性企业和资本再配置摩擦的定量模型。我们利用秘鲁制造业企业投资动态的微观数据以及中国与秘鲁之间的贸易流来校准模型。由于企业缩减规模和退出存在较大摩擦，进口竞争冲击会导致暂时的总体生产率损失和边际产品离散度增大，这源于投资停滞以及一些高生产率企业的退出。关于贸易冲击对资本再配置影响的实证证据支持了模型的机制。（JEL E22, E23, F14, L60, O14, O16, O19）

records.title_en: The State-Dependent Effectiveness of Hiring Subsidies
records.title_cn: 招聘补贴的周期性有效性
records.abstract_en: The responsiveness of job creation to shocks is procyclical, while the responsiveness of job destruction is countercyclical. This new finding can be explained by a heterogeneous-firm model in which hiring costs lead to lumpy employment adjustment. The model predicts that policies that aim to stimulate employment by encouraging job creation, such as hiring subsidies, are significantly less effective in recessions: these are times when few firms are near their hiring thresholds and many firms are near their firing thresholds. Policies that target the job destruction margin, such as employment protection subsidies, are particularly effective at such times. (JEL E24, E32, H25, J23, J64)
records.abstract_cn: 就业创造对冲击的响应是顺周期的，而就业破坏的响应是逆周期的。这一新发现可以通过一个异质性企业模型来解释，其中招聘成本导致就业调整的不连续性。模型预测，旨在通过鼓励就业创造来刺激就业的政策，如招聘补贴，在经济衰退时期效果显著降低：这些时期很少有企业接近其招聘阈值，而许多企业接近其解雇阈值。针对就业破坏边际的政策，如就业保护补贴，在这样的时期尤其有效。(JEL E24, E32, H25, J23, J64)

records.title_en: Learning-through-Survey in Inflation Expectations
records.title_cn: 通胀预期中的调查学习效应
records.abstract_en: When surveys rely on repeat participants, this raises the possibility that survey participation may affect future responses, perhaps by prompting information acquisition between survey waves. We show that these “learning-through-survey” effects are large for household inflation expectations. Repeat survey participants generally have lower inflation expectations and uncertainty, particularly if their initial uncertainty was high. Consequently, repeat participants may be more informed about or attentive to inflation. This has important implications: for example, inflation expectations of new participants are more influenced by oil prices, and estimates of the elasticity of intertemporal substitution are lower for new participants. (JEL C83, D84, E31, E37, E58)
records.abstract_cn: 当调查依赖重复参与者时，这增加了调查参与可能影响未来回应的可能性，或许通过在调查波次之间促使信息获取。我们表明，这些“调查学习”效应对家庭通胀预期影响显著。重复调查参与者通常具有较低的通胀预期和不确定性，特别是当其初始不确定性较高时。因此，重复参与者可能对通胀更为了解或关注。这具有重要意义：例如，新参与者的通胀预期更受油价影响，而跨期替代弹性的估计值对新参与者较低。(JEL C83, D84, E31, E37, E58)

records.title_en: Measuring Monetary Policy in the Euro Area Using SVARs with Residual Restrictions
records.title_cn: 使用残差限制的SVAR模型测量欧元区货币政策
records.abstract_en: This study measures the effects of monetary policy in the euro area using a small number of sign and magnitude restrictions on the residuals of a structural vector autoregression. We derive the dates and directions of these shocks from high-frequency financial market data around official European Central Bank policy announcements. Based on an in-depth narrative analysis and a comparison of the results with those of a standard high-frequency approach, we argue that our approach is purged from central bank information effects.
